jobs.title: Senior/Principal Software Developer
jobs.description: **About Us:** Founded in 2013, Clear Launch is an established software development agency implementing technology that drives business results. We create custom software through experienced consultation, seamless communication, and precise execution. We constantly strive to live up to our company values: Dependability, Hustle, Innovation, and Mastery. Our Clear Launch team of “Rockets” represent communication, collaboration and camaraderie. We are located in North Austin, near Burnet and 183\. **What You'll Do:** Clear Launch is seeking a Senior or Principal software developer to join our rapidly growing team. jobs.title: Head of Safety
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ San Francisco **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- On\-site **Department** -------------- Research \& DevelopmentResearch **We are an applied AI lab building end\-to\-end software agents.** ------------------------------------------------------------------- We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer. Our team is extremely talent\-dense. Among our founding team, we have world\-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro. Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real\-world tasks, apply to join us. **Role Mission** ---------------- Devin is one of the most capable autonomous agents in production. It writes and runs code, uses tools, takes actions in real customer systems, and operates for hours without a human in the loop. That makes it one of the most important places in the industry to get safety right, and one of the few where safety work ships to millions of developers rather than staying in a paper. You will build Cognition's safety function from the ground up: the research agenda, the evaluation and red\-teaming program, the deployment policies, and the team. You will work directly with the researchers training our models and the engineers building the agent harness. This is a hands\-on role for someone who has done serious safety or alignment work at a frontier lab and wants to apply it where agents actually operate. **What You'll Accomplish** -------------------------- * **Own safety end to end:** Set the safety strategy for Devin and the models behind it, and own the outcomes. * **Build the evaluation program:** Design evals and red\-teaming for agentic risk: unsafe actions, prompt injection, data exfiltration, sandbox escape, reward hacking, and misuse. Make them part of every model and product release. * **Shape training and the agent harness:** Partner with pre\-training, post\-training, and agent teams so safety is built into how models are trained and how Devin plans, acts, and asks for help. * **Set deployment policy:** Define what Devin is and is not allowed to do, how permissions and oversight work, and how we handle the gray areas, in a way that holds up with enterprise customers. * **Build the team and the external voice:** Hire and lead safety researchers and engineers. Represent Cognition's safety work with customers, policymakers, and the broader research community. **Exceptional Candidates Have Demonstrated** -------------------------------------------- * **Frontier lab safety or alignment experience:** Hands\-on work on safety, alignment, evaluations, or red\-teaming at a frontier AI lab. You have shipped safety work that affected real models or products. * **Agentic systems depth:** You understand how agents fail in practice: tool misuse, specification gaming, long\-horizon drift, adversarial inputs. You have ideas about how to measure and mitigate it. * **Research credibility:** A track record of published or widely used safety research, evals, or methods. An advanced degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field is a plus. * **Technical fluency:** Comfortable in Python and in the training and inference stack. You can read the code, run the evals, and argue with researchers on the details. * **Builder, not reviewer:** You have started or scaled a safety function and prefer shipping mitigations to writing memos about them. * **Judgment under uncertainty:** You can make clear calls on deployment risk with incomplete information and explain them to engineers, executives, and customers. **Equal Opportunity** --------------------- Cognition is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities throughout the hiring process \- please let us know if you need any.

You will build the evaluations and red\-teaming that gate every release, develop alignment methods that shape how our models are trained, and work directly with the agent team on how Devin plans, acts, and asks for help. This is a hands\-on research engineering role for someone who wants their safety work to run in the loop of a real agent, not sit in a benchmark. **What You'll Accomplish** -------------------------- * **Build agentic safety evals:** Design and run evaluations for the failure modes that matter for autonomous agents: unsafe actions, prompt injection, data exfiltration, sandbox escape, reward hacking, and misuse. Make them fast enough to run on every model and product release. * **Red\-team Devin:** Attack the agent and its harness systematically. Find the failures before customers do and turn them into fixes and regression tests. * **Develop alignment methods:** Work with post\-training on reward modeling, preference data, constitutional approaches, and other techniques that make the model safer without making it worse at the job. * **Shape the agent harness:** Partner with the agent team on permissions, oversight, and escalation: when Devin should act, when it should ask, and how it should explain itself. * **Publish and share:** Contribute to Cognition's external safety work through papers, evals, and open methods where it makes sense. **Exceptional Candidates Have Demonstrated** -------------------------------------------- * **Safety or alignment research experience:** Hands\-on work on evaluations, red\-teaming, alignment, or interpretability at a frontier AI lab or in published research. You have built things that changed how a model was trained or deployed. * **Agentic systems understanding:** You know how agents fail in practice: tool misuse, specification gaming, long\-horizon drift, adversarial inputs. You have measured it or have concrete ideas about how to. * **Strong engineering fundamentals:** Proficiency in Python and PyTorch (or JAX). You can build eval infrastructure, run experiments at scale, and read the training and inference code. * **Empirical rigor:** You design clean experiments, report results honestly, and know the difference between a real improvement and noise. * **Comfort with adversarial thinking:** You enjoy breaking systems and are good at it. * **Relevant industry experience:** Prior experience at a frontier AI lab, applied AI company, or developer tools company. * **Advanced degree:** PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Physics, Mathematics, or a related discipline; or equivalent industry research experience. **Equal Opportunity** --------------------- Cognition is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities throughout the hiring process \- please let us know if you need any.

jobs.description: Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value\-added services for collectors worldwide. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team. Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder. Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France. As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. Our engineering mission is to democratize technology while promoting innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning throughout the organization. We're looking for a **Senior Data Engineer** to help build and scale our data platform. This is a hands\-on IC role: you'll design, build, and own the pipelines that move data across the business, contribute to the architecture of the platform, and help create the foundations that our analytics, reporting, and AI agents depend on. You'll report to the Staff Manager, Data Engineering \& Analytics. Remote or hybrid candidates will also be considered. We believe that there is significant value in in\-person collaboration. If you live within a 1 hour commuting distance to one of our offices, you will be required to be onsite most of the time. This will be discussed further as part of the recruiting process. **What You'll Do** * **Build and own key components of our data platform** , spanning ingestion (Hevo, Estuary), our Google BigQuery warehouse, and the dbt transformation layer — delivering systems that are scalable, reliable, and secure. * **Contribute to architecture and technical direction** , writing design docs, participating in design reviews, and working closely with senior technical leaders to shape how the platform evolves. * **Design and maintain data ingestion pipelines** , building batch and CDC pipelines across a diverse set of sources — operational databases, SaaS applications, and ERP systems — and evaluating tooling options with a clear, well\-reasoned perspective. * **Develop end\-to\-end with AI coding agents** . Our teams build with Claude Code and similar tools, and you'll use them daily while helping refine the practices and guardrails that keep AI\-assisted engineering fast, safe, and high\-quality. * **Improve reliability and observability** , implementing testing, monitoring, alerting, and on\-call practices so data lands on time, is trusted, and failures are caught before stakeholders notice. * **Implement governance and controls** , applying access models, auditability, and operational rigor across the pipelines and datasets you own. * **Help build the foundations for agentic analytics** , delivering well\-modeled, well\-governed data that agents and MCP connections can rely on for trustworthy answers. * **Partner with analytics engineers, analysts, and stakeholders** to understand data needs, unblock high\-value use cases, and turn business requirements into durable platform capabilities. * **Engineer tooling and services beyond the warehouse** — building the APIs, automated jobs, and internal tools in Python that make the platform run smoothly and put data in more people's hands than SQL alone can reach. * **Mentor and support other engineers** through thoughtful code review, pairing, and knowledge sharing, helping raise the quality and consistency of the team's work. * **Explore what's next for our warehouse** , contributing to hands\-on POCs on lakehouse patterns, open table formats, and alternative query engines. **Who You Are** * **An experienced data engineer** with 5\+ years building data platforms and pipelines in orative teammate** . You make the people around you better through code review, knowledge sharing, and mentoring more junior engineers. * **Technically fluent and a clear communicator** . You're strong in SQL and Python, comfortable with version control, CI/CD, and testing workflows, and able to explain technical work to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders. * **Comfortable with cloud infrastructure.** You work beyond the data warehouse, managing serverless compute, storage, and secrets on a major cloud platform like GCP or AWS. * **Curious about where the data stack is heading.** You follow developments in lakehouse patterns and query engines and enjoy testing new ideas through hands\-on work. **Salary Range:** *The salary range for this position is $135,549 \- $220,067\. Actual compensation on this range varies based on a variety of non\-discriminatory factors, including location, job level, experience, and skill set. This role may be eligible for bonuses, commissions, or other forms of compensation, please ask your recruiter for details.* **Reasons To Join Us:** * Health Insurance: All full\-time employees are eligible to enroll in Medical, Dental, and Vision * Additional Benefits: Full\-time employees are eligible for fertility, commuter, and educational assistance benefits. * 401(K) Matching Plan: We are proud to offer a competitive 401k matching plan to our employees to support their future financial goals * Vacation: All salaried employees are eligible for flexible time\-off. * Holiday Pay: All regular, full\-time employees are eligible for ten company paid holidays * Employee Discounts: Employees receive discounts on select grading services for approved submissions * Flexible Hours: Many of our teams offer flexible schedules with varying shifts and will work with you to accommodate your needs * Fun Working Environment: Our team members are invited to participate in celebrations, holiday events, and team building activities Additional Resources: Collectors Tech Blog , PSA * Collectors uses e\-Verify to validate your ability to work legally in the United States. jobs.description: **College Board – Technology – Infrastructure \& InfoSec** **Location:** This is a fully remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). **Type:** This is a full\-time position **About the Team** The College Board Product Security team is a close\-knit and enthusiastic group of technologists with a thirst for knowledge in security and cloud. We collaborate closely to investigate and solve problems and have strong alignment with our product teams to be a step ahead in securing the organization’s suite of products. We are an agile organization, embracing AI and cloud\-native systems, and are focused on improving speed and security of service delivery in support of our important mission. Our team comes from a wide variety of backgrounds as well as experience within the security space and we work to ensure everyone on the team has a voice. Product Security Engineers work closely with product and engineering teams as well as other organizational stakeholder groups to achieve product and security business objectives. They support threat modelling, architecture design, and implementation of secure development practices. In addition, they help define organizational security standards and organizational capability and tooling adoption decisions. **About the Opportunity** As a Senior Product Security Engineer, you will embed with assigned product and engineering teams to own security across the full development lifecycle, from feature\-level design review and threat modeling through vulnerability remediation and production monitoring. This includes a heavy focus on securing AI features built into College Board's products, implementing AI\-native security tooling and features, and assessing and mitigating the risks that AI development tools introduce into the software supply chain. You will join planning and grooming sessions as the team's security partner, translating compliance and requirements and security risks into guidance engineers can act on. You will lead risk assessments, provide prioritization advice, and drive mitigation of risks. Alongside that product or engineering team work, you will coach developers on security practices, including the responsible use of AI coding tools. This role is equal parts hands\-on security engineering and organizational enablement. Your work will directly protect platforms that serve millions of students and educators worldwide. **In this role, you will:** **Partner with Product and Engineering Teams (50%)** * Serve as the security partner for assigned product and engineering teams; join planning, grooming, and design sessions to advise on security architecture and flag risk early. * Own threat models and risk assessments for assigned products; communicate security risks and mitigation plans to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * Own the security engagement lifecycle for each assigned product, from design review and documentation through production deployment and monitoring. * Lead vulnerability reviews and remediation; assess exploitability to set accurate risk priority. * Apply knowledge of emerging best practices in AI security, CB's security policies, and compliance requirements (SOC 2, ISO 27002, PCI, PII) to guide product teams. * Write and review security design documentation and code; give and receive direct feedback in design reviews. Ensure assigned products meet Product Security Framework requirements; identify gaps and drive remediation. * **Elevate Product Security (25%)** * Coach product teams and junior engineers through discussions, code reviews, and hands\-on training to advance secure SDLC practices. * Grow and mature the AI Product Security program; develop security controls and guidance in the use of AI in software engineering, in our products, and in our security program. * Document and share emerging security patterns; keep your knowledge accessible to the full team. Stay current with industry trends; apply what you learn to improve the partner program. * **Drive Operational Improvement (25%)** * Deploy and operate security tooling across cloud environments; integrate automated security controls into CI/CD pipelines. * Contribute to roadmap planning and strategic direction: identify security risks and opportunities, escalate issues with cross\-team scope, and synthesize feedback to inform priorities. * Define and track KPIs that measure product security maturity and partner team posture; use the data to prioritize work and report progress. * Participate in agile ceremonies; manage assigned epics and assess roadmap timelines and risk. jobs.title: Middle Scraping Engineer
jobs.description: Operational Support · Full\-time We are looking for a sharp, proactive, and experienced **Middle Scraping Engineer** to join our team and drive our web data extraction operations forward. This is not a generic backend role. You will work with complex web structures, heavy anti\-bot mechanisms, scale\-driven infrastructure, and high\-load scraping systems. You will expand our crawling coverage, maintain a massive crawling fleet, architect unblocking solutions, and ensure high data quality under strict SLAs. **Why this role is exciting** Scraping at the Middle level is advanced web reverse engineering combined with scalable systems architecture. Every target site is a dynamic battlefield: advanced anti\-bots, CAPTCHAs, fingerprinting, dynamic JavaScript rendering, and changing structures. You won't just write scripts — you will build resilient, automated data\-pipeline infrastructure that handles millions of requests seamlessly. We offer an environment where your technical initiative leads directly to production impact. You will have full ownership of challenging scrapers and the freedom to experiment with new unblocking and engineering approaches. **What you will do** * Maintain and optimize our existing large\-scale crawling fleet to ensure high availability; * Expand crawling coverage by developing scrapers for new, complex target websites; * Improve the quality, throughput, and success rates of existing crawls; * Research, update, and develop custom unblocking solutions to bypass modern anti\-bot protections; * Ensure consistent data delivery while strictly maintaining client SLAs; * Support team bandwidth by actively taking on R\&D tasks, solving complex edge cases, and mentoring junior engineers. **What we expect** * Strong Python mastery ("Python Ninja") with clean, scalable code practices; * Deep expertise in Scrapy, Playwright, and async networking; * Solid hands\-on experience with proxy management (residential, datacenter, rotating networks, session stickiness); * Experience with advanced unblocking tools and techniques (bypassing Cloudflare, Akamai, Datadome, CAPTCHA solvers, TLS/browser fingerprinting); * Practical DevOps knowledge (Docker, CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, monitoring); * Strong web reverse engineering skills (analyzing network traffic, API endpoints, WebSocket messages, minified JS); * Experience in building or deploying scalable web scraping infrastructure; * High level of responsibility, SLA\-driven mindset, and target\-oriented approach; * Excellent teamwork, fast thinking, and strong problem\-solving skills in high\-pressure situations. **You’re gonna love it, and here’s why:** * Rich innovative software stack, freedom to choose the best suitable technologies; * Remote\-first ideology: freedom to operate from the home office or any suitable coworking; * Flexible working hours (we start from 8 to 11 am) and no time tracking systems on; * Regular performance and compensation reviews; * Recurrent 1\-1s and measurable OKRs; * In\-depth onboarding with a clear success track; * Competera covers 70% of your training/course fee; * 20 vacation days, 15 days off, and up to one week of paid Christmas holidays; * 20 business days of sick leave. **Drive innovations with us. Be a Competerian.**

jobs.title: UI UX Developer
jobs.description: **POSITION SUMMARY** We're seeking multiple UI/UX Developers to join the growing frontend team behind LEXSO (Layered Extended Security Operations)—a modular, microservice\-based platform designed to integrate advanced sensors, AI, and automation for enhanced situational awareness and real\-time security operations. As a UI/UX Developer, you'll help design and build the user interfaces and visual workflows that operators depend on for mission\-critical decision\-making. Our current frontend stack is built with React, WebSockets, and real\-time geospatial mapping via Mapbox—but we're open to web developers from all backgrounds with a passion for intuitive, data\-rich design. Whether you're early in your career or bring years of experience, this role offers the chance to contribute meaningfully to a fast\-paced engineering team building an ambitious, high\-impact platform. **RESPONSIBILTIES** * Design and implement UI components for our real\-time operational dashboard, timelines, alerts, and camera/video controls. * Develop and refine user workflows and interactive visualizations (e.g., geospatial overlays, drag/drop control, event timelines). * Work with React, TypeScript, WebSockets, and REST APIs—while maintaining flexibility for other modern frameworks. * Collaborate with backend and sensor engineers to build intuitive interfaces for complex system automation. * Help evolve our design system and component libraries (e.g., shadcn/ui, Tailwind CSS, etc.). * Translate user and product requirements into well\-structured, testable UI features. * Participate in sprint planning, design reviews, and end\-to\-end testing. * Collaborate using Git, GitHub, Figma, Jira/Confluence, and CI/CD pipelines. * Work is typically based in a busy remote environment and subject to frequent interruptions. Business work hours are Monday\-Friday standard core hours, however some extended or weekend hours may be required. * Other duties as assigned. **QUALIFICATIONS:** We welcome a wide range of experience levels—from early\-career UI developers to more seasoned frontend engineers. * 3\+ years of experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks (React preferred). * Familiarity with responsive design, web accessibility, and component\-based UI architecture. * Understanding of REST APIs, data modeling, and web\-based state management. * Strong attention to detail and UX best practices. * Collaborative mindset and effective communication skills. * Preferred exposure to: * React, Next.js, or Vue.js + Mapbox, geospatial UI, or real\-time data visualization + Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, or other component libraries + WebSockets, pub/sub architectures (e.g., Kafka), or real\-time streaming data + Figma, design tokens, or UI/UX workflows + Docker, Kubernetes, or other DevOps tools + Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/Engineering, Human\-Computer Interaction (HCI), Software Engineering, Digital Media, or a related technical/design field is required. + Degrees in Interaction Design, UX/UI Design, or Web Development will also be considered **BENEFITS** Constellis offers a comprehensive, total rewards package that includes competitive compensation and a flexible benefits package that reflects its commitment to creating a diverse and supportive workplace. Requirements: ***Equal Opportunity Employer*** ***Race/Color/Sex/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/Disability/Vet***

jobs.description: **Senior Manager, IT Infrastructure** **Department:** Information Technology **Reports To:** Director of IT Infrastructure \& Operations **Location:** Construction Resources **Position Type:** Full\-Time, Exempt **Position Summary** The **Senior Manager of IT Infrastructure** is a key leadership position responsible for the day\-to\-day leadership, execution, reliability, security, and continuous improvement of Construction Resources' enterprise infrastructure. Reporting directly to the **Director of IT Infrastructure \& Operations**, this position serves as the Director's **right hand and primary infrastructure leader**, translating infrastructure strategy and organizational priorities into successful technical execution. The Senior Manager leads the Systems Administration and Systems Engineering functions and is responsible for coordinating infrastructure projects, establishing technical standards, managing operational priorities, and ensuring that enterprise infrastructure services remain secure, resilient, scalable, and aligned with the needs of the business. This position requires a combination of **people leadership, technical depth, project execution, operational discipline, and strategic thinking**. The successful candidate should be capable of leading technical teams and complex initiatives while also stepping into detailed technical discussions when necessary. **Key Responsibilities** **Infrastructure Leadership \& Team Management** * Provide direct leadership, coaching, prioritization, and technical guidance to Systems Administrators, Systems Engineers, contractors, and other infrastructure resources. * Establish clear expectations, responsibilities, technical standards, and operational priorities for the Infrastructure team. * Conduct regular team meetings, project reviews, technical reviews, and one\-on\-one discussions. * Develop team capabilities through mentoring, cross\-training, documentation, and knowledge transfer. * Identify resource, skill, and compliance\-driven environments, including PCI\-related infrastructure controls. * ITIL, Microsoft, Azure, Cisco, VMware, security, or comparable technical certifications are preferred. **Measures of jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer - Search Features & APIs (SABR)
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Engineering **About us** ============ Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI\-first e\-commerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e\-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains. **About the team** ================== The SABR team owns the top layer of request processing for product discovery. We own the service that first receives product discovery requests (autocomplete, search, browse \& recommendations) \& executes the entire business logic that drives product discovery. That service also functions as a gateway to parse incoming user requests, orchestrate calls across the internal services that do the ranking and retrieval, interpret their responses, and assemble the final response the customer sees. We also own the public configuration APIs customers use to control how discovery behaves, and the MCP layer that exposes all of it to AI agents. Our team owns both platform \& product components: Because of the positioning of our services, we take part in every architectural decision of our core product offering. At the same time, our goals are heavily influenced by direct customer feedback, because all product discovery\-related features are either implemented in or integrated with our services. All of our services are public APIs, so interface design and backward compatibility are a constant part of the job. But most of our attention goes to keeping them fast and up: we serve up to 15k RPS, fan out to many internal services on every request, and are expected to stay available and degrade gracefully when any of them fails or slows down. The work is distributed systems in practice rather than in theory: request orchestration, failure isolation, caching, latency budgets, capacity planning, and the observability to know what is actually happening in production. The team is small enough that engineers own problems end to end, from design through on\-call. **About you** ============= You're a staff\-level engineer who wants to own systems, not tickets. You've built high\-traffic, low\-latency Python services and carried the pager for them. You think in trade\-offs: latency versus cost, flexibility versus a public API that customers can't afford to see break, the fix that ships this week versus the architecture that has to last two years. You can lead work that spans several engineers and several quarters, you enjoy mentoring others, and you're fine when a problem shows up half\-defined. You don't mind being the one who reads the spec for some unfamiliar protocol, works out how it fits, and designs an integration that holds up at scale. You change your mind when someone has a better argument, you make the people around you better, and you still care about your code long after it merges. **What you will do** ==================== * Own the technical direction of one or more of our services \- architecture, performance, and reliability. * Lead design of new systems and public APIs, and the evolution of existing ones as traffic and feature scope grow. * Raise the engineering bar through design and code review, and mentor mid and senior engineers into owning bigger scopes. * Partner with product, other engineering teams, and solutions/support to shape what we build and to represent search constraints and trade\-offs honestly. * Take part in on\-call for the systems you own, and lead incident response and follow\-through when things break. **What we are looking for** --------------------------- ### **Technical** * Substantial experience building and operating high\-traffic, low\-latency backend services in production. * Extensive Python knowledge (our primary language). * Experience with observability and performance work in live systems. * Experience designing and evolving public APIs that external customers depend on. * Experience designing \& implementing scalable service\-oriented architectures. ### **Beyond the code** * Track record of leading projects that span multiple engineers and quarters. * Influence without authority, and willingness to change your position when someone has a better argument. * Clear written communication \- design docs, RFCs, postmortems. * Good judgment about trade\-offs and scope. * Comfort with ambiguity and loosely defined problems. * Ownership that extends past merge, to how the system behaves in production. ### **Nice to have** * Experience with AWS * Background in search, ranking, information retrieval, or e\-commerce product discovery. * Exposure to AI/LLM\-facing infrastructure (MCP, agent tooling, or similar). **Benefits** ============ ️ Unlimited vacation time \- we strongly encourage all of our employees take at least 3 weeks per year Fully remote team \- choose where you live ️ Work from home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office Apple laptops provided for new employees ‍ Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year Maternity \& Paternity leave for qualified employees Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact Base salary: $110k–$130k USD, depending on knowledge, skills, experience, and interview results Stock options \- offered in addition to the base salary Regular team offsites to connect and collaborate **Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Constructor** =================================================== At Constructor.io we are committed to cultivating a work environment that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome individuals of all backgrounds and provide equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of their education, diversity of opinion, race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status or affiliation in any other protected group. Studies have shown that women and people of color may be less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every one of the qualifications listed. Our primary interest is in finding the best candidate for the job. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of our listed qualifications. How we handle your data. By submitting this application, you acknowledge that Constructor will collect and process the personal data you provide for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for this role. If you are not selected, we will retain your data for a limited period as described in our Recruitment Privacy Notice. After that period your data will be deleted or anonymized. **How we handle your data.** By submitting this application, you acknowledge that Constructor will collect and process the personal data you provide for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for this role. If you are not selected, we will retain your data for a limited period as described in our Recruitment Privacy Notice. After that period your data will be deleted or anonymized.

Our data centers bring dozens of organizations together under one roof, supporting the technology and services that keep our world connected. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, bringing the expertise, ideas and commitment that power our business and help our customers succeed. With a culture built on collaboration, ownership, and operational excellence, CoreSite is a place to make an impact. **Critical Operations Engineer I:** As a member of the Data Center Operations team, the Critical Operations Engineer I (COE I) is responsible for operating, monitoring, and maintaining critical data center electrical, mechanical, cooling, and fire/life safety systems to support reliable facility operations. COE I performs routine operational tasks, responds to alarms and abnormal conditions, supports customer infrastructure projects, and works closely with team members, vendors, and customers while developing technical knowledge and experience within a mission\-critical environment. The COE I follows established operational procedures, safety standards, and best practices while supporting day\-to\-day facility operations and continuous improvement efforts. The position also performs other duties and responsibilities as assigned. * We are currently hiring for the Swing Shift Tuesday \- Saturday 2:00pm \- 10:30pm. **What You'll Do:** **Critical Facilities infrastructure * Working knowledge of basic security systems, including access control, CCTV, and facility monitoring systems **Education/Experience:** * High School Diploma or greater * 2\-5 years of jobs.title: Tenure-Track Faculty - School of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Cornell University
jobs.description: The SCHOOL OF ELECTRICAL AND COMPUTER ENGINEERING at CORNELL UNIVERSITY is looking for outstanding candidates for multiple tenure\-track faculty positions in all areas of electrical and computer engineering, at all ranks of seniority, for its main campus in Ithaca, New York. We are particularly interested in the following areas: computer engineering (e.g., AI hardware, computer architecture, digital VLSI), robotics, semiconductor devices, plasma science and engineering, and quantum devices. Please see our website, **https://www.ece.cornell.edu/**, for additional information about the school. Applicants must hold a doctorate in an appropriate field by the time their faculty appointment begins. They must have demonstrated an ability to conduct outstanding research and show promise for excellence in teaching. Salary and rank will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. We are especially interested in exceptionally qualified candidates who can contribute positively, through their research, teaching, and service, to our diverse Cornell academic community and to create a climate that attracts students of all backgrounds. **Applicants should submit a cover letter; curriculum vitae (CV); brief statements describing research, teaching, and service; three publications; and arrange to have at least three reference letters submitted.** Applications must be submitted online at: https://academicjobsonline.org/ajo/jobs/32962 Review of applications will begin immediately. Applications received by December 1, 2026 will receive full consideration. Inquires may be directed to: Anders Larson, apl8@cornell.edu, Assistant to the Directors. Closing Date: January 15, 2027 The salary range reflects an aggregate of qualifications and disciplines across Cornell University and will fall between $83,200 \- $357,300\. The hiring rate of pay for the successful candidate will be determined considering the following criteria: * Prior relevant work or industry experience * Education level to the extent education is relevant to the position * Academic discipline (faculty pay ranges reflect 9\-month annual salary) * Unique applicable skills Cornell University is the largest and newest of the Ivy League universities, and our College of Engineering ranks highest among them. Ezra Cornell’s 1865 foundational vision of “any person, any study” is palpable in everyday life on campus, as faculty and students have access to an exceptional breadth of research and learning opportunities while immersed in an atmosphere of inclusive collaboration. The town of Ithaca sits at the southern tip of Cayuga Lake, the second largest in the Fingerlakes region of New York State. It combines breathtaking natural beauty and a small\-town lifestyle with the cultural and culinary offerings of larger cities. The seasonal climate in this privileged setting allows for many outdoor activities, such as sailing, swimming, biking, hiking, skiing, or ice skating. Cornell University seeks to meet the needs of dual career couples, has a Dual Career program, and is a member of the Upstate New York Higher Education Recruitment Consortium to assist with dual career searches including positions available in higher education in, the upstate New York area. **Pay Range:** Refer to Posting Language **Pay Ranges:** The hiring rate of pay for the successful candidate will be determined considering the following criteria: * Prior relevant work or industry experience. * Education level to the extent education is relevant to the position. * Academic Discipline * Unique applicable skills. **Employment Assistance:** For general questions about the position or the application process, please contact the Recruiter listed in the job posting or email mycareer@cornell.edu. jobs.title: Data & AI Engineer - (Hybrid)
jobs.description: Cruise Planners is the largest franchisor of home\-based travel agencies across the country that independently book cruises, tour, and land vacations. Cruise Planners has achieved Top Producer status with virtually every cruise line, tour, and resort company. Cruise Planners has been named the No.1 Cruise Tour / Travel Agency by Entrepreneur Magazine for the past 10 years and recently featured in Entrepreneur as one of the top 30 franchise innovators in technology. Cruise Planners positions franchise owners for success by providing them with innovative marketing, booking and lead\-generating tools as well as professional development and hands\-on training with the industry’s top executives. Cruise Planners Home Office has won awards such as Coolest Offices and Top Places to Work in South Florida by Sun Sentinel and South Florida Business Journal. ***\*\******Candidates must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa*****\*\**** **Job Summary** The Data \& AI Engineer designs, builds, and operates the data and AI systems behind Cruise Planners' analytics, advisor\-facing products, and internal automation. The role combines production data engineering on AWS (Glue, Redshift, Step Functions, Lambda, S3\) with applied generative\-AI work on Amazon Bedrock (Data Automation, Knowledge Bases, AgentCore) and the Strands Agents SDK. Day\-to\-day development is conducted through agentic coding tooling — Claude Code with MCP — used as a primary engineering surface, not as autocomplete, with the pace and scope of delivery expected to exceed what traditional tooling supports. The team is small: engineers scope, build, deploy, document, and operate their own work end to end. *The items listed below are intended to provide an overview of the essential functions of the job. This is not an exhaustive list of all functions and responsibilities that the position may be required to perform.* **Responsibilities** * Design and operate data pipelines on AWS — Glue, Step Functions, Lambda, EventBridge, S3 — feeding the Redshift data warehouse. * Stand up and operate containerized production pipelines on AWS Fargate / ECS (scheduled ingest or scrape, enrich, deliver) with CloudWatch alarms and health monitoring. * Design dimensional data models — facts, conformed dimensions, and analytics marts — on Redshift over a zero\-ETL replica of the operational source. * Implement document\-extraction pipelines using Amazon Bedrock Data Automation blueprints and deliver structured output to downstream consumers via webhook or queue. * Build and operate Bedrock Knowledge Bases for retrieval\-augmented generation: source preparation, indexing, retrieval evaluation, and cost / latency tuning. * Build agents using the Strands Agents SDK on Bedrock AgentCore — supervisor / sub\-agent topologies, tool definitions, and deployment hardening. * Build applied\-LLM data products for reporting, search, and agentic operations. * Deploy and operate services on AWS end to end, including internal web apps and demos. * Build internal tooling and integrations, including MCP servers. * Prototype and ship new AI\-powered applications for advisors and internal teams. * Maintain operational quality — logs, alarms, runbooks, on\-call response, post\-incident notes — and continuously monitor quality and compliance with data\-privacy regulations. * Conduct day\-to\-day development through Claude Code with project\-scoped MCP servers, document decisions and architectures in the team wiki. **Competencies** **Technical (builds with)** * AWS data and serverless services. * Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore Runtime. * Python (primary); SQL (baseline). * Data warehousing and dimensional modeling. * Agent and LLM frameworks. * Infrastructure\-as\-code. **Tooling (works with)** * Claude Code as the primary development surface, including parallel sessions. * MCP servers (AWS, Excolo, Atlassian) as deterministic tool routing for work that previously spanned terminal, IDE, and browser. * Comfort treating the model as a collaborator — generating alternatives, having design conversations, validating choices before committing — rather than as autocomplete. **General** * Writes documentation a teammate can pick up and act on without a meeting. * Explains trade\-offs in plain language to non\-engineers (Marketing, Operations, Finance). * Strong problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. **Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field. Master's preferred at the Senior level. * Relevant production experience scaled to level (Data \& AI Engineer I / II / Senior). * Authorization to work in the United States without sponsorship. **Levels** Placement is by experience, evidenced output, and judgment scope — not by years alone. * **Data \& AI Engineer I** — Executes scoped work end to end under guidance; ships well\-defined pipelines, blueprints, or Knowledge Base load jobs. * **Data \& AI Engineer II** — Owns workstreams end to end (design, build, deploy, operate) and makes architecture choices within an established pattern; writes the playbook a peer can ship from. * **Senior Data \& AI Engineer** — Owns multi\-system architecture; stands up a new pattern (e.g., AgentCore deployment, multi\-agent topology) without precedent; coaches peers; represents the team in cross\-functional design. Operates across the full stack — Fargate production pipelines, inbound AWS deployments, applied\-LLM data products, and end\-to\-end agent architecture. **This is a hybrid role (Remote: Mondays and Fridays, Onsite: Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays)** *Cruise Planners provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all team members and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. Cruise Planners complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities or team members. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment.*

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Sales, Client Services, Marketing and Finance)
jobs.description: Overview: **Our Culture and Impact** Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6,000\+ employees and 34,000\+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500\. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection. Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections. **AI at Cvent: Leading the Future** Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation. Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI\-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you. **Role Overview** Cvent is building an AI\-forward enterprise and is looking for an AI Transformation Leader to turn that ambition into practical, measurable outcomes. You’ll partner across one or more functions—including Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Finance—helping teams improve workflows while ensuring solutions are secure, governed, and aligned with enterprise priorities. This is a business\-facing role with a strong technology and change\-management dimension. You’ll build trust with stakeholders, connect business needs to technical possibilities, and help teams adopt solutions responsibly. Success means measurable business impact and lasting capability—not simply a tool or pilot. In This Role, You Will:: * Build trusted relationships with business leaders and teams; learn their goals, processes, pain points, and measures of success. * Map end\-to\-end workflows and identify opportunities for AI, automation, and process redesign. * Translate ambiguous business challenges into clear problem statements, prioritized use cases, requirements, and outcome\-based plans. * Shape partners to assess solutions and support responsible implementation. * Help teams apply AI in ways that complement human judgment and expertise, with appropriate review and control points. * Establish success measures—such as time saved, improved service, stronger forecast accuracy, increased retention, or revenue and pipeline impact—and track results. * Create repeatable playbooks, operating practices, and enablement materials so improvements can scale beyond an individual project. * Gather and channel new ideas through established governance and prioritization processes, avoiding fragmented or duplicative solutions. * Communicate recommendations and outcomes clearly to business stakeholders, technical partners, and senior leaders. **Functional areas you may support** The role may focus on one or more of the following areas, based on business priorities and your experience:* **Sales:** Prospecting, pipeline management, forecasting, deal support, quoting, sales operations, enablement, and revenue operations. * **Customer Success and Client Services:** Onboarding, implementation, adoption, customer health, support, renewals, retention, and expansion. * **Marketing:** Demand generation, account\-based marketing, campaign operations, content workflows, digital channels, and attribution. * **Finance:** Planning and forecasting, accounting, reporting, procurement, order\-to\-cash, collections, and financial operations. You do not need to be a deep subject\-matter expert in every function. We’re looking for strong transformation skills, a willingness to learn new business domains, and the ability to connect people, processes, and technology. Here's What You Need:: * Significant experience leading business transformation, enterprise technology delivery, AI implementation, intelligent automation, consulting, or a related discipline. * A track record of taking initiatives from discovery through implementation and adoption, with measurable outcomes. * Ability to understand complex processes and translate business needs into structured requirements and practical solution plans. * Experience partnering across business and technical teams, including data, engineering, IT, security, and operations. * Familiarity with AI, generative AI, workflow automation, analytics, or enterprise platforms—and the judgment to select approaches based on the problem rather than a single tool. * Strong change\-management and communication skills, including the ability to earn trust, facilitate working sessions, and explain technical concepts in business terms. * Sound judgment around governance, data protection, security, risk, and human oversight in enterprise environments. * A builder’s mindset: you create reusable approaches and leave teams better equipped to sustain and extend the work. **Nice to have*** Experience in one or more of Sales, Customer Success, Client Services, Marketing, or Finance. * Experience in a complex or regulated enterprise environment. * Familiarity with CRM, customer success, marketing automation, finance, analytics, or enterprise workflow platforms. * Experience defining AI or automation metrics, building business cases, or communicating results to executive audiences. * Experience developing playbooks, centers of excellence, enablement programs, or operating models. **Who you are*** **Outcome\-oriented:** You measure success by meaningful business results, not activity or technology alone. * **Curious and consultative:** You listen, learn the context, and build trust before recommending change. * **Comfortable with ambiguity:** You create clarity and momentum when the problem or path forward is not yet fully defined. * **Pragmatic about AI:** You understand where AI can help, where people should remain in control, and why responsible adoption matters. * **Collaborative:** You bring together business and technical partners to move from ideas to implementation. * **Focused on lasting impact:** You help teams build the capability to sustain improvements over time. *This job posting is intended to comply with all applicable laws. If we learn during the course of our recruitment process that, due to an applicant’s location, further information about the position is required, including certain salary information, this information in this posting will be supplemented accordingly.**The estimated base salary range for new hires into this role is $150,000 \- $200,000 annually \+ bonus depending on factors such as job\-related knowledge, relevant experience, and location. jobs.title: Director, Technical Marketing
jobs.description: MKTQ427R50 As the Director of Technical Marketing at Databricks, you will lead and scale the team responsible for explaining Databricks products, and what you can do with them, at scale to technical buyers and practitioners (from data engineers, data scientists, and ML engineers to solutions architects, platform teams, security engineers, and application developers). You will own the strategy and execution of technical content in written and video form, demos, workshops, launch storytelling, and outbound evangelism that drives technical mindshare, consideration, product adoption, and ultimately pipeline. In the era of agentic marketing and AEO/GEO, your team will increasingly produce content designed to educate both humans and agents alike. You will also play an outsized role in programming the technical content for key Databricks events, such as the Data \+ AI Summit and Data \+ AI World Tour, among others. Reporting to the SVP of Product \& Solutions Marketing, you will manage a team of 6\+ Technical Marketing Managers (growing) and serve as the connective tissue between Product, Product Marketing, Field Engineering, and the broader technical community. This role expands the traditional TMM charter to include a stronger outbound evangelism dimension, becoming a visible, trusted technical voice externally through social media, YouTube, conferences, and the data practitioner ecosystem while continuing to own the core technical content engine that powers Summit, World Tour, workshops, and field enablement. **The impact you will have:** **First 6 months:** * Assess the current TMM team's strengths, gaps, and capacity; establish a clear operating model with defined ownership areas (product coverage, content types, GEO) and a quarterly planning cadence. Own and deliver the technical content agenda for Data \+ AI World Tour and/or the next major Tier 1 event, achieving* 4\.5/5\.0 average session ratings and measurable pipeline contribution. Launch or significantly expand at least 2 new outbound evangelism motions (e.g., a YouTube series architecture, a technical social media cadence, or a creator/influencer engagement program) that grow Databricks' external technical reach by* 25%. * Build an AI\-powered publishing engine that enables the TMM team to scale content faster, leveraging AI assistance for content creation and publishing. * Establish yourself as a credible external technical voice, publishing 3\+ original technical pieces (blogs, videos, or talks) and representing Databricks at 2\+ external events or podcasts. **First 12 months:** * Scale the TMM team to meet growing demand across an expanding set of technical personas (solutions architects, platform engineers, security teams, data scientists, analysts, app developers) driven by the 2026\+ product surface (Lakebase, Genie, Lakewatch, Agent Bricks, Omnigent). * Work with Databricks Field Engineering and FDE (Forward\-Deployed Engineering) to capture repeatable product use cases into a Solutions Library, building a motion to scale capture and marketing of these use cases for learning across the entire community. Build and operationalize a "1 launch* many assets" content engine that converts every major product launch into persona\-specific learning journeys (demos, workshops, blogs, videos, social). * Grow Databricks' YouTube and social technical content reach by 2x, with a series\-based content architecture targeting key personas at multiple depth levels. * Drive measurable contribution to AEO/GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) ensuring Databricks is cited by default in AI answer engines for key buyer questions. **First 18–24 months:** * Establish Databricks as the default place every technical practitioner learns data \+ AI, measured by YouTube subscriber growth (target: 300K\+), technical content engagement, and Free Edition activation rates tied to content. * Build a formal Databricks Creators program that turns independent creator reach into co\-owned, accurate, early\-access content across new product areas. * Develop the TMM team into a recognized center of excellence — with clear career paths, a strong hiring bar, and a reputation as one of the best technical marketing teams in enterprise software. **What we look for:** * 10\+ years of experience in technical marketing, developer relations, solutions engineering, field engineering, or a related technical field in enterprise software / SaaS / cloud. * 3\+ years of people management experience, with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining high\-performing technical teams. * Deep technical fluency in data, AI/ML, and cloud platforms, comfortable building demos and engaging credibly with data engineers, data scientists, solutions architects, and other technical practitioners across the data \+ AI ecosystem. * Demonstrated outbound evangelism skills, including a visible external presence through conference speaking, technical blogging, YouTube/video content, or social media thought leadership. * Experience owning technical content strategy for major product launches and flagship events (e.g., user conferences, world tours). * Strong cross\-functional influence with a proven ability to partner with Product Management, Product Marketing, Field Engineering, and Sales to align on priorities and deliver integrated GTM. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into compelling narratives for multiple audiences. **Preferred:** * Experience with data platforms, lakehouse architectures, Apache Spark, or related open\-source data technologies. * Experience building or scaling a YouTube channel, podcast, or technical content program for practitioner audiences. * Familiarity with GEO / AI answer engine optimization strategies. * Experience with technical community building, creator programs, or influencer engagement across practitioner audiences. * Track record of building technical content that drives measurable pipeline and product adoption. **Pay Range Transparency** Databricks is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The pay range(s) for this role is listed below and represents the expected salary range for non\-commissionable roles or on\-target earnings for commissionable roles. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job\-related skills, depth of experience, relevant certifications and training, and specific work location. Based on the factors above, Databricks anticipates utilizing the full width of the range. The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for annual performance bonus, equity, and the benefits listed above. jobs.title: Security Manager
jobs.description: Who We Are Catalyst Capital is a profitable, bootstrapped holding company building a diversified financial services group: education, publishing, software, wealth \& tax planning tools, investment products and proprietary trading technology. Funded entirely from its own operating cash. Role summary Catalyst Capital is hiring a Security Manager to own security across our brands. You will run the security program, lead incident response, and build a small security team as we grow. This is a hands\-on leadership role: you set the direction and you still do real technical work. You report to our Head of Technology and brief our leadership team directly every month. When something goes wrong, you are the person leadership trusts to run the response and explain it in plain language. What you will own * Security program. Own the security strategy and roadmap across Decentralized Masters, Legacy, Inflection Club, and future brands. Report on security posture and risk to leadership every month. * Incident response. Own incident response end to end and lead the room during live incidents. Keep runbooks current, run tabletop exercises, and write postmortems leadership can act on. * Team leadership. Manage and develop our Security Engineer, and build the security team as the company scales. * Policy and audit readiness. Write and enforce security policies that people actually follow: access control, acceptable use, data handling, vendor review, and incident response. Prepare the company for audits such as SOC 2, working with Legal \& Compliance. * Phishing and impersonation defense. Own email security, staff training, and phishing simulations. Run brand protection: find and take down fake domains and accounts impersonating our brands on social media platforms. * Platform and account security. Set the security standards for customer accounts on our platforms, including login protection and account\-takeover defense, and work with the engineering teams that own each platform to build them in. * AI and automation security. Set the rules for how AI agents and automations handle credentials, data, and tool permissions, and review high\-risk ones before they go live. * Security tooling and vendors. Own the security stack (SIEM, endpoint protection, email security, identity and device management) and the vendors behind it. Set the device and access standards that IT runs day to day. * Member scam awareness. Supply the security content behind our scam\-awareness messaging to members, working with Community, Support, and Marketing. Legal approves the wording. Scope This role protects our company, our platforms, and our brands. For members' personal wallets and accounts outside our platforms, our role is education: helping members recognize and avoid scams. **Requirements** What you will bring * 5\+ years in security, including at least 2 years leading a security function or serving as senior security personnel at a company of 100\+ people. * Has led live\-incident response, not just tabletop exercises. * Has built or rebuilt a security program from an early stage: policy, tooling, training, and incident response. * Experience in crypto, fintech, or another high\-fraud industry. * Deep, current knowledge of phishing, social engineering, and impersonation attacks and how to defend against them. * Hands\-on experience with SIEM, endpoint protection, email security, and identity and device management platforms. * Can write scripts and automation rather than relying only on vendor UIs. * Writes clear security policy and gets people to follow it. * Briefs executives in plain language and trains non\-technical staff. * Comfortable leading in a fully remote team spread across many time zones. Nice to have * Has prepared a company for SOC 2 or ISO 27001\. * Has run a brand protection or takedown program. * Experience securing or evaluating AI agents and LLM\-based tools. * Experience with customer\-facing security features such as account\-takeover defense. * Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GCIH, OSTH, or OSCP. How we hire Our process ends with every finalist presenting a 90\-day security plan to our Head of Technology: what you would look at first, what you would fix, and how you would measure progress. **Benefits** What We Offer * Competitive compensation package * Independent Contractor opportunity * Fully remote, globally distributed team. * Team offsites * Collaborative, forward\-thinking culture that values innovation and results. If you are ready to take on a challenge that will shape the future of crypto finance and grow with a team of innovators, we want to hear from you!

jobs.title: AI-RAN Deployment Engineer
jobs.description: **Type:** Full\-Time (W2\) On\-Site/Hybrid, Arlington, VA, with travel to customer and test sites as deployments require **Description** DeepSig Inc. is a venture backed and product centric technology startup building revolutionary wireless processing software solutions using cutting edge machine learning techniques to transform baseband processing, wireless sensing, and other key wireless applications. We are seeking an AI\-RAN Deployment Engineer to be the hands\-on engineer between our AI\-RAN products and the customers, partners and test sites that deploy them. This person will take those products out of the lab: integrating them into customer environments, standing them up at field sites, running them through test events and demonstrations, and bringing what they learn back to the engineering team. The role centers on 5G RAN deployment work and builds on a strong radio and SDR background. You should already be comfortable with RF hardware, software\-defined radios and the signal\-level debugging that comes with them. Prior RAN experience is helpful but not required; you will have a team of RAN and ML specialists behind you for the deep details. The day\-to\-day work is hands\-on systems integration, troubleshooting, and optimization. **What You'll Be Doing** * Own customer and partner integrations of DeepSig software end to end: scoping the deployment, configuring radios, timing and networking, installing and configuring the OCUDU stack and dApps, and carrying the system through acceptance * Plan and execute site visits: pre\-visit surveys and bills of material, on\-site installation and bring\-up, over\-the\-air validation, and on\-site support during test events and demonstrations * Bring up and troubleshoot deployed systems across the whole chain, from antennas, cabling and RF front ends through SDR and O\-RU hardware, timing and fronthaul, to the software stack and the dApps running on it * Capture and analyze RF data in the field (IQ recordings, spectrum sweeps, link measurements) to validate performance, debug issues and feed datasets back to the ML team * Reproduce field issues in the lab, isolate them to a subsystem and hand well\-characterized defects to the owning software, RAN or ML engineer * Write and maintain deployment procedures, configuration baselines, site documentation and runbooks so that installs are repeatable and supportable by others * Build and maintain lab test setups and integration benches alongside the lab engineer, including interoperability testing with partner radios, UEs and test equipment * Act as a technical point of contact for customers and partners during integration, translating their requirements and constraints into clear asks for the engineering team * Support product managers and business development with demonstrations, trial deployments and customer feedback on deployability and operability **Requirements** * BS in Electrical/Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent hands\-on experience * 4\+ years deploying, integrating or supporting radio frequency machine learning, software\-defined radio or other RF systems in real environments * Significant hands\-on experience with software\-defined radios (USRP, Epiq, or similar) and the RF hardware around them: antennas, cabling, filters, amplifiers, power and grounding * Comfortable with RF test equipment and measurement: spectrum analyzers, signal generators, power meters, basic link budget and interference analysis * Working knowledge of wireless systems fundamentals, including OFDM, time and frequency synchronization, and the practical effects of RF impairments on a deployed system * Strong Linux skills: networking, drivers, system configuration, log and packet capture; familiar with programming basics and able to read, run and adapt shell and Python scripts (a software engineering background is not required) * Experience with containers (Docker or Kubernetes) sufficient to deploy, configure and debug containerized software in the field * Willing and able to learn 5G NR and O\-RAN deployment on the job: gNB and O\-RU configuration, PTP timing, fronthaul, UE attach and basic performance validation * Methodical troubleshooting approach: able to isolate a problem across hardware, RF, timing, network and software layers and document what was found * Strong communication and teaming skills to work directly with customers and partners and collaborate productively in a small company environment * Able to travel to customer sites, test ranges and partner labs; travel varies with deployment schedules and can peak at 25 percent during installs and test events **Bonus** * Prior experience deploying or operating 5G NR, LTE or O\-RAN systems (srsRAN, OCUDU, OAI, or commercial gNBs), including PTP/SyncE timing chains and eCPRI fronthaul * Familiarity with GNU Radio or similar SDR frameworks and with IQ data capture and analysis workflows * Experience with NVIDIA GPU platforms in deployed systems: driver and container runtime setup, Kubernetes and Helm * Exposure to machine learning for RF (spectrum sensing, signal classification) and to collecting and labeling RF datasets * Field experience with CBRS, private 5G or tactical communications deployments, including spectrum coordination and site RF surveys * Experience with vendor O\-RUs and radio hardware integration (Foxconn, WNC, Eridan or similar) * Python or C\+\+ experience beyond scripting, for building test and automation tooling **Working at DeepSig** DeepSig is growing its technical team while cultivating a collaborative, agile, and fun small\-team culture. We value creativity, knowledge sharing, and employee growth, and we encourage participation in scientific publications, conferences, and open\-source software. We offer competitive salaries and benefits, an employee stock option grant program, an environment where we are excited to be transforming and disrupting how signal processing is done with AI/ML, a welcoming and inclusive environment, a flexible schedule, and a great work / life balance. DeepSig is an equal\-opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability. We are dedicated to cultivating an inclusive, diverse, and engaging workplace where individuals feel fulfilled, inspired, and motivated. We value the unique perspectives that our team brings.

jobs.title: Staff AI/ML Engineer, Data Products & AI
jobs.description: **The Company** Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health. We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing\-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us. **Meet the team:** Our R\&D organization is building the next generation of AI\-powered experiences for people managing their health. As a Staff AI/ML Engineer in the Data Products \& AI group, you set technical direction for production AI/ML systems that span multiple teams and products, owning the full lifecycle from problem framing and model design through evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous optimization. You’ll combine deep expertise in modern AI, including foundation models, generative AI, and predictive modeling, with strong software engineering to turn emerging AI capabilities into reliable, safe, and valuable product features, and you’ll raise the technical bar for the engineers around you. You’ll work at the intersection of research and production, shaping strategy and technical standards across the group while partnering with engineers, product managers, and clinical, regulatory, and commercial stakeholders to ship AI systems at scale. In doing so, you’ll help position Dexcom as an industry leader in health AI and empower millions of customers to take control of their health. **Where you come in:** * You set technical direction for and architect end\-to\-end AI/ML capabilities that span multiple teams and products, from concept and experimental design through production deployment, writing reusable, production\-quality code and reference implementations others build on. * You take on the most complex and ambiguous modeling problems, building and optimizing AI/ML features powered by predictive models or generative AI such as large language models (LLMs), and improving behavior through model selection, prompting, retrieval, feature engineering, fine\-tuning, or retraining. * You define evaluation and safety standards for the group, establishing metrics, benchmarks, and monitoring, anticipating model and system risks, and driving mitigations and responsible\-AI practices across teams. * You shape technical strategy and roadmap, balancing model performance, latency, cost, safety, and regulatory requirements, and connecting technical decisions to commercial and clinical impact. * You raise the engineering bar across the group, improving the training, serving, and CI/CD pipelines and the standards, patterns, and infrastructure that keep AI/ML systems reliable, observable, and cost\-effective at scale. * You partner with and influence cross\-functional stakeholders, including R\&D, Commercial, Product, Legal, and Regulatory, aligning technical direction with company strategy and the highest safety standards. * You mentor and provide technical guidance to other engineers, and communicate complex methods and results clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences, including senior leadership. **What makes you successful:** * You love being on the cutting edge of AI/ML, are eager to learn new technologies as they emerge, and share a passion for Dexcom’s mission and health\-sensing applications. * You have deep, advanced expertise in AI/ML with strong CS fundamentals and extensive hands\-on experience with Python and modern AI/ML libraries and frameworks. * You have a track record of delivering AI/ML systems to production and operating them reliably at scale, including evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and MLOps practices. * You have experience designing scalable, cloud\-based AI/ML solutions and working with large datasets in distributed environments. * You set and uphold strong software engineering and testing standards, applying engineering rigor to AI/ML work and helping others do the same. * You have demonstrated technical leadership and influence beyond your own projects, setting direction, driving alignment, and mentoring other engineers. * You bring a responsible\-AI mindset, attentive to model safety, reliability, and risk in regulated, high\-stakes settings. **What you’ll get:** * A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave \#dexcomwarriors community . * A full and comprehensive benefits program. * Growth opportunities on a global scale. * Access to career development through in\-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement. * An exciting and innovative, industry\-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve. **Travel Required:** 5\-15% * **Experience and Education Requirements:** Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline, and a minimum of 8\-12 years related experience or Master’s degree and 5\-7 years equivalent industry experience or a PhD and 2\-4 years of experience. **Remote Workplace:** Your location will be a home office; you are not required to live within commuting distance of your assigned Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km). *If you reside within commuting distance of a Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km) a hybrid working environment may be available.
