jobs.title: Full-Stack AI Developer
jobs.description: **About Our Company** H.W. Kaufman Group is a powerful global network of companies dedicated to shaping the future of insurance. With thousands of dedicated professionals across an extensive network of over 60 offices around the world, we lead by offering innovative solutions that are at the forefront of the industry. We are privately owned and thus free from the influence of Wall Street. This allows us the ability to adapt to constantly fluctuating market conditions. From brokerage, underwriting, and real estate to claims, loss control and risk management services, our depth of services is unrivaled. **Equal Opportunity Employer** The H.W. Kaufman Group of companies is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, genetic information or any other status or condition protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. In addition, Kaufman will make reasonable accommodations to known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified person with a disability, unless the accommodation would impose an undue hardship on the operation of our business. H.W. Kaufman Group is building an AI Value Engineering capability inside Information Technology to engineer measurable business value across the enterprise. The AI Value Engineering team operates at the intersection of application development, RPA, data, business operations, and AI\-enabled delivery. Its charter is to deliver high\-impact solutions across quick\-strike and deep\-dive engagements, partner closely with business stakeholders, transition proven solutions to sustaining teams, and stop initiatives quickly when they are not proving value. The team is measured on portfolio impact, successful handoffs, quantified business value, disciplined focus, and the ability to avoid becoming a maintenance or production\-support function. This role is for a hands\-on, AI\-enabled developer who can move across applications, automation, data, and business operations to identify high\-impact opportunities, build working solutions, prove their work, and transition responsibly to sustaining teams. We are looking for developers for whom building software is more than a job. Strong candidates are resourceful, curious, disciplined, and energized by solving problems. They have opinions shaped by experience, reading, experimentation, and exposure to good engineering practices. They understand that AI changes the speed of software delivery, but not the need for judgment, craftsmanship, business understanding, and accountability. This role is best suited for a T\-shaped or comb\-shaped technologist: broad enough to wire together platforms, data, APIs, automations, and user workflows; deep enough to make sound technical decisions and avoid fragile solutions. **What Success Looks Like*** Take a loosely defined business problem, clarify the value hypothesis, and produce a working demonstration quickly * Know when an AI agent’s recommendation is plausible, risky, over\-engineered, or misaligned with enterprise supportability * Move comfortably between front\-end, back\-end, integration, data, workflow automation, and platform configuration * Actively look for simpler, faster, more supportable paths rather than merely implementing the first technical answer * Produce solutions that can be handed off cleanly; you do not create hidden dependencies on yourself * Communicate tradeoffs clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences **Responsibilities*** Deliver quick\-strike solutions in days or weeks where business value is clear and the path is known * Contribute to deeper exploratory engagements over one to three months where the solution is uncertain, but the potential value is high * Build prototypes, automations, integrations, data\-driven workflows, and application features across Salesforce, MuleSoft, .NET, RPA, AI/ML tooling, and related enterprise platforms * Use AI development tools such as Claude, Codex, Gemini, Copilot, or similar agents to accelerate delivery while validating architectural fit, maintainability, security, and operational risk * Work directly with underwriting, claims, operations, and IT stakeholders to understand workflows, pain points, value drivers, and practical adoption constraints * Translate business problems into working software, measurable experiments, and clear handoff packages * Document architecture, configuration, dependencies, known limitations, prompts, runbooks, and operational considerations for the receiving team * Recommend pivoting or stopping work when an initiative is not proving valuable, without treating that as failure * Shadow and learn business workflows so solutions are grounded in how work gets done * Professional software development experience in enterprise environments with 5\+ years of experience * Full\-stack capability across application development, integrations, APIs, data access, workflow automation, and user\-facing delivery * Experience with at least several of the following: Salesforce, MuleSoft, .NET/C\#, JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL, REST APIs, RPA/workflow tools, cloud services, CI/CD, or enterprise data platforms * Practical experience using AI\-assisted development tools or a demonstrated ability to adopt them quickly and responsibly * Strong debugging, problem decomposition, and self\-directed learning skills * Ability to evaluate code quality, maintainability, patterns, security implications, and operational fit * Ability to write clear technical documentation and conduct knowledge transfer with receiving teams * Comfort working in timeboxed engagements with defined outcomes, checkpoints, and handoff expectations * Experience in insurance, underwriting, brokerage, claims, or other workflow\-heavy business domains is a plus * Exposure to enterprise architecture patterns, design patterns, domain modeling, relational database design, integration patterns, or similar engineering disciplines * Experience building automations or AI\-enabled solutions that combine applications, data, documents, and human review workflows * Experience with prompt engineering, LLM evaluation, retrieval\-augmented generation, agentic development workflows, or AI governance practices * Ability to operate inside appropriate enterprise guardrails while still challenging assumptions and finding better approaches **Complementary Strengths** Because this team is intentionally built from generalists who can go deep, we value candidates who bring complementary strengths that broaden the team’s overall capability. Experience in any of the following areas is a plus, but not required:* Information security — secure development practices, identity and access management, data protection, secrets management, vulnerability remediation, secure API design, or practical experience partnering with security teams * Azure and cloud services — Azure App Services, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Azure SQL, Storage Accounts, Key Vault, Service Bus, Entra ID, Azure DevOps, or similar cloud\-native services * Infrastructure as Code / DevOps — Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, CI/CD pipelines, environment configuration, deployment automation, observability, or release governance * Enterprise integration — API gateways, MuleSoft, event\-driven integration, message queues, service orchestration, or integration monitoring * AI governance and operationalization — prompt/version management, LLM evaluation, data leakage prevention, human\-in\-the\-loop review, auditability, monitoring, or safe deployment of AI\-assisted workflows \#LI\-CC1

jobs.title: Consulting Application Engineer

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff
jobs.description: **About Harbor** ---------------- Harbor is insurance for the agentic economy. Banks, insurers, hospitals and law firms are handing real decisions to AI agents: approving loans, pricing policies, moving money, advising customers, thousands of times a day. When one gets it wrong, nobody knows who is liable, and insurers are excluding AI from existing policies because there is no claims history to price it. We fix that. Our platform finds every agent a company runs, measures its operational, security and regulatory risk against a framework mapped to NIST AI RMF, SR 26\-2 and the EU AI Act, and blocks the decisions that break the company's rules before they go through. Then we insure the risk that remains, with our own money behind the answer. We emerged from stealth in October 2026 with $10M in seed funding from Base10 Partners, Abstract and 8VC. Our four co\-founders met at Stanford, and the team includes former founders, IMO and IOI medalists, professional athletes and competitive programming champions. We are headquartered in San Francisco with a team across the United States and Europe. What we share is a way of working. Everyone here thinks like a founder, owns outcomes rather than tasks, and moves fast because our customers cannot wait. And we are good people to each other. We would rather pass on a brilliant hire than lose that. **About the role** ------------------ We are hiring Members of Technical Staff across research, product and agents. We use one title because the work is one problem: making AI agents safe enough to insure. You might spend a quarter building the evaluation harness that decides whether a bank's agent gets covered, the next one shipping the runtime that blocks a bad decision before it reaches a customer, and the one after that inside a customer's stack getting their agents onto Harbor. **What you will work on** ------------------------- * Agent discovery: finding every agent a company runs, across clouds, vendors and shadow deployments. * Measurement: evaluations, red\-teaming and risk scoring against our framework, with results that an underwriter can price and a regulator can read. * Mitigation: the runtime controls that stop an agent breaking a rule, at machine speed, without breaking the agent. * The platform itself: the product our customers log into every day, the SDK and integrations their engineers use, and the data that connects all of it. * Forward deployment: working directly with customers in banking and insurance to put their agents on Harbor and learning what the product is missing. **Who we are looking for** -------------------------- * You have built real systems that real people depended on, and you can go three levels deep into how they worked and how they failed. * Strong in at least one of: ML and LLM systems, distributed systems and infrastructure, security, or product engineering with taste. * You have shipped software to production and carried a pager for it. * You are comfortable in a codebase where the spec is a conversation with a customer and the deadline is their launch date. * You want to work on agents from the angle nobody else is taking: not making them smarter, making them insurable. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience with agent frameworks, tool use, evaluations or LLM red\-teaming. * Background in regulated industries, risk, or security. * Competitive programming, research publications, or a company you started. **How we work** --------------- * Founder mentality. Everyone owns a piece of the company, not a job description. If something is broken and nobody owns it, you own it. * Ownership over outcomes. You decide, you ship, you answer for the result. There are no layers between you and the people whose agents we insure. * High pace. We are growing fast and we like it that way. We make decisions in days, ship in weeks, and fix what we got wrong just as quickly. * Good hearts. We are direct and demanding, and we are kind. We help each other win and we tell each other the truth. * We write things down. Decisions, post\-mortems and specs live in documents, not in meetings. * We hold ourselves to the standard we sell. Our own agents run on Harbor. * In person in San Francisco. We think the first years of a company are built in the same room. **What we offer** ----------------- * Competitive salary and meaningful early\-stage equity. * Medical, dental and vision for you and your dependents. * Flexible paid time off, with a real expectation that you take it. * Hardware of your choice and a budget for anything that makes you faster. * Relocation support to San Francisco. **How we hire** --------------- Four steps, two weeks. An intro call with a founder, a working session on a real problem from our roadmap, conversations with the team, and references. We make decisions quickly and tell you where you stand at every step. Harbor is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on the basis of what you can do, and we welcome applicants of every background, nationality and path into the industry. If you need an accommodation during the process, tell us and we will arrange it. Compensation Range: $150K \- $260K

jobs.title: Director, Integration Engineering
jobs.description: **About the Role** ================== Hippocratic AI builds safety\-focused generative AI agents for healthcare: voice agents, care navigation, and patient engagement tools that work alongside clinicians to extend care beyond the hospital walls. Our platform is deeply integrated with health system technology, most centrally Epic, and increasingly Cerner (Oracle Health) and Athenahealth, so our agents can schedule, document, and coordinate care the same way a staff member would. As Director of Integration Engineering, you’ll lead the team responsible for building and operating the technical connections between Hippocratic AI and every EHR and health system environment we work in. You’ll own the production integration and development shop end to end, including architecture, delivery, on\-call reliability, and the engineering practices that keep partner go\-lives on schedule and interfaces running cleanly in production. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Partnerships, and partner\-side IT and interface teams to scope new integrations, keep existing ones healthy, and build a team and a process that scales as Hippocratic AI adds health system partners. You’ll manage engineers across the US and India, and you’ll be the executive point of accountability for integration delivery and production stability. **What You’ll Do** ================== **Lead the integration engineering function** --------------------------------------------- * Own the production integration and development shop for Hippocratic AI’s EHR connectivity, covering Epic (Interconnect, Bridges, App Orchard/Vendor Services APIs), Cerner (Oracle Health), and athenahealth, plus HL7 v2 interface feeds and flat file exchanges with partner health systems. * Set technical direction and delivery standards for the integration team, balancing new partner go\-lives against the stability of integrations already in production. * Lead and grow a distributed engineering team spanning the US and India, including hiring, performance management, on\-call rotation design, and day\-to\-day prioritization across time zones. * Establish engineering practices for code review, branching strategy, release cadence, and incident response, using GitHub and Jira as the backbone for source control, change tracking, and work management. * Set standards for the team’s engineering toolkit (Python\-based data transformation, integration engines such as InterSystems IRIS and Redox, and CI/CD pipelines) and make the build\-vs\-buy calls on when to use each. * Partner with Product and Partnerships to scope new integration work, size effort accurately, and commit to go\-live timelines the team can hit. **Own EHR and interoperability architecture** --------------------------------------------- * Maintain deep technical fluency in Epic’s integration technologies (FHIR/REST APIs, HL7v2 interfaces, Interconnect) and apply the same rigor to Cerner (Oracle Health) and athenahealth integrations as those partnerships grow. * Direct architecture decisions for HL7 v2 messaging, flat file interfaces, and modern API\-based integrations (FHIR/REST), guiding the right method for each partner’s capabilities and constraints alongside the architects. * Guide the team’s use of integration engines (InterSystems IRIS, Redox) and FHIR bulk data workflows, and push toward reusable components and templates that speed up future go\-lives. * Ensure every production interface has monitoring, alerting, and a clear escalation path, and drive root\-cause fixes, not workarounds, when interfaces fail. * Maintain a current, defensible map of every live integration, its data flows, and its dependencies, so the team can answer “what happens if this changes” for any partner on short notice. * Track Epic, Cerner, and athenahealth platform changes (API deprecations, new interoperability mandates, vendor portal requirements) and keep the roadmap ahead of them. **Location and Travel** ======================= We believe the best ideas happen together. To support fast collaboration and a strong team culture, this role is expected to be in our Menlo Park office five days a week. Given the team’s footprint across the US and India, some flexibility for early or late meetings to overlap with the India\-based team is expected, along with periodic travel to partner health systems and occasional overnight or out\-of\-state trips to support go\-lives and escalations. **What You Bring** ------------------ **Must\-Have** -------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Health Informatics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 8\+ years in healthcare integration engineering, with hands\-on experience integrating against Epic (required); Cerner (Oracle Health) and/or athenahealth experience strongly preferred. * 3\+ years managing a production integration and/or software development team, including on\-call ownership for live interfaces. * Deep, working knowledge of HL7 v2 messaging, fla e of Python\-based development and at least one integration engine (InterSystems IRIS), sufficient to review architecture and unblock the team on technical decisions. * Comfort working directly with internal teams as well as partner IT, interface, and clinical informatics teams during scoping, build, and go\-live. **Nice\-to\-Have** ------------------ * Direct experience with Epic’s Show Room, App Orchard/Vendor Services API catalog. * Experience with Cerner Millennium interfaces or athenahealth’s API/partner integration program specifically, not just Epic. * Background standing up or scaling an integration engineering function inside a high\-growth health tech or digital health company. * Familiarity with scheduling APIs, patient engagement platforms, or voice/AI agent architectures in a clinical setting. * Experience with infrastructure and vendor relationships supporting integrations (e.g., telephony, cloud infrastructure, data exchange platforms). * Experience with CI/CD, containerization (Docker), or cloud\-based deployment pipelines for integration workloads. * Background in AI/ML data pipelines or healthcare analytics. * Advanced degree in a technical or health informatics field. **What Success Looks Like** =========================== * Every live Epic, Cerner, and athenahealth integration runs cleanly in production, with monitoring, alerting, and documented escalation paths in place. * New partner integrations go live on committed timelines, with clear, repeatable scoping and delivery processes behind them. * The US and India integration team operates as one team, with clear ownership, consistent on\-call coverage, and strong engineering practices in GitHub and Jira. * Executive leadership has a current, accurate picture of integration health, delivery status, and production risk across every partner. * Hippocratic AI has a reputation among health system partners as a technically rigorous, easy\-to\-integrate\-with vendor. **Why Join Hippocratic AI** --------------------------- **Reinvent healthcare with AI that puts safety first.** We’re building the world’s first healthcare‑only, safety‑focused LLM — a breakthrough platform designed to transform patient outcomes at a global scale. This is category creation. **Work with the people shaping the future.** Hippocratic AI was co‑founded by CEO Munjal Shah and a team of physicians, hospital leaders, AI pioneers, and researchers from institutions like El Camino Health, Johns Hopkins, Washington University in St. Louis, Stanford, Google, Meta, Microsoft, and NVIDIA. **Backed by the world’s leading healthcare and AI investors.** We recently raised a $126M Series C at a $3\.5B valuation, led by Avenir Growth, bringing total funding to $404M with participation from CapitalG, General Catalyst, a16z, Kleiner Perkins, Premji Invest, UHS, Cincinnati Children’s, WellSpan Health, John Doerr, Rick Klausner, and others. **Build alongside the best in healthcare and AI.** Join experts who’ve spent their careers improving care, advancing science, and building world‑changing technologies — ensuring our platform is powerful, trusted, and truly transformative. **Equal Opportunity** --------------------- Hippocratic AI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a team that reflects the patients we serve. We actively encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. If you require accommodations during the hiring process, please contact people@hippocraticai.com. ***Please be aware of recruitment scams impersonating Hippocratic AI. All recruiting communication will come from @******hippocraticai.com*** ***email addresses. We will never request payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.***

Reporting directly to the Chief Product \& Data Officer, this executive leader will be responsible for defining and executing the micro frontend (MFE) strategy that unifies complex media workflows—from planning and buying to optimization and analytics—into a cohesive, composable digital experience. Advanced degree (e.g., M.S., Ph.D.) or MBA is a plus. **What We Offer:** * The opportunity to lead a transformative technology initiative in a fast\-paced innovation\-driven environment. * A collaborative and supportive team culture focused on professional growth and continuous learning. * Competitive compensation, benefits, and opportunities for advancement) strategy that unifies complex media workflows—from planning and buying to optimization and analytics—into a cohesive, composable digital experience. jobs.title: Associate Director, AI Enablement
jobs.description: **Become a part of our caring community** ========================================= At Humana, we are on a mission to provide an exceptional experience for our community of developers, testers, product owners, and business partners that deliver software products for our members. We believe that happy and productive delivery teams create essential features that enhance our members' well\-being and overall experience with our Humana products. As the Associate Director of AI Enablement in the Enterprise Engineering Enablement organization, you will play a crucial role in building Humana's Agentic Development Lifecycle (ADLC) — an AI\-native software delivery platform program with four dedicated tracks, a published governance framework, and hard targets for reuse, uptime, cost, and regulatory defensibility in a HIPAA\-regulated environment. The ideal candidate for this role will need to have a unique mix of leadership experience, proficiency with applying modern Agile, Engineering, and DevOps practices to enable software delivery, strong public speaking skills, and be exceptional at leading people through change. You will need to have the skillset to apply your software delivery expertise to an entire IT organization, be the catalyst for an enterprise\-wide organizational change effort, and simultaneously ensure smooth product and platform engineering delivery for your own teams responsibilities. Finally, you will need to have a passion for enablement, coaching, and teaching in order to assist agile and operations teams with adopting new technologies and new ways of working using GAI. **Use your skills to make an impact** ===================================== **Required:** ------------- * **15\+ years** in software engineering, with **5\+ years leading engineering managers, leads, or DevOps Services, GitHub, SonarQube, Artifactory, TFE or their industry standard equivalents. * You have experience with cloud technologies, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Kubernetes, and emerging DevOps trends like 'GitOps' combined with 'pull' based deployment technologies like Argo and Terraform Enterprise (TFE). * You have a deep understanding of large language models, including how they feedback to your direct reports in order to promote team member growth and maturity. * You value work/life balance and enable a positive team culture that people want to be a part of. * You are a strong communicator, a connector, and enjoy a highly agile work environment. jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: **BUILT DIFFERENT** We believe there's a better way to build. One that moves faster, thinks bigger, and gives people the ownership to challenge what's been done before. We're not here to follow the standard. We're here to set a new one. We don't believe the best work happens inside rigid boxes. People are given real ownership, real responsibility, and the space to operate beyond a title. Scope grows with impact. Responsibility grows with trust. And the people who step up help shape what comes next. We're building an organization around ownership, not hierarchy, where your influence is defined by what you take on, not what's written on your email signature. **ABOUT THE ROLE** The infrastructure is ambitious. The people behind it should be too. We need a Mechanical Engineer who thinks from first principles, questions convention, and wants the weight of owning the outcome. Someone who can design it, stand behind it, solve for it in the field, and build the runway as they go. **WHAT YOU'LL OWN** \+ Design it: Own mechanical system design end\-to\-end: chilled\-water plants, air\-cooled and direct\-liquid\-cooling (DLC) systems, piping, and fire protection. \+ Stamp it: Take professional responsibility for calculations, drawings, and specifications as Engineer of Record, not a reviewer of someone else's work, the author of it. \+ Build it: Stay close to construction and commissioning, catch conflicts before they become delays, and sign off only when it's actually right. \+ Challenge it: Push on cost, constructability, and third\-party engineering deliverables without cutting the corners that matter. **WHAT YOU BRING** \+ Active Professional Engineer (PE) license. \+ 7\+ years designing mechanical systems for data centers, industrial, or other mission\-critical facilities. \+ Working knowledge of IMC, IPC, IECC, NFPA 13, ASME B31, and ASHRAE TC 9\.9, backed by hands\-on experience with chilled\-water plants and liquid\-cooling architectures. \+ Comfortable reading and redlining P\&IDs, single\-line diagrams, and construction documents without help. \+ Experience working directly with contractors, vendors, and construction teams through commissioning. **BUILT FOR THIS** If you are mission\-driven, ownership\-minded, drawn to hard problems, willing to challenge convention, and ready to build the playbook. If you aren't waiting for every answer, looking for layers of approval, leading from a distance, attached to "the way it's always been done," or looking for just another role. **BONUS POINTS** \+ 10\+ years and multi\-site U.S. data center delivery experience. \+ CFD or thermal\-hydraulic modeling (AFT Fathom, ANSYS, or similar). \+ Background at a company that self\-performs its own builds rather than relying on a GC. \+ Experience integrating with BAS/controls systems. *"People are our greatest differentiator: an environment where high performers thrive, where collaboration drives impact, and where careers are shaped by opportunity, not hierarchy."* Asher Genoot, Architect

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description: **Summary** ----------- **The Opportunity** Hyatt Hotels Corporation seeks an experienced Senior Data Engineer who will be an exceptional addition to our growing engineering team. The Senior Data Engineer will work closely with engineering, product managers and data science teams to meet data requirements of various initiatives in Hyatt. As a Senior Data Engineer, you will take on big data challenges in an agile way. In this role, you will build data pipelines that enable engineers, analysts and other stakeholders across the organization. You will build data models to deliver insightful analytics while ensuring the highest standard in data integrity. You will integrate different data sources, improve the efficiency, reliability, and latency of our data system, help automate data pipelines, and improve our data model and overall architecture. You will be leading multiple data projects with planned and coordinated execution and on\-time delivery of quality products. You will be part of a highly visible, collaborative and passionate data engineering team and will be working on all the aspects of design, development and implementation of scalable and reliable data products and pipelines. Applying the latest techniques and approaches across the domains of data engineering, and machine learning engineering isn’t just a nice to have, it’s a must. This candidate builds fantastic relationships across all levels of the organization and is recognized as a problem solver who looks to elevate the work of everyone around them. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest\-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues. As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers. **Why Now?** This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception. **How We Care for Our People** What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious *100 Best Companies to Work For®* list since 2013\. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong. We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include: * Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally * Flexible work schedule * Work\-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on\-site fitness center * A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption * Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match **Who You Are** As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results\-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally. **The Role** **Overview** The Senior Data Engineer designs, develops, and supports scalable data products, platforms, and pipelines that enable operational reporting, business intelligence, self\-service analytics, and advanced AI capabilities. This role partners with cross\-functional teams to translate business needs into reliable, high\-quality technical solutions while providing operational leadership and solving complex data\-engineering challenges. **Key Responsibilities** * Partner with product managers, data scientists, machine\-learning teams, business stewards, engineering teams, and program management to define product features, business deliverables, and data\-product strategies. * Collaborate with business partners, operations teams, and senior management to provide day\-to\-day opera rship, curiosity, collaboration, and a commitment to delivering practical business outcomes. The candidate also reflects Hyatt’s core values of **respect, integrity, humility, empathy, creativity, and fun** in every aspect of their work. **Qualifications** ------------------ **Experience Required** * 5 to 8\+ years of experience within the field of data engineering or related technical work including business intelligence, analytics * Experience and comfort solving problems in an ambiguous environment where there is constant change. Have the tenacity to thrive in a dynamic and fast\-paced environment, inspire change, and collaborate with a variety of individuals and organizational partners * Experience designing and building scalable and robust data pipelines to enable data\-driven decisions for the business * Very good understanding of the full software development life cycle * Very good understanding of Data warehousing concepts and approaches * Experience in building Data pipelines and ETL approaches * Experience in building Data warehouse and Business intelligence projects * Hands\-on experience in AWS cloud and AWS native technologies such as Glue, Lambda, Kinesis, Lake Formation, S3, Redshift * Experience using Spark EMR, RDS, EC2, Athena, API capabilities, CloudWatch, CloudTrail is a plus * Experience with Business Intelligence tools like Tableau, Power BI, and ThoughtSpot. * Hands\-on experience building complex business logics and ETL workflows using Informatica IICS Alteryx. * Experience in one of the scripting languages: Python or Unix Scripting * Proficient in SQL, PL/SQL, Cloud warehouse (Snowflake), relational databases (RDBMS), database concepts and dimensional modeling. * Strong experience using Snowflake native pipelines, Snowflake native app including Streamlet, Python based Container services. * Experience using AI, including Snowflake Cortex AI capabilities. * Good knowledge in application and backend API development using Python or Java or Go, TypeScript/JavaScript). * Strong verbal and written communication skills * Demonstrate integrity and maturity, and a constructive approach to challenges * Demonstrate analytical and problem\-solving skills, particularly those that apply to Data Warehouse and Big Data environments * Open minded, solution oriented and a very good team player * Passionate about programming and learning new technologies; focused on helping yourself and the team improve skills * Ability to manage multiple projects and report simultaneously across different stakeholders * Rigorous attention to detail and accuracy of the data, process, requirements. **Experience Preferred:** * Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Finance, or a related quantitative field * Professional certifications in AWS, Snowflake * Experience with Hospitality is also preferred The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all\-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary. **We welcome you:** Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. jobs.title: Go-To-Market Engineer
jobs.description: About Improvado --------------- Improvado is an AI\-powered marketing data platform built for mid\-market and enterprise teams. We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI. Brands like Genentech, T\-Mobile, Activision, and H\&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance. We’re a fast\-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high\-quality execution. About the role -------------- Improvado is hiring a Go\-to\-Market Engineer to build and run the engine that generates sales pipeline, then step into deals to help close them. You report directly to the VP of Sales. This is a team\-of\-one role with no SDR layer behind you. You own outbound cadences, the data and tooling stack, and event follow\-up. You work directly with the VP of Sales to design and run go\-to\-market experiments, on Improvado wherever possible, and you work alongside the demand generation team so outbound and advertising hit the same accounts and people. You identify which current customers to expand and with which products. And you are forward deployed: embedded with prospects and customers, building working use cases in their environment, and packaging the experiments that worked in\-house into outcome\-based projects Improvado sells. It is a hybrid of growth operator, forward deployed builder, and revenue strategist. The long\-term path is to become an Improvado expert who builds agentic go\-to\-market loops with the platform at their core, first for us, then for our customers. If you have only done one of those jobs, this is not the role. If you have done two and are hungry for the rest, keep reading. What you'll do -------------- Outbound pipeline generation * Design, build, and run multi\-channel outbound cadences (email, LinkedIn, phone) targeting enterprise marketing and data leaders and agency executives. * Write and continuously test messaging, subject lines, and personalization at scale, including AI\-assisted personalization. * Own deliverability, sending infrastructure, and domain health. Sales and marketing alignment * Work with the demand generation team so outbound and advertising target the same accounts, personas, and buying committees, with one shared target account list. * Build the operating rhythm between sales and marketing: shared definitions, a common view of account engagement, and a feedback loop from deals back into campaigns. * Partner with marketing on content and offers; own the sourced\-pipeline number on the outbound side. Go\-to\-market experimentation with the VP of Sales * Design and run go\-to\-market experiments with the VP of Sales: messaging by buyer persona, channels, offers, signals, and workflows, each with a hypothesis, a measurement, and a scale\-or\-kill decision. * Run them on Improvado wherever possible, so our own go\-to\-market is the lab for what we sell. * Maintain a messaging playbook per persona that outbound, advertising, and account executives all draw from, and share results with marketing on a regular cadence. Customer expansion * Analyze the customer base to identify which accounts we should be upselling and which Improvado products fit each. * Build expansion plays with Customer Success and account executives, and run the outbound layer of those plays. Tooling and data * Own the go\-to\-market tech stack: sequencing, enrichment, intent data, CRM hygiene, and the integrations between them. * Build and maintain target account lists and contact data with enrichment waterfalls and signal\-based triggers. * Automate the repetitive parts of prospecting so one person operates like a team. Event follow\-up * Run pre\-event targeting and outreach for conferences and field events. * Convert attendees, booth visitors, and scanned leads into qualified meetings within days, not weeks. Forward deployed with prospects and customers * Learn the Improvado platform deeply: connectors, data models, the AI agent, and dashboards. * Embed with prospects and customers on active opportunities and expansions to build working go\-to\-market and marketing\-data use cases in their environment. Ship something they use, not a demo. * Carry what you learn in customer environments back into our own experiments, outbound targeting, and messaging. Package and sell what works * Turn successful in\-house experiments into packaged, outcome\-based projects that Improvado sells to customers: the outcome, the data required, the build, and the delivery path. * Help account executives position and scope those projects as part of the Improvado offer, and deliver the first ones yourself. Measurement * Track pipeline sourced and influenced by channel, cost per qualified meeting, and conversion through each stage. * Report daily to the VP of Sales and kill what is not working quickly. Who you are ----------- * 4 or more years in a pipeline\-generating or growth role at a B2B SaaS company: outbound, demand generation, growth, revenue operations, or forward deployed / implementation work, ideally more than one of these. * You have personally built outbound cadences that booked meetings with enterprise buyers, and you can show the numbers. * You have designed and run structured go\-to\-market experiments with a clear hypothesis and measurement, and you can tell the story of one that worked and one you killed. * You have taken something that worked internally and turned it into something a customer paid for. * You have worked across the sales and marketing boundary and know what it takes to get both teams targeting the same accounts. * Technical enough to work with APIs, webhooks, SQL, and data pipelines, and to build on a data platform inside a customer's environment. * Fluent with AI tools for research, personalization, and automation, and interested in building agents, not just using them. * Comfortable being a team of one: you set your own priorities, build your own systems, and do not wait for an SDR or an ops team. * Strong writer. Your emails get replies. * Curious about marketing data and analytics: you want to understand how a CMO measures performance, not just who to email. Nice to have ------------ * Experience selling or marketing to agencies or enterprise marketing teams. * Background in marketing analytics, ETL, data warehousing, or business intelligence. * Forward\-deployed, implementation, or professional services experience at a data or AI company. * Experience with customer expansion or account\-based programs. * Hands\-on experience building AI agents or automated workflows with LLMs. * Experience running pre\- and post\-event programs for conferences. * Early\-stage startup experience, Series A to C. ### **What We Offer** * Remote\-first environment * Competitive compensation * Medical and dental benefits * 401K plan * Unlimited PTO * Paid holidays * Professional development reimbursement mTPFnDuhw0

jobs.title: Principal Engineer - Founding Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ Intuit Enterprise Suite is how the world's fastest\-growing mid\-market and enterprise finance teams run their books, close their quarter, and put AI agents to work on real accounting operations — not demos. Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) are the team that makes that real: embedded with our customers, shipping production automation, and turning "AI pilot" into "AI in the general ledger." FDEs win the last mile, one customer at a time. This role exists because the last mile only compounds into a platform if someone is holding the line across all of it at once. As Principal Engineer for Forward Deploy, you are the technical throughline between three groups that each see a different slice of the problem: the Enterprise Accountant Suite organization, which owns the core agent platform FDEs build on; Product Engineering, which needs structured, credible signal instead of anecdotes; and the FDE team itself, which needs someone who can walk into the hardest customer\-specific architecture problem and actually solve it. You are an individual contributor. You do not manage the FDE engineers — that's the Forward Deploy engineering management line. You lead through the quality of what you build, the standards you set, and the trust you earn from engineers more senior than you've managed and executives more senior than you report to. You'll be judged on whether FDE's output, across every pod and every engagement, started looking like one coherent technical practice instead of forty unrelated unit\-of\-one builds. **Responsibilities** ### **Set the technical standards every FDE engagement builds against** * Define the reusable architecture patterns, integration standards, and agent\-platform guardrails that every FDE pod builds on — so a solution shipped for one customer is a pattern reused for the next, not a one\-off nobody can maintain. * Own the technical review bar for what ships into a customer's production environment: what counts as production\-ready, what requires a security or compliance sign\-off, and what gets rejected back to the drawing board. * Partner with Enterprise Accountant Suite engineering leadership to keep FDE's customer\-specific work and the core platform's roadmap pointed in the same direction — FDE builds the last mile, Enterprise Accountant Suite owns the platform underneath it, and your job is making sure neither side is surprised by what the other is building. ### **Be the technical escalation point for the hardest problems in the field** * When a pod or a Staff FDE hits something genuinely hard — an architecture decision with no clean answer, a platform limitation standing between a customer and a signed deal, a production incident nobody else can diagnose — you're who gets pulled in. * Get hands\-on when it matters: review and write code, review integration architecture, and work a live customer escalation directly when the stakes or the technical depth require it. * Travel to customer sites as needed (up to 30\-40%) for the engagements where your technical depth is what unblocks the deal or the deployment — not as a standing presence on every pod, but as the person who shows up when it's genuinely load\-bearing. ### **Own the ROI and business\-case discipline across the team** * FDE's credibility with CFOs and Controllers rests on a defensible, consistent ROI case — not a different pitch from every pod. You own the framework: how we quantify the value of an automation, how we validate it against a customer's actual numbers, and how we hold every engagement to the same bar of proof. * Coach Staff FDEs and pod leads on building and defending that case in the room with economic buyers, so the discipline scales with the team rather than living only in your own deals. ### **Own the roadmap feedback loop into Product Engineering** * Voice\-of\-Customer from the field is only useful if it's structured enough for Product Engineering to act on. You own turning the patterns that show up across multiple customers — the integration nobody has, the agent behavior every pod has to work around — into a credible, prioritized input to the core roadmap. * Be the senior technical counterpart Product Engineering trusts to separate "every customer needs this" from "one customer asked for this" — so FDE's signal sharpens the roadmap instead of generating noise it has to filter. * This is an input to Product Engineering's roadmap, never a substitute for it. You don't re\-architect the core platform, and you don't let FDE become a shadow path around Product Engineering's own prioritization. ### **Build the playbook that makes the next engagement faster** * Turn what you learn solving the hardest problems into implementation guides, architecture references, and reusable assets — the difference between FDE staying a collection of heroics and becoming a repeatable practice as it scales from a handful of engagements to the full target cohort. * Partner with FDE leadership on what has t oss engagements rather than relayed deal by deal. Product Engineering should be able to trust what reaches them through you as validated, cross\-customer signal — not anecdote.**Your partnership with FDE.** You are not these engineers' manager, but you are the person they escalate to when the problem is genuinely hard, and the person whose architecture decisions and review standards shape how every pod builds. Staff and Senior FDEs should see you as the technical ceiling they're growing toward, not a separate track they rarely interact with. **Qualifications** ### **Required** * 10\+ years in a hands\-on, customer\-embedded engineering role — Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, technical consulting, or equivalent — with demonstrated progression into a technical leadership or principal\-level scope, not just increasing deal size. * Deep, hands\-on experience with agentic AI systems: LangChain, LangGraph, MCP servers, multi\-agent orchestration, RAG, vector stores, hybrid retrieval — enough to set the architecture standard other engineers build against, not just use the tools yourself. * Experience with LLMs and tooling: OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic; GitHub Copilot, Gemini Code Assist; prompt engineering at a level where you can review and improve someone else's agent design, not only build your own. * Deep experience with REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, SQL, and enterprise integrations, including the judgment to say no to an integration pattern that won't hold up across multiple customers. * A track record of being the technical escalation point across multiple simultaneous engagements — not just delivering your own, but unblocking others' — under real delivery and revenue pressure. * Demonstrated ability to build and defend a quantified ROI case directly to CFOs, Controllers, or equivalent economic buyers, and to coach others to do the same. * Experience translating field\-level technical signal into a structured input a product organization actually prioritizes — not just raising issues, but making the case for why they matter at scale. * Strong technical fluency and the standing to operate as a peer with Principal and Staff engineers in Product Engineering, not as a field representative asking for favors. * You default to automation — you use AI and modern tooling to move faster, document better, and scale your own impact and the team's. ### **Preferred** * Background in high\-growth SaaS, applied AI, or fintech/ERP/accounting\-adjacent domains. * Domain experience in one of our priority verticals — construction (job costing, WIP, retainage), nonprofit (fund accounting, grant and donor compliance), manufacturing (inventory, cost accounting, production workflows), wealth management (client billing, compliance/regulatory reporting, investment accounting), health care (revenue cycle, compliance\-heavy financial operations), franchise (zee governance, zor performance), or field services (job/work\-order costing, scheduling\-linked billing). * Prior experience setting technical standards or an architecture review bar for a distributed team of embedded or field engineers, rather than only for your own deployments. * Non\-traditional paths are a plus: veterans, former management consultants, competitive programmers, and PhDs have historically made excellent FDEs — and excellent technical leaders within the function. jobs.title: Senior Data Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Collections today works like an emergency room. The doctors carry too many patients, everyone arrives at their worst moment, and nobody has their chart. We're making it primary care. January personalizes interactions and optimizes decisions across every stage of consumer credit. We started in the hardest, most broken stage, because if it works there it works anywhere. Most consumers want to pay what they owe. They want a way out, not a break. We've serviced over $20 billion in debt across more than 20 million consumers. We see more people with charged\-off loans each year than all but the top five US banks. Those consumers rate us about 50% higher than the banks that lent them the money. Creditors net over 30% more because we collect more and charge less. Most AI strips the human out of the work. We use it to make someone's hardest financial moment more human. The more human we make it, the more people recover. Now we're moving upstream, catching people before they default and building across every stage of the consumer credit lifecycle. The consumer in collections today is the consumer who gets approved tomorrow. As our first Data Systems Engineer, you'll own the foundation under every decision we make: what data lands, what our reports say, and what we offer to consumers. When the data is right, someone in their hardest financial moment gets an offer that fits their life. When it's wrong, they get the wrong balance, the wrong call, or nothing at all. **About the Role** ------------------ We're hiring our first data systems engineer. Data is the most valuable thing January has: 20 million consumers, $20 billion in debt, and every record behind them. Every decision we make about a consumer starts with our data. As we grow our business, it’s critical that our data system scales with it. The data that powers collections now has to power every stage of consumer credit. You'll decide what that foundation looks like and how it grows. This is a blank page. What gets built, in what order, and how this function interacts with downstream consumers is yours to decide. You'll set the standard for how we treat our data: trusted by default, understood by everyone who touches it, and increasingly able to look after itself. Engineers, analysts, ops, and product all depend on what you build. You'll set the standards that let them make good calls on data without you in the room. You thrive on obsessing over data quality and infrastructure, and you move fast to improve both. **What We Need** ---------------- * You've built and owned a data pipeline end to end. * You design for failure. Safe replayability, recovery that self heals where possible and has a clear runbook when it doesn’t * You treat data quality as a key indicator of pipeline health * You can own migrating a legacy system into a durable data pipeline by identifying the highest impact opportunities first, and you know when to build vs. buy. * You've collaborated with multiple stakeholders/data consumers, with an ability to manage asks and hold boundaries where they need to be held * You draw ownership lines through writing and influence instead of authority, and explain tradeoffs equally well to engineers and non\-engineers. * You already use AI deeply in your own work and want to go further, including by architecting systems that repair themselves. * You love building 0 to 1, and you want the shape of a function to be yours. * 4\+ years in software engineering, data engineering or data platforms. **How We Work** --------------- * **Decentralization beats control.** The best calls get made by the people closest to them, not routed up a chain. You'll set the standards that let the team decide without you in the room. * **Speed beats perfection.** You run tight loops, act at 70% on reversible calls and adjust as you learn. Fast loops beat slow ones. * **Candor beats comfort.** You'd rather hear a hard truth early than a polite sidestep that wastes everyone's time. * **Writing beats the average meeting.** Clarity scales. * **AI runs through everything here.** We built our own code reviewer that beats the alternatives. Our voice AI handles most inbound calls with zero hallucinated payments. Engineers ship 3\-4x the PRs they used to. You'll push it further into the work than almost any company you've worked at. * **We operate at every altitude.** No one here lives only on Mount Olympus, not even the leaders. We get into the trenches to learn the ground truth, then refine our information flows so ground truth climbs as fast as direction comes down. * **We build in person, at least three days a week in our office in Nolita**, with a growing group coming in every day. Random run\-ins cross\-pollinate ideas. Face time builds trust no thread can. Building alongside people makes work far more fun. **We are currently hiring for this position in our New York office.** As a New York City\-based company, we are dedicated to transparent, fair, and equitable compensation practices that reflect our commitment to fostering an environment where all team members are valued and supported. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, age, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Compensation Range: $199,915 \- $231,331

equipment and operational data into actionable insights. * Create intuitive user experiences and modern web applications that simplify troubleshooting and equipment diagnostics. * Collaborate across software, systems, hardware, data science, and product engineering teams to deliver end\-to\-end solutions. * Deploy and support solutions operating in highly secure, customer\-controlled semiconductor manufacturing environments. * Drive software design, code quality, testing, and continuous improvement initiatives across the platform. **Qualifications Required:** * BS or MS in applications. * Strong programming skills in Python and at least one object\-oriented language such as Java, C\+\+, or C\#. * Experience developing scalable backend services, APIs, databases, and distributed software systems. * Experience working with hardware\-integrated software systems, industrial equipment, manufacturing systems, instrumentation, embedded interfaces, controls software, telemetry systems, or IoT platforms. * Experience building data\-intensive applications using SQL, NoSQL, streaming platforms, or large\-scale data processing technologies. * Familiarity with cloud\-native development, CI/CD pipelines, source control, automated testing, and modern software engineering practices. * Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to work across multidisciplinary engineering teams. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with semiconductor equipment, manufacturing systems, inspection systems, industrial automation, robotics, or scientific jobs.title: VDC Coordinator
jobs.description: **VDC Coordinator** =================== **Company** ----------- Kunz is a model\-based design and engineering firm focused on improving how complex, mission\-critical facilities are designed and delivered. We work at the intersection of engineering, product development, digital design, and construction to create repeatable solutions for large\-scale infrastructure programs. Our teams work on complex technical challenges where design information must move reliably across disciplines and from engineering through construction. By combining deep technical expertise with model\-based workflows, we help improve the quality, consistency, and scalability of project delivery. **Location** ------------ San Francisco, California or Golden, Colorado **Job Description** ------------------- Kunz is expanding its BIM/VDC team to support global hyperscale data center programs. We are seeking technically driven professionals who want to apply their expertise to complex building systems, solve multidisciplinary design challenges, and advance how model\-based information moves from engineering into construction. The work extends beyond individual projects. Models, content, and workflows developed here support repeatable building systems deployed across a broader infrastructure program. This is an opportunity to influence both the technical deliverables and the methods used to produce them at scale. We welcome BIM/VDC practitioners and experienced technical specialists from architecture, engineering, construction, and design technology. Previous data center experience is valuable, but not required. Working across engineering, product architecture, VDC, and construction, you will help turn complex design and product information into coordinated, reusable digital deliverables. The role combines hands\-on Revit development, multidisciplinary coordination, model quality, and the improvement of digital delivery workflows. Assignments may include developing configurable Revit content, integrating manufacturer equipment models, resolving interfaces between building systems, or establishing the information standards that make models reliable for downstream teams. You will work directly with engineers, vendors, A/E partners, construction teams, and owner stakeholders to address technical challenges and move deliverables forward. Opportunities are available across multiple experience levels. Experienced candidates can take greater ownership of technical scopes, contribute to program standards, and mentor colleagues while remaining closely involved in the technical work. At Kunz, the opportunity is to do more than deliver the next model. It is to help establish how complex design information is structured, coordinated, and used across an infrastructure program. For professionals who want to deepen their technical expertise and influence how projects are delivered, this role offers both hands\-on work and a broader field of impact. **Primary Responsibilities** ---------------------------- * Develop and maintain Revit models, families, structured parameters, and reusable content that support coordinated building systems and consistent deployment across projects. * Translate engineering and manufacturer information into usable BIM deliverables, including support for MCAD\-to\-BIM workflows and configurable product models. * Coordinate interfaces between disciplines, equipment, and building systems, working with project partners to resolve technical issues and communicate design changes. * Review models for geometric accuracy, data quality, completeness, and readiness for downstream design and construction use. * Maintain Autodesk Construction Cloud environments, model structures, information exchanges, and issue workflows. * Plan, track, and deliver assigned BIM/VDC scopes, identifying dependencies and communicating decisions, priorities, and outstanding issues. * Improve templates, standards, and quality\-control methods to make digital delivery more reliable and repeatable. **Minimum Requirements** ------------------------ * Bachelor's degree in architecture, engineering, construction management, design technology, or a related field. * Minimum of 2 years of professional experience in BIM, VDC, architectural or engineering design, design technology, or model\-based project delivery. * Professional experience using Autodesk Revit for building design, engineering, construction, or BIM/VDC applications. * Professional experience developing or maintaining Revit models, families, parameters, schedules, or other model content. **Desired Qualifications** -------------------------- * Strong hands\-on Revit skills, with demonstrated capability in model development, families, parameters, schedules, or model organization. * Experience with Autodesk Construction Cloud, Navisworks, or comparable coordination tools. * Ability to interpret engineering drawings, product information, and construction documents, with a practical understanding of how building systems fit together. * Clear technical communication, sound judgment, and the ability to manage priorities and take responsibility for deliverables. * Experience with hyperscale data centers, mission\-critical facilities, or other complex commercial, industrial, or institutional projects. * Experience with modular or configurable building systems or product\-based design. * Experience with MCAD\-to\-BIM workflows, manufacturer equipment models, or configurable product models. * For senior\-level consideration, demonstrated ownership of complex technical scopes, experience improving standards or workflows, and the ability to guide others through coordination and delivery challenges. Candidates are not expected to bring expertise in every area. We are building a team with complementary strengths in model development, coordination, information quality, and digital delivery. **Position Details** -------------------- This is a full\-time position based in either San Francisco, California or Golden, Colorado. Opportunities are available at the VDC Coordinator Level 2 and Level 3, with the position level determined based on the candidate's experience, technical background, and scope of responsibility. **Benefits** ------------ Kunz offers a comprehensive benefits package, including: * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) with company match * Paid time off * Paid company holidays * Annual performance\-based bonus eligibility **Compensation** ---------------- Kunz is hiring for VDC Coordinator Level 2 and Level 3 positions. The level offered will be based on the candidate's experience and technical background. The anticipated base salary ranges for the positions covered by this posting vary by work location: * San Francisco, California: $80,000 to $140,000 annually * Golden, Colorado: $70,000 to $115,000 annually Individual compensation will be based on position level, work location, relevant experience, skills, technical background, and internal equity. Employees may also be eligible for an annual performance\-based bonus. **Work Authorization** ---------------------- Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. Kunz is unable to provide employment visa sponsorship for this position.

jobs.description: Overview: Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. The goal of the role is to ensure that the R\&D laboratory environments and equipment remain operational, reliable, and available for R\&D development and testing activities. jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure Security Engineer – AI/GPU Cluster
jobs.description: **Job Summary** We are looking for an experienced Infrastructure Security Engineer to design, implement, and maintain security controls for a large\-scale AI/GPU computing cluster. This role will work closely with infrastructure, network, storage, platform, and operations teams to protect the cluster environment across compute nodes, Kubernetes workloads, network infrastructure, storage systems, and management platforms. The ideal candidate has hands\-on experience securing large\-scale Linux and cloud\-native infrastructure, with strong knowledge of Kubernetes security, network security, identity and access management, vulnerability management, and security automation. **Key Responsibilities** * Design and implement security architecture for large\-scale AI/GPU cluster infrastructure. * Secure Linux\-based compute nodes, management servers, and supporting infrastructure. * Implement Kubernetes and container security controls, including RBAC, network policies, secrets management, workload isolation, image security, and runtime protection. * Design and maintain network security controls, including firewall policies, ACLs, network segmentation, VPN, IDS/IPS, and secure management networks. * Establish identity and access management policies, including RBAC, MFA, service accounts, privileged access, and least\-privilege controls. * Perform vulnerability scanning, security assessment, CVE management, patch coordination, and configuration hardening. * Build monitoring, logging, alerting, and security incident detection capabilities across the cluster environment. * Support security incident investigation, root cause analysis, remediation, and post\-incident improvements. * Develop security automation using scripting and Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools. * Collaborate with networking, storage, SRE, DevOps, platform, and data center operations teams to integrate security into infrastructure design and deployment. * Define and maintain security standards, hardening guidelines, operational procedures, and security documentation. * Continuously evaluate emerging threats and security risks related to AI infrastructure, GPU clusters, distributed systems, and cloud\-native environments. **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years of experience in infrastructure security, cloud security, platform security, network security, or a related field. * Strong Linux system administration and Linux security experience. * Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes and container security. * Strong understanding of network security concepts, including firewalls, ACLs, VLANs, routing, network segmentation, and secure remote access. * Experience with IAM, RBAC, MFA, privileged access management, and secrets management. * Experience with vulnerability management, patching, system hardening, and security baselines. * Experience with security monitoring, logging, SIEM, IDS/IPS, or endpoint/runtime security solutions. * Familiarity with Python, Bash, Ansible, Terraform, or similar automation tools. * Strong understanding of security principles such as least privilege, Zero Trust, defense\-in\-depth, and secure\-by\-design infrastructure. * Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to work across multiple infrastructure teams. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience securing HPC, AI, GPU, or large\-scale distributed computing environments. * Experience with NVIDIA DGX or similar GPU computing platforms. * Familiarity with InfiniBand, RoCE, RDMA, or high\-performance networking. * Experience with multi\-tenant cluster security and workload isolation. * Familiarity with security tools such as HashiCorp Vault, Falco, Trivy, Aqua, Prisma Cloud, CrowdStrike, Splunk, Elastic, or similar technologies. * Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. * Knowledge of security compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, or CIS benchmarks. * Security certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, OSCP, CKS, or equivalent are a plus. **Technical Keywords** Linux Security, Kubernetes Security, Container Security, Infrastructure Security, Platform Security, Network Security, IAM, RBAC, Zero Trust, Vulnerability Management, SIEM, IDS/IPS, DevSecOps, Terraform, Ansible, Python, GPU Cluster, HPC, InfiniBand, RoCE, RDMA, NVIDIA DGX Pay: From $77,800\.00 per year Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II - Agentic Platform
jobs.description: **ABOUT LVT** LVT is redefining how businesses operate in the physical world, moving beyond traditional security solutions to deliver AI\-driven, actionable intelligence that makes sites smarter, safer, and more secure. Since pioneering our first mobile, solar\-powered units, our commitment to scrappy, hands\-on innovation has made us an established leader and one of the fastest\-growing companies in intelligent site technology. We are building the next generation of solutions—from our physical units in the field to a powerful Agentic AI platform—that allows our customers to gain unprecedented visibility and control over safety, compliance, and operations. This is your chance to join a cutting\-edge team that isn't just watching the world change, but actively building the technology that is changing it. We’re a team that’s focused on growth and innovation, and we’re proud that our crew, products, and leadership are being recognized for it. * **A Top\-Tier Growth Company:** Named one of the *Financial Times’ Fastest Growing Companies 2025* and *\#10 on the Inc. 5000 Rocky Mountain Regional* list for 2025\. * **Innovative Leadership:** Our CEO, Ryan Porter, was named an *EY Entrepreneur of the Year 2025*, and our CTO, Steve Lindsey, was inducted into the *Silicon Slopes CTO Hall of Fame* in 2024\. * **Product \& Software Excellence:** We were named one of *The Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies of 2023* and are a winner of the *Security Today Govies Award* for 2025\. **ABOUT THIS ROLE** As a Senior Software Engineer II on LVT's Agentic Platform team, you will build the Go services that power the AI agents behind our intelligent site platform. You will own the design, delivery, and operation of production\-grade microservices, APIs, and orchestration layers that let agents reason over live site data and take action at scale. Working as an individual contributor within a dedicated engineering team, you will set the standard for code quality, resolve complex production issues, and raise the bar for peers through thoughtful code reviews and technical mentorship. LVT is a flexible\-first company, and this role is onsite at our American Fork, UT headquarters. **ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES** * Design and ship high\-performance Go microservices and APIs that form the backbone of LVT's Agentic AI platform. * Build and evolve the infrastructure that orchestrates agent workflows, including tool integration, state management, and event\-driven processing of site data. * Optimize service architecture, API latency, concurrency, and database query performance to support rapidly expanding platform scale. * Partner with Product Management, QA, and DevOps to turn feature requirements into clear technical specifications, accurate estimates, and timely releases. * Raise code quality through rigorous unit and integration testing, constructive code reviews, and thorough technical documentation. * Diagnose and resolve complex production defects through root\-cause analysis, protecting uptime and data integrity. * Mentor fellow engineers with practical technical guidance and feedback that strengthens the whole team. * Improve CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, observability, and developer tooling to increase delivery speed and reliability. **OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE** * **Technical Background:** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). * **Proven Backend Expertise:** 5\+ years of professional backend software engineering experience shipping production\-level microservices and APIs. * **Strong Go Skills:** 2\+ years of hands\-on experience building and maintaining backend services in Go, with a solid grasp of concurrency, idiomatic design, and performance tuning. * **Agentic \& AI Platform Exposure:** Experience building or integrating LLM\-powered or agent\-based systems, such as tool calling, workflow orchestration, or AI\-enabled APIs, or a demonstrated drive to grow quickly in this space. * **API Development:** Hands\-on experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs (OpenAPI), gRPC, and/or GraphQL. * **Modern Infrastructure:** Familiarity with containerized workflows using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD tools, plus cloud\-native and event\-driven architecture patterns. * **Database Proficiency:** Practical experience with relational databases (SQL) and schema design optimization. * **Problem\-Solving Ability:** Strong analytical skills and a track record of solving complex technical problems amid evolving requirements. * **Quality \& Detail Oriented:** A strong commitment to clean code, thorough testing, and maintainable software. * **Strong Collaboration Skills:** Excellent verbal and written communication and the agility to work effectively in a fast\-paced Agile environment. **BENEFITS** We believe you do your best work when your whole life is supported. We invest in our crew’s health, families, and financial futures with a benefits package designed to support you inside and outside the office.
