jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Managed Kubernetes
jobs.description: Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU. If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us. * Note: This position requires presence in our San Francisco, San Jose, or Bellevue office location 4 days per week; Lambda’s designated work from home day is currently Tuesday. **About the Role** Lambda is building the AI Cloud of the future. We are seeking a Staff Engineer to help our development of our Managed Kubernetes platform. Think GKE, but purpose\-built for AI workloads and running on bare metal. This is a foundational technical leadership role where you will shape the infrastructure that powers the next generation of AI training and inference at scale. As a Staff Engineer on our Orchestration team, you will collaborate to help drive the technical vision for Lambda's managed orchestration services, including Managed Kubernetes, Managed Slurm on Kubernetes, and higher\-level platform services for inference and AIOps. You'll work at the intersection of distributed systems, GPU\-accelerated computing, and Cloud Native infrastructure to build systems that are reliable, performant, and elegantly simple for our customers. This is not a role for someone who just operates Kubernetes; it is a technical leadership role for an engineer who has synthesized the core domains of infrastructure (compute, network, storage, security) and can design holistic solutions across all of them. You'll be working closely with NVIDIA's open\-source ecosystem, and partnering with internal teams across the stack to deliver a world\-class managed platform. **What You'll Do** **Product Engineering** * Drive technical vision for Lambda's Managed Kubernetes bare\-metal platform, including control plane scalability, multi\-tenancy, cluster lifecycle management, and high availability * Integrate and extend NVIDIA's open\-source ecosystem: GPU Operator, Network Operator, DCGM, NCCL, and emerging projects like AICR and Topograph for topology\-aware scheduling and placement * Design GPU\-aware orchestration systems * Lead development of services that power our managed services * Inform on and help with networking solutions for AI workloads: CNI integration (Cilium, Multus), high\-performance fabrics (InfiniBand, RoCE), RDMA, and GPUDirect. You will work closely with our Network team to define and drive requirements * Inform and help with storage architecture requirements for AI workloads. You will partner with Storage teams on what managed K8s, Slurm, and future services need * Build the foundation for Managed Slurm on Kubernetes, enabling traditional HPC workloads to run seamlessly alongside Kubernetes workload * Design higher\-level platform services for inference, including model serving infrastructure, autoscaling based on inference load, and multi\-model deployment patterns * Design self\-healing systems and automation for incident response, root cause analysis, and platform resilience * Lead chaos engineering efforts to validate system behavior under failure conditions at scale * Establish operational excellence for a managed service: upgrade automation, security patching, and zero\-downtime maintenance **Cross\-Functional Infrastructure Leadership** * Serve as the technical bridge between Orchestration and other infrastructure teams (Network, Storage, Security), translating platform requirements into actionable specifications * Drive infrastructure\-wide decisions that enable successful managed services. You’re someone who understands what's needed end\-to\-end, not just at the Kubernetes layer. * Provide input on bare\-metal provisioning, network topology, and storage systems to ensure they meet the needs of managed the services being built by the Orchestration organization * Champion consistency and standardization across Lambda's infrastructure stack * Work directly with customers and internal teams to understand existing deployments and chart a path to the managed platform **Technical Leadership** * Set technical direction for Kubernetes services across the Orchestration team, influencing roadmap and prioritization * Drive reviews and design sessions, ensuring we build systems that are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with customer needs * Mentor and grow engineers, establishing best practices for Kubernetes development, distributed systems, and Cloud Native engineering * Collaborate cross\-functionally with Network, Storage, Security, and Customer Success teams * Engage with NVIDIA and the open\-source community to stay current on GPU orchestration technologies and contribute back where appropriate * Represent Lambda externally through technical blog posts, conference talks, and strategic customer engagements * Shape our AIOps vision: design in ing managed services or multi\-tenant platforms. You understand what it takes to run infrastructure for external customers * Strong understanding of distributed systems principles: consensus, fault tolerance, consistency models, and graceful degradation * Experience with observability at scale: Prometheus, Grafana, distributed tracing, and building actionable alerting systems * Solid knowledge of Linux systems and networking (L2\-L7\), including high\-performance networking concepts (RDMA, InfiniBand, RoCE) * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code and GitOps workflows **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building and operating managed Kubernetes services (GKE, EKS, AKS, or similar) or working on Kubernetes control plane components * Hands\-on experience with NVIDIA's open\-source ecosystem beyond GPU Operator: Network Operator, NCCL tuning, Topograph, AICR, or similar emerging projects * Familiarity with HPC and traditional job schedulers (Slurm) and Kubernetes\-native batch scheduling (KAI, Volcano, Kueue) * Background in confidential computing * Experience migrating customers or workloads from legacy/bespoke infrastructure to standardized platforms * Contributions to CNCF projects, Kubernetes SIGs, or NVIDIA open\-source projects * Familiarity with security and compliance in multi\-tenant environments: RBAC, Pod Security Standards, network policies, workload isolation * Background in ML infrastructure: training clusters, inference serving, simulation **Why Lambda** Lambda is building the essential infrastructure for the AI era. We're not just another cloud provider: we're a company founded by ML practitioners, for ML practitioners. Our customers include leading AI research labs and enterprises pushing the boundaries of what's possible with artificial intelligence. What makes this role special: * You'll be building core platform services the world’s largest AI companies will consume * NVIDIA partnership: Deep integration with NVIDIA's GPU and networking stack, working with cutting\-edge open\-source tooling * Real technical challenges: Massive scale GPU clusters and the unique demands of AI workloads * Cross\-stack influence: Shape not just Kubernetes, but the network, storage, and compute infrastructure that supports it * Direct impact: Your work enables AI breakthroughs. Every model trained on Lambda benefits from systems you build * World\-class team: Work alongside engineers with deep expertise in ML, systems, and infrastructure **Salary Range Information** The annual salary range for this position has been set based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description. **About Lambda** * Founded in 2012, with 500\+ employees, and growing fast * Our investors notably include TWG Global, US Innovative Technology Fund (USIT), Andra Capital, SGW, Andrej Karpathy, ARK Invest, Fincadia Advisors, G Squared, In\-Q\-Tel (IQT), KHK \& Partners, NVIDIA, Pegatron, Supermicro, Wistron, Wiwynn, Gradient Ventures, Mercato Partners, SVB, 1517, and Crescent Cove * We have research papers accepted at top machine learning and graphics conferences, including NeurIPS, ICCV, SIGGRAPH, and TOG * Our values are publicly available: https://lambda.ai/careers * We offer generous cash \& equity compensation * Health, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents * Wellness and commuter stipends for select roles * 401k Plan with 2% company match (USA employees) * Flexible paid time off plan that we all actually use **Equal Opportunity Employer** Lambda is an Equal Opportunity employer. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Connected Fleet & Operations
jobs.description: **About The Landline Company** Landline is building infrastructure that lets passengers clear security and check in for their flight closer to home, before they ever reach the airport. We provide seamless ground connectivity on behalf of American Airlines, Air Canada, and other major carriers, integrating booking, secure transport, and baggage handling into a single ticket across a growing North American network. Backed by top\-tier venture investors and partners like CLEAR, we've spent eight years making the travel day seamless for millions of passengers. **Job Summary** Our drivers and frontline teams run a live 24/7 operation across a growing North American network, and the tools in their hands have to work the first time, even for someone who got hired last week. As a Software Engineer, you'll own that layer. That includes the driver app at the center of every trip, the handheld tools our station staff run their shifts on, and the connections back into the platform, from booking systems to the operations backend, that keep everyone in sync in real time. Our operation runs inside the networks of major airline partners like American Airlines and Air Canada. You'll work at hub airports and partner stations, alongside their teams and ours, watching how the operation actually runs. When you find something slow, manual, or error\-prone, you'll ship the fix and iterate on it in days rather than quarters. We work on a modern, engineer\-friendly stack and build agentic workflows into how we develop and how our tools run, and you'll have a real voice in where it goes next. **What You'll Do** * Own the field software layer: the driver app and the handheld tools frontline staff use every shift for scanning, verification, photo capture, and real\-time status. * Design flows that hold up in real field conditions, including offline use, glare, gloves, and one\-handed operation. * Integrate device capabilities like camera, barcode/NFC scanning, and GPS so field events are verifiable and auditable without slowing anyone down. * Integrate IoT and vehicle telematics, working with platforms like Samsara, so vehicle, device, and operational data flow into one real\-time picture of the operation. * Work across the platform when the problem calls for it, from booking flows to dispatch visibility to the operations backend, so field tools and core systems behave as one product. * Use and build agentic workflows. We rely on LLM\-driven tooling in development and in production, and we want people who are excited to push that further. * Deploy forward: ride along with drivers, work station shifts at partner hub airports, and ship the fix that week. Your users include our own teams and the airline partner staff we operate alongside. **What We're Looking For** * You know how to build for spotty connectivity and make sync conflicts boring, with offline\-first instincts. * Device and IoT integration experience with camera, barcode/NFC scanning, and GPS. * Experience with telematics/IoT platforms (Samsara or similar), rugged devices, or BLE sensors is a plus. * Modern web fluency in a Next.js/Vercel environment working across the stack when a feature needs it. * Agentic or automation experience is a plus, whether that's LLM\-driven workflows, orchestration, or process automation that real users depend on. * Secure\-by\-design instincts as we operate in a security\-regulated environment and build to federal\-grade standards, so data integrity, least privilege, and auditability should come naturally to you. * Forward\-deployed experience embedded with users or operations teams (as an FDE, in solutions engineering, or on internal tools in a physical\-ops business) and you're at your best turning messy operational reality into shipped software. * Comfortable reaching into backend services or web frontends when the fix lives there, across the stack. * A travel or logistics startup background is a plus, and familiarity with regulated data environments will speed up your ramp. **Why Join** * Impact — Ground\-floor ownership of tools a live operation depends on every day * Proximity — You'll watch drivers use what you built the same week you shipped it * Culture — A small, ambitious team that values speed, creativity, autonomy, and bias for action **What We Offer** * Global flight privileges through airline partners * Flexible, remote\-friendly work environment (with regular travel to stations in the USA and Canada, including Montréal, Boston, Denver, and Philadelphia) * Competitive salary, 401(k), and PTO * Medical, dental, vision, and company\-paid life insurance * The opportunity to contribute to sustainable transportation and redefine how people travel **Location**: Remote in a major metro area within the USA or Canada, with occasional travel to station locations in the USA and Canada **Time Zone**: Standard business hours local time, targeting EST and CST **Pay Target:** $120,000 **Job Type**: Full Time Salary, Exempt The Landline Company is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. \#LI\-Remote

jobs.title: Principal AI Software Developer
jobs.description: **Description** Leidos is seeking a Principal **AI Software Developer** to join the Air Traffic Business Area within the Homeland Sector, supporting the development of the Leidos Common Automation Platform (L\-CAP). L\-CAP is a mission\-critical, future\-ready automation platform built on a hybrid cloud data mesh architecture, enabling next\-generation air traffic management capabilities. We are building with an AI\-first engineering mindset, embracing emerging AI capabilities and modern development practices to accelerate delivery, improve software quality, and continuously evolve how we design and build mission\-critical systems. This role operates within a SAFe/Agile framework as part of an Agile Release Train (ART) delivering iterative value across the program. In this position, you will design and implement software solutions independently while working closely with systems engineering, product delivery, and DevSecOps teams. The primary focus is on developing microservices\-based applications within an **Agile/SAFe environment.** Experience with **AI\-enabled or data\-driven systems** is advantageous. This position supports government programs and requires the ability to **obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust investigation** **This is a hybrid position requiring 3 days onsite and 2 days working from home, i**f you are located within a commutable distance (Less than 1 hour's drive one\-way during normal traffic) from **Gaithersburg, MD; Eagan, MN; or Egg Harbor Township, NJ.** **However, if you do not reside within a commutable distance, you** ***may*** **be considered for a 100% remote role.** This role focuses on building and modernizing real\-time, safety\-critical systems using a combination of traditional systems engineering and AI\-augmented software development practices. You’ll work on software that directly supports national air traffic operations, applying AI tools to accelerate development, improve quality, and enhance system reliability. **What You’ll Do** * Design and develop microservices that form the backbone of the L\-CAP automation platform * Collaborate with architects to translate system designs into robust, scalable implementations * Implement RESTful APIs and event\-driven integrations within a hybrid cloud data mesh architecture * Integrate with relational and NoSQL databases, ensuring data consistency and performance * Perform performance tuning and optimization of services operating in distributed environments * Conduct and lead code reviews, enforcing coding standards and best practices across the team * Mentor junior developers, providing technical guidance and supporting their professional growth * Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues spanning multiple services, APIs, and infrastructure layers * Contribute to technical documentation including design documents, API specifications, and runbooks * Participate actively in SAFe/Agile ceremonies and contribute to PI planning and backlog refinement * Perform performance engineering activities including profiling, optimization, and latency analysis for distributed ATC services * Maintain interface stability and backward compatibility when modernizing existing operational software into service\-based implementations * Modernize legacy ATC automation functions into cloud\-native service implementations preserving operational behavior and performance characteristics * Embrace an AI\-first engineering culture by actively adopting AI\-assisted development tools, automation, and modern engineering practices that improve productivity, code quality, and delivery velocity. **Core Technical Qualifications:** * **Bachelor’s degree** in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience in lieu of degree). A completed Master's degree will account for 2 additional years of experience below. * **Minimum Experience AND knowledge will drive level:** + **12 or more years of experience** * Proficiency in Java or C\+\+ with demonstrated experience building production software * Experience designing and developing microservices\-based applications * Strong understanding of RESTful API design and implementation * Experience with distributed systems and event\-driven architectures * Proficiency with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices * Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cassandra) * Solid experience with Git and collaborative development workflows * Familiarity with Agile/SAFe frameworks and iterative delivery * Strong debugging, problem\-solving, and analytical skills * Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust * Experience with performance engineering including profiling, benchmarking, and optimization of distributed services * Knowledge of interface stability practices and API versioning for service\-based architectures * Experience modernizing legacy software into service\-oriented or microservice implementations * **Ability to obtain and maintain  Commutable distance to Gaithersburg, MD; Eagan, MN; or Egg Harbor Township, NJ. **Why Leidos?** You’ll work on systems where performance, precision, and reliability matter — every second. This is not experimental AI for prototypes. This is disciplined, responsible AI applied to mission\-critical software that supports national infrastructure. If you’re excited by solving complex problems in regulated, real\-world environments — and using AI as a force multiplier rather than a shortcut — we’d like to talk. If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares. **Original Posting:** --------------------- October 8, 2026 For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above. **Pay Range:** -------------- Pay Range $131,300\.00 \- $237,350\.00 The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law. **About Leidos** Leidos is an industry and technology leader serving government and commercial customers with smarter, more efficient digital and mission innovations. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, with 47,000 global employees, Leidos reported annual revenues of approximately $16\.7 billion for the fiscal year ended January 3, 2025\. For more information, visit www.Leidos.com. **Pay and Benefits** Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers. Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement. More details are available at www.leidos.com/careers/pay\-benefits. **Securing Your Data** Beware of fake employment opportunities using Leidos’ name. jobs.title: Data Platform & Cloud Engineer, AI- Enabled Developer
jobs.description: Welcome to The Liberty Company—a forward\-thinking, rapidly growing insurance brokerage built on a foundation of culture and collaboration. Recognized for our award\-winning workplace, we believe in creating opportunities for every employee to discover their *Joy of Being* (*JOB*). Our entrepreneurial, wellness\-focused environment is paired with competitive compensation, a generous benefits package, paid time off, and unique programs to support your professional and personal growth. We’re seeking a talented Data Platrform \& Cloud Engineer, AI\-Enabled Developer to join our vibrant team. If our values resonate with you, and you’re looking for a workplace where culture comes first, we can’t wait to get to know you!**JOB SUMMARY** The data and development engineer will own the health of our data warehouse and Azure cloud infrastructure while building the next generation of internal tools using AI\-assisted development practices. This role sits at the center of how Liberty turns raw operational data — from our agency management systems, carrier feeds, and finance platforms — into trusted, well\-governed information that powers reporting, dashboards, and emerging internal applications across the brokerage. The role also administers a portion of Liberty's Azure subscription — the cloud foundation for our internal operating and AI platforms — and leads the retirement of the legacy systems those platforms replace. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable administering a SQL Server data warehouse and using modern AI coding assistants to design, build, and ship production\-grade internal applications faster than traditional development allows. This is not an AI or machine\-learning research role — it is a software engineering and data infrastructure role for someone who has made AI\-assisted coding a core part of how they build software.**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES****Data Warehouse, Database \& Cloud Platform Administration*** Own the health, performance, and security of Liberty’s SQL Server / Azure SQL data warehouse infrastructure, including production and reporting databases. * Administer, monitor, and tune database environments: indexing, query performance, backup and recovery, capacity planning, and patching. * Build, maintain, and monitor the ETL/ELT pipelines that pull data from source systems — agency management systems, carrier and finance platforms, HR/payroll, and other line\-of\-business tools — into the warehouse. * Design and maintain data normalization, transformation, and modeling logic so downstream reporting and BI tools work from a single, consistent source of truth. * Manage schema changes, data quality checks, and job orchestration/scheduling for recurring data loads; troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures and data discrepancies. * Define and enforce data access controls, retention practices, and documentation standards for the warehouse, in coordination with IT and compliance. * Collaborate with IT Department team members and conform to Liberty's governing technology policies — including security, change management, access provisioning, and architecture standards — across all warehouse, cloud, and application work. This role carries a dotted\-line reporting relationship to Technology Operations. * Partner with the BI/Analytics team to expose clean, well\-modeled data sets to existing and future consumption layers, including dashboards, internal applications, and APIs. * Administer responsible portions of Liberty's Microsoft Azure subscription: resource and subscription organization, role\-based access control through Entra ID, cost management and budget monitoring, tagging and naming standards, and platform\-level security configuration. * Own the Azure infrastructure supporting Liberty OS and Liberty Aura — provisioning, configuration, monitoring, patching, and capacity planning for the app services, databases, key vaults, and supporting resources those platforms depend on. * Lead the decommissioning of legacy systems and databases: plan and execute data migration and archival, confirm records\-retention obligations are satisfied before shutdown, retire orphaned Azure resources, and document what was retired and where the data now lives. **AI\-Enabled Development*** Design, build, and maintain internal software applications and automations using AI\-assisted development tools and coding agents as a primary part of the development workflow. * Translate business and operational needs from BI, Operations, and other Liberty teams into working internal tools, integrations, and automations. * Apply sound software engineering practice — code review, version control, testing, and documentation — to everything shipped, regardless of how much of it was AI\-assisted. * Evaluate and responsibly adopt new AI coding tools and workflows, and share practices that raise the team’s overall development speed and quality. * Build and maintain integrations between the data warehouse and internal business applica erience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines and data warehouse or data mart architectures. * Hands\-on experience administering a Microsoft Azure subscription: resource and subscription organization, role\-based access control (Entra ID), cost management, and platform security configuration. * Strong SQL skills, including query optimization, indexing strategy, and performance troubleshooting. * Practical experience building software using modern AI coding assistants or agents (for example, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor) as part of a real development workflow, not just casual use. * Working proficiency in at least one modern programming language (for example, Python, C\#, or JavaScript/TypeScript) for building internal tools and automations. * Familiarity with version control (Git) and standard software development lifecycle practices. * Strong troubleshooting skills and comfort owning a system end to end, from data ingestion through the reports and applications built on top of it. * Experience migrating off and decommissioning legacy systems or databases, including data migration, archival, and retention\-compliant shutdown. * Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to non\-technical stakeholders. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Experience with Azure SQL Managed Instance or another cloud data platform. * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code (Bicep, ARM, or Terraform) and Azure cost management or FinOps practices. * Experience with Tableau or another modern BI/reporting tool, as a data publisher or consumer. * Experience in insurance, brokerage, or financial services, or with agency management systems such as Applied Epic or AMS360\. * Experience building or integrating with MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers or similar agentic/AI tool\-calling architectures. * Exposure to data governance or regulatory compliance requirements relevant to insurance and financial data. * Experience mentoring other developers on AI\-assisted development practices. **TOOLS \& TECHNOLOGIES** **Database \& Warehouse** SQL Server, Azure SQL Managed Instance, T\-SQL, ETL/ELT integration tooling **BI \& Reporting** Tableau and internal dashboarding tools **Development** Python, C\#/.NET or JavaScript/TypeScript, Git/GitHub **AI\-Enabled Development** Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or comparable AI coding assistants and agent frameworks **Cloud \& Infrastructure** Microsoft Azure subscription administration (App Services, Key Vault, Entra ID, Azure Monitor, Cost Management, Azure Policy); infrastructure\-as\-code tooling (Bicep, ARM, or Terraform) ***Promoting Peace of Mind for All*** At Liberty, we take great care to promote peace of mind for all. We create a safe space to find your Joy of Being as your most authentic self. Being uniquely YOU, with your unique experiences and ideas, we will continue to strengthen our company as we grow together. HABU has nothing to do with age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, or ethnicity. jobs.title: Senior Engineer II, Robotics Mechanical Design
jobs.description: **Your Impact at LILA** Our Platform Evaluation team tests and benchmarks alternative robotics platforms, including mobile manipulators, AMRs/AGVs, and other form factors, against our current production baseline. The team builds custom mobile manipulators by combining off\-the\-shelf components from different AMR and robot arm manufacturers, for example mounting one or more arms from a given vendor onto an AMR base from another. As the Robotics Mechanical Design Engineer, you will own the mechanical design of these custom configurations end to end: mocking up multiple iterations (different arm brands, mounting positions, and configurations), modeling them fully in CAD, and preparing designs for simulation and physical build. You will work closely with the Platform Evaluation engineers, who validate designs in simulation (NVIDIA Isaac Sim) and in physical testing once built. This is a hands\-on mechanical and mechatronic design role, not a robotics software or controls position. **What You'll Be Building** * Design and iterate mounting and integration concepts combining robot arms with AMR/AGV base platforms * Produce multiple design options per platform combination for evaluation * Model custom mobile manipulator configurations in CAD, including brackets, structural supports, and interface hardware * Run mass, center\-of\-gravity, and payload analysis to keep configurations within manufacturer specifications * Design cable, hose, and connector routing between the arm, end effector, and AMR base * Prepare simulation\-ready CAD models and specifications (exportable URDF/mesh geometry) for Isaac Sim validation * Document design decisions, tolerances, and assembly procedures, and support physical build and integration **What You'll Need to Succeed** * Mechanical or mechatronic design experience in a production, commercial, or applied R\&D setting, ideally involving robotics or automated equipment * Strong proficiency in 3D CAD software (SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Onshape, or similar) * Experience designing mechanical mounts, brackets, or structural interfaces for hardware integration * Understanding of payload, mass properties, and center\-of\-gravity considerations for robotic arms on mobile bases * Familiarity with robot arm and AMR specifications, including mounting interfaces, payload limits, and reach envelopes * Comfortable iterating quickly, producing and revising multiple design options rather than one final design upfront * Strong documentation habits, with the ability to communicate design intent and constraints to a non\-mechanical audience **Bonus Points For** * Experience preparing CAD models for downstream simulation use, exporting clean geometry at a level of detail suited to URDF/mesh conversion * Experience with robot arms and AMRs specifically, rather than general industrial equipment * Familiarity with ROS2/URDF conventions * Experience with NVIDIA Isaac Sim or other robotics simulation tools * Background in industrial design for warehouse automation, logistics robotics, or manufacturing equipment * Experience with rapid prototyping methods such as 3D printing, sheet metal, and machining for early design iterations **About LILA** Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard\-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves. LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai. Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply. **We're All In** Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy. **A Note to Agencies** *Lila Sciences does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Lila Sciences or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Lila Science's internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Lila Sciences, and Lila Sciences will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.*

jobs.title: Software Engineer - LinOS Connect
jobs.description: Most of the food on a grocery shelf spent part of its life in a cold chain, and Lineage runs the largest one in the world. Getting food from a farm or a plant to a store without ever breaking temperature is a genuinely hard problem, and we solve it thousands of times a day. We build the software that makes it happen. Connect is Lineage's own Warehouse Management System, the system of record for warehouse inventory, orders, and customers. This position is to join the Connect engineering team that builds the integration with LinOS, our platform for automating and improving warehouse operations end to end with data science algorithms. This is software with a physical consequence. Get a release right and a facility moves more product with fewer mistakes; get it wrong and trucks wait at the dock. Your work lands in a real building, on real pallets. LinOS is replacing manual processes that have gone unchanged for decades. What you'll do * Build and maintain backend features and APIs for Connect, working from initiatives scoped by the Tech Lead * Write unit tests, useful logging, and clear pull requests * Learn the warehouse domain: what a receipt, a pick, a load, and a cycle count actually mean on the floor, and why the software models them the way it does * Participate actively in code review, both giving and receiving feedback on the diff * Take part in L3 production support for the systems your team owns, with support from senior engineers * Use AI coding assistants effectively and verify their output before it reaches review What we'll invest in you This role comes with real ramp\-up support: a Tech Lead who owns your onboarding, multiple Senior Software Engineers on the team whose job includes mentoring you, structured documentation, and internal tech talks. We expect to train and grow you into the platform, you are not expected to arrive knowing warehouse management. Required qualifications * **5\+ years** of professional software development experience * Solid object\-oriented development background * Working proficiency in at least one of **JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or C\#** * Comfortable with **SQL** \- able to write queries and understand an existing relational schema * Excellent problem\-solving skills; able to break down an unfamiliar problem and ask good questions * Clear written and verbal communication; works well on a distributed team * Comfortable using **AI development tools**, including giving them appropriate context and reviewing what they produce Preferred qualifications * Node.js / TypeScript (NestJS) and React or React Native * Microsoft SQL Server, including stored procedures * Any exposure to warehouse, supply chain, logistics, or industrial/operational software * Observability tooling (Datadog or equivalent) and containerized deployment (Docker) \#LI\-Remote Why Lineage? This is an excellent position to begin your career path within Lineage! Success in this role enables greater responsibilities and promotions! A career at Lineage starts with learning about our business and how each team member plays a part each and every day to satisfy our customers' requirements. Beyond that, you'll help us grow and learn on our journey to be the very best employer in our industry. We'll ask you for your opinion and ensure we do our part to keep you developing and engaged as we grow our business. Working at Lineage is energizing and enjoyable. We value respect and care about our team members. Lineage is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and is committed to compliance with all federal, state, and local laws that prohibit workplace discrimination and unlawful harassment and retaliation. Lineage will not discriminate against any applicant on the basis of race, color, age, national origin, religion, physical or mental disability or any other protected status under federal, state and local law. Benefits Lineage provides safe, stable, reliable work environments, medical, dental, and basic life and disability insurance benefits, 401k retirement plan, paid time off, annual bonus eligibility, and a minimum of 7 holidays throughout the calendar year.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, RL Research & Environments
jobs.description: Magic’s mission is to build safe AGI that accelerates humanity’s progress on the world’s most important problems. We believe the most promising path to safe AGI lies in automating research and code generation to improve models and solve alignment more reliably than humans can alone. This role focuses on post\-training: identifying capability gaps, building targeted datasets, designing reward signals, and running iterative training loops that measurably improve user\-facing behavior. You will own the infrastructure and experimental workflows that connect product priorities to concrete capability gains. Magic’s long\-context models introduce distinct post\-training challenges: long\-horizon reasoning, sustained coherence over extended trajectories, context\-use quality, and tool\-augmented behavior. You will build systems that expose failure modes, generate high\-signal training data, and enable rapid RL iteration at scale. This role can evolve into ownership of major capability areas, deeper RL systems work, or broader influence over post\-training strategy as Magic scales long\-context model performance and reliability. **What you’ll work on** ----------------------- * Design and build post\-training datasets using synthetic generation, targeted data collection, and self\-play * Implement filtering, scoring, and mixture strategies for RL and post\-training corpora * Build and maintain evaluation frameworks that surface long\-context failure modes * Design reward signals and training environments for targeted capability improvements * Run ablations across data sources, reward designs, and long\-horizon task structures * Improve reliability and observability of post\-training data and environment pipelines * Collaborate closely with Product and Research to translate capability goals into measurable iteration cycles **What we’re looking for** -------------------------- * Strong software engineering fundamentals * Experience building or operating large\-scale data or ML systems * Ability to design and interpret experiments that measure model behavior changes * Comfort working at the intersection of ML, data systems, and infrastructure * Strong attention to data quality and evaluation rigor * Track record of owning experimental or production systems end\-to\-end **Our culture** --------------- * **Integrity.** Words and actions should be aligned * **Hands\-on.** At Magic, everyone is building * **Teamwork.** We move as one team, not N individuals * **Focus.** Safely deploy AGI. Everything else is noise * **Quality.** Magic should feel like magic Magic strives to be the place where high\-potential individuals can do their best work. We value quick learning and grit just as much as skill and experience. **Compensation, benefits, and perks (US):** ------------------------------------------- * Annual salary range:s between $275K \- $550K based on experience * Equity is a significant part of total compensation, in addition to salary * 401(k) plan with 6% salary matching * Generous health, dental and vision insurance for you and your dependents * Unlimited paid time off * Visa sponsorship and relocation stipend to bring you to SF, if possible * A small, fast\-paced, highly focused team Compensation Range: $275K \- $550K

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer
jobs.description: Mural is financial infrastructure for builders, their customers, and authorized agents: the compliant system of record fintechs and platforms build on to move, store, and grow money. The whole stack, one partner. Companies build cross\-border financial products on us using our API. We carry the licenses, the compliance, and the failure states, so they go live in weeks instead of months. Under the hood, fiat and blockchain run as one system. Their customers never see any of it. Money comes in, money goes out, and it just gets there. We've processed over $2 billion across US dollar, stablecoin, and international rails. That includes USDC and USDT on major blockchains, ACH and wire in the US, and local rails across Latin America and Europe (PIX, SPEI, Bre\-B, CBU/CVU, SEPA). Customers include Deel, Bolt, Opera, Koywe, Taxdome, Uniswap, Movii, and more. We've successfully raised our Series A and we're an AI\-native company. Agentic tools are how we build, operate, and scale. **The Role** ------------ Our customers don't just call our APIs. They build their products on us. Their balances, their payment operations, their compliance state. Which means our business succeeds exactly as far as theirs do. Forward Deployed Engineering is the team that makes that true, one customer at a time. You'll report to our CTO and embed with one strategic customer at a time, the enterprises building their products on Mural where we're investing deepest. You'll understand their business, their constraints, and their pain points better than anyone at Mural, and then you'll build what their launch needs. Here's a concrete example. A global payouts customer is expanding into a new market where we don't yet have local account infrastructure. You scope the requirements with their engineering team, then build the virtual account infrastructure, in our core codebase, that their launch depends on. When it ships, it's not a one\-off. It becomes core Mural product that we sell to the next ten customers. That's the defining property of this role. This is not a services role, and it's not technical support. You're a product engineer whose roadmap comes from a live customer instead of a planning doc. Everything you build lands in the core platform, and the best of it becomes product the whole company resells. Engagements are scoped at contract time. You're delivering what we've committed to, not absorbing unbounded requests. But within that scope, the what, the why, and the how are yours to figure out with the customer. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Deploy into customer contexts.** Iterate daily with your customer's engineering and operations teams, mostly over Zoom and Slack, with some travel to spend real time on site. * **Scope the build with the customer.** You're not handed a spec. You work out what to build and why with the customer directly, paired with a deployment strategist who owns the commercial side. * **Build across the full stack.** TypeScript and React, NestJS with Postgres and Prisma, and AWS (SQS, SNS, Lambda). New account infrastructure, blockchain integrations, API endpoints, compliance workflows, whatever the launch requires. * **Generalize the bespoke.** Identify patterns across implementations and work with product to turn engagement output into first\-class platform features. * **Prototype fast, ship carefully.** Rapid iteration against live customer workflows, accepting some throwaway work and making sure what isn't throwaway gets productized properly, all while debugging production issues in real time, sometimes with the customer watching. * **Design for correctness and auditability.** This is money\-movement infrastructure. Edge cases have real consequences, and you think about failure modes before they happen. * **Communicate crisply** with customer engineers, operators, founders, and finance leaders, and with our own product leads, whose pods your work must generalize into. **Who You Are** --------------- * **You're a builder first.** We're flexible on tenure. We'll hire a scrappy engineer straight out of school or a seasoned customer\-facing engineer. We're not flexible on the bar. You ship production\-grade, full\-stack work, and you have something you've built to prove it. * **You're AI\-native.** Agentic tools are how you already build, and we'll ask you to show us. * **You're energized by customers, not shielded from them.** You're comfortable operating directly with an enterprise engineering team, under ambiguity, where the requirements are yours to discover. * **You're obsessed with correctness and resilience.** You love a good state machine. You think carefully about what happens when things go wrong, because with money they can't. * **Strong pluses.** Payments and fintech infrastructure experience, blockchain and stablecoin integration work, and a forward\-deployed or solutions architect background where you *built* rather than just configured. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- * Your customer launches on time, on our rails, and their volume ramps because what you built works. * The infrastructure you shipped for one customer is now core product being sold to the next ten. * Your customer's engineering team treats you as one of their own, and our team trusts what you merge. * You've defined, alongside our CTO, what "forward deployed" means at Mural. You're an early member of a function we're building the company around. **How We Work** --------------- We run on three principles: * **2% better, every day.** One percent for yourself, one percent for the people around you. * **Telos.** From the Greek word telos, meaning not just done but fulfilled. Everyone here is focused on one mission and knows each other's Telos. * **Build.** Embody the builder's mindset. Make things, solve problems, and have fun doing it.

What You’ll Do Design evaluation systems Define what “better” means for representations that evolve over time. Design novel evaluation methodologies where traditional ground truth is unavailable or insufficient. Develop scoring frameworks, metrics, rubrics, judge models, and diagnostic methodologies. Continuously evolve evaluation definitions as models and product capabilities change. Build evaluation infrastructure Build production\-quality Python pipelines and evaluation harnesses. Manage datasets, labels, experiment versions, model versions, judges, reruns, and regression testing. Create infrastructure that allows researchers and engineers to answer new evaluation questions quickly. Integrate experiment tracking and observability into evaluation workflows. Analyze results and improve the system Analyze model outputs, agent trajectories, and execution traces. Identify meaningful failure modes rather than optimizing for superficial metrics. Translate evaluation findings into concrete engineering or research improvements. Run experiments, compare results, document findings, and drive the resulting fixes. Build simulation agents at scale Develop and operate simulation environments capable of modeling large numbers of entities. Increase the throughput and reliability of evaluation runs. Build systems that enable rapid iteration across models, prompts, representations, and evaluation strategies. Own the full evaluation loop You will own the process from: Research question → evaluation design → data → implementation → execution → analysis → diagnosis → rerun → recommendation There is no expectation that this work will be handed off between multiple teams. Required Qualifications Dealbreakers 3\+ years of professional experience designing and owning LLM evaluations. Demonstrated experience designing, building, and running LLM evaluations end to end. Production\-quality Python experience, including testing, maintainability, debugging, and release practices. Experience creating evaluation methodologies rather than exclusively running existing benchmarks. Strong ability to investigate model/agent failures using traces, outputs, datasets, and experimental results. Ability to work on\-site in New York City five days per week. Must already have unrestricted U.S. work authorization; visa sponsorship is not available. Required Technical Skills Python PyTorch Hugging Face / Transformers LLM evaluation and benchmarking Experiment design and statistical/quantitative analysis Evaluation datasets and labeling methodologies Model/LLM\-as\-a\-judge evaluation ML experimentation and debugging Preferred Technical Skills Weights \& Biases Hydra SQL Kafka or other streaming/event\-driven infrastructure Evaluation/observability frameworks Agent simulation and multi\-agent systems Large\-scale data pipelines Nice to Have Experience with AI memory, identity, personalization, agent evaluation, or agentic optimization. Research experience in LLMs, NLP, machine learning, evaluation, or related areas. First\-author/co\-author research at NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, or comparable venues. Alternatively, a high\-quality open\-source project, benchmark, framework, or technical publication demonstrating comparable research ability. Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Machine Learning, or another quantitative discipline. Who Will Not Be a Strong Fit Candidates who have only run established benchmarks without designing their own evaluations. Engineers whose LLM experience is limited to application development without evaluation ownership. Candidates without substantial hands\-on Python engineering experience. Candidates without evidence of research thinking, novel experimentation, published work, or comparable open\-source work. Candidates unwilling or unable to work five days per week from the New York City office. Compensation $220,000–$300,000 base salary \+ competitive equity Final compensation will depend on experience, technical depth, research contributions, and interview performance. Hiring Process The successful candidate should expect technical discussions focused on: Designing an evaluation from scratch. Diagnosing an LLM/agent failure from traces. Building a production evaluation pipeline. Research methodology and experimental design. Python/ML engineering. Previous research or open\-source work. Pay: $220,000\.00 \- $300,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Employee assistance program Application Question(s): * Can you work full\-time on\-site in New York City 5 days per week, and do you currently have unrestricted U.S. work authorization without requiring visa sponsorship? * Have you either (a) published ML/LLM research at a recognized conference/journal or (b) released substantial open\-source research/ML work of comparable quality? * Do you have hands\-on experience with PyTorch AND Hugging Face/Transformers? * Do you have production\-level Python experience, including writing tests, maintaining production code, debugging, and managing releases? * How many years of professional experience do you have designing and owning LLM evaluations? * Have you personally designed, built, and run an LLM evaluation system end to end, including defining the evaluation methodology/metrics rather than only executing an existing benchmark? * Share your Linkedin url Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Head of Data Strategy and Enablement
jobs.description: **Company:** ------------ Marsh **Description:** ---------------- Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, this combined commercial, product, and technical leadership role drives the firm’s data strategy, enabling colleagues to benefit from our extensive data platform, and derive insights which deliver value to them and our clients. Leading \~20 experts across the US, UK and Brazil, the team innovates with data technologies, including extensive use of AI capabilities, to continuously improve the data\-driven capabilities of Marsh Re. There is an additional focus on client advisory: the data\-led reinsurance analytics work that wins and retains business. You will turn those learnings into new data and AI products that scale across the client base and help push the frontier of Marsh Re’s data and AI work. This role is based in New York City. **We will rely on you for:** ---------------------------- ### **Client advisory** * Support analytics\-led advisory that wins new business and retains clients—bringing quantitative firepower to clients’ risk and capital decisions * Engage clients and markets with the firm’s internally built, AI\-oriented products (built on our data lake), making them a reason that clients engage and stay * Advise clients on building their own data and AI strategy: assess where they are, design the target operating model and roadmap, and help them stand up scalable AI capabilities — with the credibility of a firm that has done it (proof\-by\-practice, not slideware) * Deploy engineers forward (embedded in our broking teams) to solve real problems using that scales a deliberate feedback loop: turn what forward\-deployed teams learn in the field into productized data/AI capabilities that scale across the client base — build once, deliver to many Own the data\-product lifecycle (discovery delivery launch* continuous improvement); build revenue\-generating products and scale them across clients and markets * Prioritize strictly by client value, applied AI/GenAI, and the data foundations that new models depend on — keeping the firm ahead of the market * Advance machine learning, predictive analytics, and applied GenAI products from research into production * Partner closely with GC IT to industrialize what the team provides — moving mature prototypes and IP cleanly from innovation into firm\-wide production and scale * Champion data quality, governance, security, and responsible AI. ### **Data Strategy \& Governance** * Further extend our enterprise\-wide Data Governance framework that includes: + Clear governance, ownership, and policies: defined data ownership, management and stewardship across the business and IT, a standardized metadata catalogue, and policies for access + Modern, scalable cloud\-native architecture based on group strategic platforms, including Azure Data Lake (ADLS), Databricks, DBT and PowerBI + Trusted data through quality and master\-data management: form\-wide data quality rules, and automated profiling and remediation * Value delivery: analytics, MLOps, and a data\-driven culture to deliver Client Advisory capabilities as described in the next section ### **People \& organization** * Leads with growth\-oriented leadership mindset—coaching others, elevating performance through timely feedback, and building an inclusive environment that supports accountability and development. * Lead and with commercial and product instinct, and is comfortable engaging with internal and external clients * Lead the quarterly business reviews delivered to Executive Committee members as well as investment cases and roadmap trade\-offs. **What you need to have:** -------------------------- * 12–15\+ years in data/analytics/AI, 2\+ in senior leadership of a multidisciplinary team * Proven track record turning analytics into commercial outcomes — winning/retaining business or building products that do * Demonstrated ability to build and scale data/AI products (productization, not bespoke delivery) * Client\-facing credibility — able to lead advisory engagements and engage with client and executive teams. * Strong command of data architecture and pipelining, ML algorithms, and applied AI — technical enough to lead the technical leads * Experience managing both engineering leads and product managers, and setting roadmap * A fast study — proven ability to master complex, unfamiliar domains quickly and operate credibly alongside subject\-matter experts * Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management * Advanced degree in a quantitative field (or equivalent demonstrated experience) **What makes you stand out:** ----------------------------- * Experience in insurance, reinsurance, or financial services * Background at a major technology company, high\-growth startup, or data/AI consultancy * Experience with a forward\-deployed / embedded client\-delivery model * Hands\-on experience with LLM/GenAI in production, with responsible AI jobs.title: Applications and AI Developer
jobs.description: Position Overview MEG is seeking a developer with strong programming and AI integration skills to improve engineering workflows and support the company’s long\-term technology needs. This position begins in the engineering department with required, hands\-on training in modeling and drafting. The employee will learn our products, design standards, and engineering processes before progressively taking on application development responsibilities. Initial development priorities include custom Autodesk Inventor tools, AI augmentation of 3D design, and an AI\-assisted drawing review system integrated with Wrike. After completing the engineering assignment, the employee will transition to the IT department, supporting company\-wide AI development, general IT operations, and continued maintenance of engineering applications. Required Drafting Training and Progression The initial drafting assignment serves as a hands\-on research and learning period for the development work that follows. By modeling and drafting MEG’s products, the employee will gain firsthand understanding of design requirements, manufacturing considerations, review expectations, and the daily challenges the custom tools must address. This background is necessary to develop useful automation and evaluate whether AI\-assisted reviews are identifying relevant issues accurately. Candidates must be willing to spend an unspecified period performing modeling and drafting work before programming becomes their primary responsibility. Progression will depend on demonstrated drafting proficiency rather than a fixed timeline. The drafting department will provide training through its established program. The employee will model and draft a wide variety of products and develop proficiency in Autodesk Inventor, Autodesk Vault, and MEG’s documentation practices. Progress will be measured against the qualification matrix used within MEG’s ISO quality management system. The Drafting Manager will determine proficiency with input from team leads. As proficiency increases, the employee will begin applying that knowledge to development projects, with a growing portion of the workday allocated to programming. For example, an initial allocation might include seven hours of drafting and one hour of programming, progressing toward full\-time development as qualifications and project needs allow. These allocations are illustrative and are not a guaranteed schedule. The employee will report to the Drafting Manager until drafting training is complete, at which point the employee will then report directly to the Director of Engineering until engineering assignments are complete and the employee is ready to transfer to IT. Engineering Responsibilities * Complete modeling and drafting assignments while learning MEG’s products, manufacturing requirements, design standards, and review processes. * Work with engineering personnel to translate identified needs into practical software requirements and measurable goals. * Independently research and select development methods, tools, and approaches appropriate to each project. * Develop, test, document, and implement custom Inventor tools, add\-ins, and workflow automation using Autodesk\-supported APIs and development methods. * Investigate and implement AI augmentation of 3D modeling and design through Autodesk\-supported capabilities and integration methods. * Create, validate, and implement an AI\-assisted drawing review system integrated with Wrike, drawing on more than ten years of historical drawing reviews. * Develop review capabilities addressing drawing layout, technical data, bills of materials, typographical errors, and other recurring model and drawing review findings. * Evaluate the feasibility of comparing models and drawings against piping and instrumentation diagrams (P\&IDs), and coordinating review tools with supported Inventor AI capabilities. * Collaboratively evaluate results with the engineering team, measure missed issues and incorrect findings, and refine applications based on demonstrated performance. * Prepare user instructions, technical documentation, and training materials; support implementation and ongoing improvements. Engineering will provide project inputs, priorities, and desired outcomes. The developer will establish implementation approaches and monitor results collaboratively with the team. IT will establish approved platforms and security requirements, including protection of confidential and NDA\-covered customer information. Responsibilities Following Transition to IT Within MEG’s approximately 300\-person organization, responsibilities will include: * Develop and maintain internal AI tools and integrations for departments throughout the company. * Continue supporting engineering applications, Inventor tools, and the Wrike AI review system. * Respond to IT support tickets and troubleshoot hardware, software, access, and application issues. * Assist with user accounts, permissions, workstation setup, software deployment, and routine systems administration. * Support network, server, backup, and other IT infrastructure activities as assigned. * Assist with website and web application security, updates, access controls, and vulnerability remediation. * Maintain technical documentation and help employees use company technology effectively. Required Qualifications * Strong practical experience developing AI\-enabled applications and integrating AI capabilities into business workflows. * Demonstrated programming ability, including the ability to independently develop, troubleshoot, test, and maintain applications. * Experience connecting applications and data through APIs or other supported integration methods. * Ability to translate business needs into workable technical solutions and explain technical limitations clearly. * Willingness to complete the required drafting assignment and progress according to demonstrated proficiency. * Careful attention to detail and a disciplined approach to evaluating software and AI outputs. * Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with technical and nontechnical personnel. * Commitment to protecting confidential information and following company security requirements. * Ability to work onsite and travel less than 10%. Beneficial Qualifications * A degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related discipline. A degree is preferred but not required; relevant experience and demonstrated ability will be considered. * Experience with one or more applicable languages, including C\#, VB.NET, VBA, Python, or C\+\+. * Familiarity with Autodesk Inventor, Vault, iLogic, Autodesk APIs, or add\-in development. * Experience with AI analysis of documents, images, or technical drawings; retrieval of historical information; and evaluation of AI accuracy. * Experience with Wrike, workflow automation, or project management system integrations. * Familiarity with manufacturing drawings, assemblies, bills of materials, or P\&IDs. * Experience with source control, software deployment, technical documentation, and user training. * Familiarity with Windows systems administration, networking, web security, and general IT support.

jobs.description: **Our Purpose** *Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build* *a sustainable economy* *where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making* *transactions secure,* *simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.* **Title and Summary** Senior Principal AI Engineer\- AI Center of Excellence Our Purpose: Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. Our technology and innovation, partnerships, and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses, and governments realize their greatest potential. Overview: The AI Center of Excellence is seeking a Senior Principal AI Engineer – AI Infrastructure to serve as a technical expert and thought leader for Mastercard’s enterprise AI infrastructure. This senior individual\-contributor role will shape the architecture and engineering of secure, scalable, production\-grade platforms supporting LLM model training and inferencing, machine learning models, large language models (LLMs), agentic AI, and emerging AI capabilities in production. The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in high\-performance computing (HPC), GPU and accelerated computing, rack\-scale systems architecture, private and hybrid cloud, Kubernetes, high\-performance networking and storage, observability, security, and reliability. jobs.title: AI Full stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: McKesson is an impact\-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well\-being of you and those we serve – we care. What you do at McKesson matters. In this role, you will be instrumental in designing, developing, and deploying end\-to\-end AI\-powered solutions that enhance our healthcare products and services. You will work across the full stack, from front\-end user interfaces to back\-end AI model integration and data pipelines. **Responsibilities** * Develop and deliver AI\-driven enterprise quality software applications. * Build scalable applications integrating Large Language Models and other AI tools (e.g. voice recognition, document parsing, image parsing, text to speech, RAG) into new and legacy codebases * Design and optimize data pipelines and datasets for AI system development and testing. * Communicate modern AI concepts (LLMs, vector databases etc.) to non\-technical audiences * Iteratively craft effective prompts to maximize LLM performance and implement prompt caching strategies * Maintain prompt libraries \& benchmark performance * Fine\-tune \& serve GPT\-family, Llama * Develop AI agents Semantic Kernel * Prototype co\-pilot experiences \& autonomous workflows * Fully document all work at both the code level and application level. * The ability to learn and adapt in a changing environment. * Collaborate with other staff and outside stakeholders on large projects. * Must be passionate about creating solutions and solving complex problems. **Priority will be given to candidates who reside in the Atlanta, GA, and Columbus, OH metropolitan areas.** **We are unable to provide sponsorship for this role presently or in the future**. **Minimum Qualifications** * Minimum 2\+ years of experience in Software development. * Minimum 2\+ years of experience in developing AI\-enhanced applications using LLMs, voice, image, or speech models. * B.S. degree in Computer Science or related engineering discipline, or equivalent experience **Critical Skills** * AI System Evaluation \& Optimization: Proficient in sensitivity metrics (precision, recall, F1\-score, AUC\-ROC) and MLOps for scalable, cost\-efficient AI deployment. * RAG Development: Skilled in building RAG systems from scratch or with LangChain/LlamaIndex, using vector databases for context\-aware LLM applications. * LLM Cost Optimization: Expert in managing LLM costs (token pricing, input/output rates) via prompt caching, batching, and quantization. * LLM Knowledge: Deep understanding of LLM advancements (GPT\-3\.5 vs GPT\-4 vs o1/”thinking” models) for informed model selection and tuning. * Exceptional analytical skills to extract actionable insights from data * Experience using AI coding tools (e.g. Github Copilot, Cursor, Codeium/Windsurf) * Proficiency in Python and AI related python libraries such as openai, tensorflow, pytorch * Healthcare Domain Expertise, Translate clinical/business needs into AI solutions * Proficiency in creating Node.js web apps (e.g. Express.js) * Experience with cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) * Effective communication skills to collaborate with technical, DevOps and product management teams. * Experience with Git, Docker, and Kubernetes We are proud to offer a competitive compensation package at McKesson as part of our Total Rewards. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. The pay range shown below is aligned with McKesson's pay philosophy, and pay will always be compliant with any applicable regulations. jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer II
jobs.description: Description: **POSITION SUMMARY** MedPro Systems is seeking a contract Full Stack Engineer to support MedProID, our core healthcare professional (HCP) identity and database platform, and DLS, a companion desktop application used by our internal data operations team. This is a maintenance\-and\-enhancement role on an established, revenue\-critical legacy system. It is not a greenfield build and is not centered on MedPro’s newer React / FastAPI / PostgreSQL stack. MedProID is MedPro’s customer\- and internal\-facing web application, built on an Oracle database of roughly 36 million healthcare professional records that serves as the “golden record” MedPro’s products and customers rely on. DLS is a WPF desktop application used by data operations staff to quality\-check state professional\-license data loads before they post into MedProID. DLS is expected to be retired eventually in favor of a newer internal platform, but it remains in active daily use, and this role provides its steady, reliable support until that transition occurs. The Full Stack Engineer will own changes end\-to\-end within MedProID’s and DLS’s existing technology, including Classic ASP and ASP.NET (VB.NET/C\#), Oracle PL/SQL, and the supporting desktop and caching layers. This mid\-level contract (staff augmentation) position is part of Full Stack Engineering – MedProID Legacy and reports to the Engineering Lead or Manager. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** **MedProID Development and Support:** * Design, build, and support MedProID features end\-to\-end, from the UI (Classic ASP, ASP.NET Web Forms/MVC, jQuery, Bootstrap) through the Oracle PL/SQL data layer. * Read, write, and troubleshoot Oracle PL/SQL stored procedures, packages, triggers, and views that power MedProID and DLS. * Diagnose and resolve production issues across the full stack. **DLS Support:** * Provide ongoing maintenance and enhancement support for the DLS WPF desktop application. * Ensure DLS remains reliable for daily data operations use until its planned replacement. **Database Standards and Change Control:** * Follow MedPro’s established Oracle coding, schema\-design, and unit\-testing standards (utPLSQL) for all database changes. * Ship database changes as reviewed, per\-issue deployment scripts under change control. * Participate in code reviews and technical design discussions with the MedProID product team. * Use AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) where helpful to work efficiently through legacy code; encouraged but not required. * Provide after\-hours support as needed during releases or production escalations. Requirements: **EDUCATION/CERTIFICATION** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent hands\-on work experience. **JOB QUALIFICATIONS** **Required (verified, hands\-on production experience):** * Classic ASP and ASP.NET (Web Forms and/or MVC) across the frontend and middle tier. * VB.NET (or C\#) and VBScript. * JavaScript / jQuery. * Oracle PL/SQL, including the ability to read, write, and troubleshoot stored procedures, packages, and non\-trivial queries. * Redis or a directly comparable in\-memory caching layer. * A true full\-stack mindset, with comfort owning a feature from UI through business logic to the database rather than staying in a single tier. **Preferred:** * Fluency with AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, or similar). General AI/ML engineering experience is welcome but does not substitute for the required qualifications. * Exposure to WPF desktop application development. * Exposure to React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, microservices, RabbitMQ, or Kafka, which is useful as MedPro modernizes but not required for this role. **YEARS’ EXPERIENCE** * 3–5 years of hands\-on production experience in the required technology stack. **TECHNOLOGY/SOFTWARE KNOWLEDGE** **Web / Presentation Tier (MedProID):** * Classic ASP with VBScript (a large, still\-active part of the application). * ASP.NET Web Forms (.aspx / .aspx.vb) and ASP.NET MVC 5 with Razor views. * VB.NET and C\# on .NET Framework 4\.5–4\.6\.2 (classic .NET Framework, not .NET Core / .NET 5\+). * jQuery (1\.11–3\.x), Bootstrap (3\.x–5\.x), jQuery Validation, Modernizr, and AJAX Control Toolkit. * Embedded, customized Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) for dashboards and ad hoc reporting; Microsoft Report Viewer for fixed reports. * Oracle.ManagedDataAccess (ODP.NET) for data access. **Desktop Tier (DLS):** * WPF (XAML / MVVM) using C\# and/or VB.NET on .NET Framework. **Database Tier (MedProID Legacy):** * Oracle 19c. * PL/SQL packages, procedures, triggers, views, materialized views, sequences, and scheduler jobs. * utPLSQL unit testing, enforced through pre\-commit hooks and written standards. * Per\-issue SQL\*Plus deployment scripts under version control. * **Supporting Infrastructure:** * Redis or a comparable in\-memory caching layer. * Azure DevOps Pipelines for CI/CD and Git for source control. **REQUIRED TRAVEL**10%Hybrid schedule with onsite attendance at the MedPro office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS** * Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. * The individual is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer screen and extensive reading. The individual in this position needs to occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, etc. The individual must be able to remain in a stationary position 70% of the time. **DISCLAIMERS** *This job description is not intended to be all\-inclusive. The employee may perform other related duties as needed for growth and development or to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.* *MedPro Systems LLC is an equal opportunity employer and does not unlawfully discriminate against current or prospective employees on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, pregnancy, familial status, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, citizenship, ancestry, genetic information, or any other characteristics prohibited by law.*
