jobs.title: Software Engineer, Systems ML Tooling
jobs.description: Meta is seeking a Software Engineer to join the MTIA (Meta Training \& Inference Accelerator) Software Tooling team, which develops and maintains the tooling ecosystem for Meta's in\-house AI accelerator ASICs. The Tooling team provides debugging, profiling, memory analysis, and monitoring capabilities for the whole MTIA Ecosystem, redefining ML accelerator tooling by leveraging Meta's full\-stack ownership from silicon specs to fleet observability.In this role, you will design and build developer tools across the MTIA tooling ecosystem, with a primary focus on debugging, sanitizer technology, and fault isolation for AI workloads running on MTIA hardware at scale. You will work at the intersection of compilers, runtime, hardware, and ML frameworks, collaborating with cross\-functional partners to deliver a high\-quality developer experience for Meta's custom AI accelerators.This role can focus on either debugging and sanitizing technology or simulation infrastructure for pre\-silicon and post\-silicon model bring\-up, depending on the candidate's background and team needs. ### **Software Engineer, Systems ML Tooling Responsibilities:** * Lead the design and development of MTIA's debugging and sanitizer tooling, including live debugging, core dump, and memory sanitizers for accelerator workloads * Build debugging capabilities spanning graph\-mode debugging, kernel\-level diagnostics, and multi\-rank fault isolation * Contribute broadly to the MTIA SW tooling infrastructure — profiling, performance debugging, memory analysis, monitoring, and reliability analysis for training and inference workloads * Own significant components end\-to\-end, from technical design through implementation, production rollout, and long\-term maintenance * Collaborate closely with the MTIA compiler, runtime, kernel, and hardware teams to instrument the software stack with the hooks, sanitizers, and debuggers required * Drive AI\-native tooling approaches, leveraging automation and LLM\-guided diagnostics to reduce time\-to\-root\-cause * Partner with internal product teams across advertising, recommendations, and generative AI to understand developer pain points and prioritize tooling investments * Communicate architectural decisions through design documents and cross\-team reviews * share debugging methodology and best practices with engineers across the MTIA stack ### **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience * 4\+ years of experience in systems software engineering, performance engineering, developer tooling, or a closely related field * Experience building debugging, sanitizer, profiling, simulation, or diagnostic tools for complex software/hardware systems * Proficiency in C\+\+ and Python, including low\-level systems programming and scripting for tool automation * Experience working across multiple layers of a system stack (compiler, runtime, OS/driver, hardware)Track record of leading the technical design and delivery of tooling or infrastructure projects through to production deployment * Cross\-stack debugging skills, with the ability to trace issues across application, runtime, and hardware boundaries ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * 5\+ years of experience in systems software, developer tooling, or accelerator software development (or equivalent with advanced degree) * Experience with compiler\-based instrumentation and runtime shadow\-memory techniques underlying sanitizers (LLVM instrumentation passes, interceptors, allocator red zones) * Track record of building developer tools adopted by large engineering populations, ideally with contributions to open\-source projects (LLVM sanitizers, gdb, Valgrind, Triton, etc.) * Familiarity with ML framework internals (PyTorch jobs.title: Systems Administrator
jobs.description: **DEADLINE TO APPLY IS SUNDAY, OCTOBER 25, 2026, AT 11:55 PM****FIRST ROUND INTERVIEWS ARE TENTATIVELY SCHEDULED FOR THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 5, 2026****IF YOU ARE INTERESTED, PLEASE APPLY IMMEDIATELY***A resume is required with your application**Be ready to rethink your assumptions about the public sector. Dedicated and motivated colleagues? Beautiful, high amenity building for on\-site work and collaboration? Flexible schedules and hybrid work options? Yes, yes, and yes!* **ABOUT THE ROLE** Under the direction of the Bay Area Toll Authority (BATA) Information Technology Manager, the Systems Administrator provides server, identity, and security administration in a primarily Microsoft Server and Azure environment with a small number of Linux systems. This is a broad role with an emphasis on identity, security, and automation. The position helps build a new configuration standards and automation program, and will support facility monitoring technology as new toll facilities come online. This is one of two systems administrator positions on a seven\-person IT infrastructure team within the Capital Delivery, Asset Management, and Roadside Tolling (CART) section, alongside network engineers and a technical project manager. Responsibilities are divided between the two administrators and reviewed as the work changes. The systems supported by this position keep toll collection running across the Bay Area state\-owned bridges and several of the region's Express Lane corridors, including equipment at toll plazas and roadside facilities. This is a 24/7 operation, though after\-hours escalations are rare and have not required a rotating on\-call schedule. The position is expected to respond to major system failures and security incidents when they occur. The Metropolitan Transportation Commission (MTC) is the transportation planning, financing, and coordinating agency for the nine\-county San Francisco Bay Area. MTC is the federally designated Metropolitan Planning Organization (MPO) and the state designated Regional Transportation Planning Agency (RTPA) for the nine\-county San Francisco Bay Area. MTC provides services to the Association of Bay Area Governments (ABAG). For more information about MTC, visit www.mtc.ca.gov . **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER** The Metropolitan Transportation Commission is an equal\-opportunity, non\-discriminatory employer. MTC provides all employees and applicants with an equal opportunity in every aspect of the employment experience regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, physical handicap, medical condition or marital status. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES** * Experience administering enterprise identity platforms such as Okta or Entra, including hybrid integration with on\-premises Active Directory * Experience with system hardening and configuration baselines * Proficiency with Microsoft PowerShell for system administration and automation * Experience administering Microsoft Azure * Experience administering enterprise backup and recovery, including restore testing and verification * Experience responding to security incidents and alerts from endpoint detection or SIEM platforms * Fundamental understanding of networking, including routing, switching, and firewalls * Fundamental understanding of common protocols (such as, but not limited to, LDAP, SMTP, TCP/IP, RADIUS, DNS, DHCP, SAML, and SSL/TLS) * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, evidenced by a history of enhancing system performance and resolving complex technical issues Valid California Class C driver's license and a safe driving record. This position requires occasional travel to toll plazas and roadside facilities, which are not served by public transit. Rental vehicles are available for planned site work; the position requires the ability to reach a site on short notice for unplanned or emergency response. * **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS** **Education \& Experience** : Equivalent to completion of the twelfth (12th) grade and five (5\) years of increasingly responsible experience conducting needs and systems analysis and planning, design, development, implementation, configuration, and maintenance of information technology applications, systems, and/or infrastructure **Licenses or Certificates:** Valid California Class C driver's license and a safe driving record. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** **Experience** : * Experience with configuration management tooling such as Ansible, Puppet, or Chef * Experience using version control (Git) for infrastructure documentation or automation code * Experience with vulnerability management tooling and remediation workflows * Security certifications such as Security\+, GSEC, or CISSP * Experience administering Linux systems * Experience with enterprise monitoring tools (SolarWinds, Splunk, or similar) * Experience with operational technology or building systems (building management, environmental monitoring, or physical security platforms) * Experience with Nutanix * Experience with LAN hardware including patch panels, switches, fiber optics, and Ethernet wiring Systems Administrator responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following: * Administering identity and access platforms, including Active Directory, Entra, and Okta; managing account lifecycle, group membership, and multifactor authentication administration * Developing configuration standards, building automated compliance auditing against those standards, and maintaining systems infrastructure documentation * Administering endpoint security and file integrity monitoring platforms; performing vulnerability remediation and system hardening * Administering on\-premises and cloud server infrastructure, storage, operating systems, and system software, including supporting migration of services to Azure * Monitoring system performance, capacity, availability, and security, and responding promptly to alerts and incidents * Managing patch and update cycles across the server and endpoint estate, and tracking platform lifecycle to plan replacement of systems approaching vendor end of support * Administering backup and recovery services, including backup design and scheduling, periodic restore testing and verification, and recovery documentation * Supporting facility technology systems as new toll facilities come online, including building management, environmental monitoring, camera and video, and physical access control * Supporting agency technology projects through infrastructure and security design review, requirements input, and technical coordination with vendors * Providing after\-hours response for major system failures and security incidents, and performing occasional on\-site work at toll plazas and roadside facilities * Performing other job\-related tasks and duties as needed or assigned by the Section

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Agentic AI Architect
jobs.description: **Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.** Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. **Job Summary – Member of Technical Staff \- Agentic AI Architect, Smart Manufacturing AI Pathfinding \& Innovation (AIPI)** Join an inclusive team passionate about one thing: using their expertise in the relentless pursuit of innovation for customers and partners. The memory solutions we build help make everything from virtual reality experiences to breakthroughs in neural networks possible. We do it all while committing to integrity, sustainability, and giving back to our communities. Because doing so can fuel the very innovation we are pursuing. The Smart Manufacturing and AI team at Micron Technology is looking for an ambitious engineer (Member of Technical Staff \| MTS) to deliver industry\-winning Agentic AI solutions that power Micron’s dominance in the highly competitive memory solutions market. (CoT) reasoning. * Experience designing and implementing Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, and vector search. * Experience building and operating end\-to\-end systems that automate the testing, evaluation, and deployment of autonomous AI Agents. * Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) tools, plugins, and skills, and the Agent\-to\-Agent (A2A) protocol for building interoperable multi\-agent systems. * Understanding of AI Agent security practices, including sandboxing, access control, and mitigating prompt\-injection and tool\-misuse risks. * Familiarity with machine learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit\-learn, etc). * Strong scripting and programming skills, with software development skills and a desire to work in a cloud environment. * 8\+ years of relevant industry experience, spanning large\-scale data/ML pipelines and/or production Agentic AI systems. * Outstanding analytical thinking, interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills. * Ability to prioritize and meet critical project timelines in a fast\-paced environment. * Experience with Kubernetes for orchestrating containerized applications, including deployment and scaling of AI Agent workloads. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience designing and coordinating Multi\-Agent Systems, including collaboration between specialized agents. * Experience designing and operating agent swarms for distributed, parallelized task execution. * Experience with agent profiling and evaluation tooling to identify performance regressions and bottlenecks across agent pipelines. * Hands\-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or CrewAI. * Proficiency in TypeScript and/or Rust. * Demonstrated ability to study jobs.title: Applied ML Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** Security represents the most critical priorities for our customers in a world awash in digital threats, regulatory scrutiny, and estate complexity. Microsoft Security aspires to make the world a safer place for all. We want to reshape security and empower every user, customer, and developer with a security cloud that protects them with end to end, simplified solutions. The Microsoft Security organization accelerates Microsoft’s mission and bold ambitions to ensure that our company and industry is securing digital technology platforms, devices, and clouds in our customers’ heterogeneous environments, as well as ensuring the security of our own internal estate. The Microsoft Social Engineering Threats Research team protects people and organizations from rapidly evolving threats across email, collaboration, and messaging platforms. We are looking for an **Applied ML Engineer** to help shape the next generation of AI\-powered security protections.We develop and deploy cutting\-edge AI systems that make tens of billions of real\-time security decisions every day, helping customers stay safe from phishing, fraud, scams, and other forms of social engineering. Our team applies advances in artificial intelligence, including language models, multimodal systems, and agent\-based reasoning, to solve challenging security problems at global scale. We believe in an AI\-first approach: rapidly experimenting with new ideas, rigorously measuring impact, and iterating quickly to bring effective solutions into production. Our work sits at the intersection of research, engineering, and product development, allowing us to transform emerging technologies into capabilities that directly improve customer protection. We foster a culture of curiosity, collaboration, and continuous learning. Team members are encouraged to explore new technologies, challenge assumptions, and work closely with world\-class researchers, engineers, and product teams to deliver meaningful outcomes. Whether you are evaluating the latest AI advances, building production\-scale detection systems, or designing experiments that influence future product direction, your contributions will have visible impact. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. In this role, you'll partner closely with design and business teams to bring useful, usable, and customer\-centered product experiences to life * Build and manage a talented backend development organization focused on delivering meaningful product features * Lead, coach, and develop software engineering managers and technical team members * Establish development metrics and regular processes for assessing performance and identifying opportunities for improvement * Create consistent project management and software development processes that support high\-quality delivery in rapid iterations * Apply strong design, business, and technical judgment to accelerate releases while advancing long\-term product goals * Champion software development excellence, customer centricity, and continuous improvement across the organization * Present and evangelize prototyped concepts to diverse audiences through both formal and informal presentations * Facilitate cross\-functional teams, contribute to short\- and long\-term planning, and help resolve challenges constructively **Experience You Bring** ------------------------ * 7\+ years of hands\-on experience as a web development engineer * 7\+ years of experience managing backend development teams * 5\+ years of experience managing and leading technical employees * Experience developing products for global markets * Experience working in a highly agile or Scrum environment * Demonstrated ability to recruit, mentor, and develop strong software engineering teams * Strong judgment and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across design, business, and technical teams * A commitment to serving customers, evolving how work gets done, and creating useful, usable experiences **Technology:** --------------- We value adaptability and problem\-solving over specific tools. Mindbody is primarily a .NET and C\# engineering organization running on AWS. Depending on your team and area of focus, you might work with: * **Backend:** .NET 8, ASP.NET Core, Java, Kotlin, Python, Django, Ruby, and Rails * **Frontend and mobile:** React, TypeScript, Next.js, Ember, and React Native * **Data:** PostgreSQL on Aurora, SQL Server, Redis, and MongoDB * **Infrastructure and delivery:** AWS, Kubernetes on EKS, Lambda, Pulumi, Docker, Helm, Flux, Azure DevOps, GitHub, LaunchDarkly, and New Relic **Pay Transparency:** --------------------- Pay Transparency: It is Playlist's intent to pay all Team Members competitive wages and salaries that are motivational, fair, and equitable. jobs.title: Staff Firefox Performance Engineer
jobs.description: **Why Mozilla?** Mozilla Corporation is the non\-profit\-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy\-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non\-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute **open\-source** software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. **About this team and role:** The Mozilla Firefox Performance team is a community of engineers who care deeply about delivering the fastest browser possible. We are the team responsible for making all parts of the browser go fast. Our team is geographically\-distributed, and working in the open is the norm. We contribute to the code driving the Firefox browser on a number of platforms \- Windows, Android, Linux, and macOS. Our focus is on finding and fixing things that slow down the browser as well as helping other teams write fast and reliable code to make Firefox excellent for users. Do you value curiosity and enjoy finding a needle in a haystack? Do you approach problems by looking at the system as a whole? Do you want to help lead and shape the future of the Internet? Do you like making things blazingly fast? If so, we’d love to hear from you. **What you'll do:** * Write code and tests, build prototypes, tackle problems, profile and analyze performance bottlenecks * Learn about a wide variety of problems and solutions across a large, complex, and evolving codebase * Use several programming languages (e.g., C\+\+, JavaScript, Kotlin, Rust, Python) and techniques to fix performance issues, with an emphasis on C\+\+ and JavaScript * Help to educate engineers on other teams about writing more performant code through code reviews, giving talks, implementing tooling, and/or writing documentation * Break down complex performance problems into actionable next steps and drive them to completion * Partner with engineering teams across the organization to support performance efforts, and lead them within your area * Contribute to the direction of performance benchmarks and help prioritize the improvements that matter most * Own the performance of a significant area of the browser end to end, and contribute to the Performance team's technical roadmap * Work with driven, committed team members to help bring the Open Web to millions of people **What you'll bring:** * BS/MS in CS or CE, and 5\+ years of relevant experience * Deep proficiency in C\+\+ * Working proficiency in JavaScript * You have proven experience developing performance\-critical software * You take an experimental and measured approach to solving problems (measurement, and using experiments to diagnose an issue or prove out a solution) * Proven skill in debugging and analyzing performance bottlenecks, and using profiling tools to diagnose and fix issues (VTune, Xperf, other sampling based profilers) * Experience with at least one of: multithreading and concurrency, disk I/O, or GPU work * Track record of driving projects to completion, including work spanning more than one engineer. * Experience collaborating with engineers on other teams to deliver shared goals. * An interest and ability to work in a distributed team (which requires good asynchronous written communication skills as well as good verbal communication skills) **Bonus points if you have any of the following:** * Familiarity with Web Standards or patterns * Familiarity with Android or Windows OS application programming * A solid understanding of statistics * Prior experience working on a modern web browser We value a variety of voices on the Performance Team and at Mozilla. You don't need to check every box on this list to apply. **What you’ll get:** * Generous performance\-based bonus plans to all eligible employees \- we share in our success as one team * Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage * Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute) * Quarterly all\-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together * Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday * One\-time home office stipend * Annual professional development budget * Quarterly well\-being stipend * Considerable paid parental leave * Employee referral bonus program * Other benefits (life/AD\&D, disability, EAP, etc. \- varies by country) **About Mozilla** Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. jobs.description: **Job Details** =============== New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. jobs.title: Product Engineer, Developer Platform
jobs.description: For more than 25 years, NVIDIA has driven innovation in computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re harnessing the boundless possibilities of AI to build the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. DSX OS is NVIDIA's open source foundation for AI infrastructure. It is a growing portfolio of engineering teams building in the open. Every project in that portfolio needs to meet a shared bar for open\-source readiness: code hygiene, governance, community health. Today, that's measured by hand, project by project. This role owns an internal product that changes that to a platform that scores, tracks, and reports on readiness across the DSX OS portfolio, and the roadmap that takes it from an internal utility to the definition of what "open source ready" means for DSX OS. **What you'll be doing:** * Lead the platform as production infrastructure. Maintain, harden, and evolve it from a measurement tool into the system every DSX OS project runs on — reliability and data quality matter because everything else in the program depends on it. * Automate scoring. Replace manual review\-fix\-recheck loops with tooling, so the portfolio scales through automation instead of added effort. Self\-serve integration. * Build scoring into onboarding and workshop experiences. This lets participants get real\-time feedback on their own project instead of waiting for manual review. It increases how many teams a single event can support. * Engineering team feedback loop. Work directly with the project teams using the platform, capture friction signals, and feed them back into the product instead of letting issues pile up in a backlog. * Readiness tracking and reporting. Automate the generation and tracking of per\-project readiness plans so status, blockers, and progress are transparent to leadership without manual assembly. **What we need to see:** * 8\+ years of relevant experience and a bachelors degree (or equivalent experience) * Experience leading a software product or internal platform end\-to\-end and making the calls on what gets built, why, and in what order * Strong software engineering skills, with a track record of turning manual, error\-prone processes into reliable automation * Hands\-on experience with agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor) as part of your actual engineering workflow, not just casual use * Experience running a production system in the real world — on\-call, incident response, or otherwise owning uptime and reliability for something people depend on daily * Experience building reporting or dashboards that a non\-engineering audience (leadership, partners) can trust as a source of truth * Ownership mentality for production systems — system dependability and integrity of data fall under your responsibility, not someone else 's **Ways to stand out from the crowd:** * Built or operated a rubric\-based scoring or compliance system — quality gates, readiness checks, policy\-as\-code — where the output has to be defensible enough for people to act on it * Experience using LLMs within an evaluation pipeline (LLM\-as\-judge, qualitative signal assessment at scale) rather than only deterministic pass/fail checks * Designed a metric or signal taxonomy from scratch — deciding what to measure, how to weight it, and how to keep a single score relevant as the system it measures evolves * Built a tool that abstracts over multiple backends or platforms (e.g., supporting both GitHub and GitLab) so it isn't locked to one provider's API * Experience with GitOps\-style automation — automated checks that run against every repo or PR or equivalent experience without a human in the loop Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. jobs.description: **About the Company:** Netspend Corporation is a global, vertically\-integrated financial services and technology company dedicated to the delivery of innovative financial empowerment solutions to consumers worldwide. The Associate Director of Application development will shape the long\-term technology vision, drive SaaS\-first engineering excellence, and ensure our product's solutions remain in the industry benchmark for innovation, reliability, and customer value. This leader will inspire high\-performing global teams, foster strong cross\-functional partnerships. ### **The Core Mandate** **1\. Strategic Technical Leadership \& Stakeholder Management** * **The Bridge:** Act as the primary interface between business units and engineering. You will translate high\-level commercial objectives into executable technical strategies. * **Portfolio Oversight:** Manage a comprehensive portfolio of applications, ensuring that cross\-functional teams are aligned, unblocked, and delivering high\-value features. * **Agile Transformation:** Lead the evolution of the engineering org into a high\-performing, fast\-paced Agile environment, optimizing for both speed\-to\-market and system stability. **2\. Technical Depth \& Innovation (AIDLC)** * **Hands\-on Guidance:** While not required to write daily production code, you must possess the technical depth of a former Solution Architect or Dev Lead. You will guide teams through complex technical hurdles and ensure code quality standards. * **AI\-Augmented Engineering:** A core focus will be the AIDLC (AI\-driven Development Life Cycle). You will be expected to implement AI tools and frameworks to drastically enhance team productivity and developer experience. * **Cloud Strategy:** Direct the architecture and migration initiatives within the AWS ecosystem, ensuring cost\-efficiency, scalability, and security. * **Move Fast with Stability:** Transition teams into high\-performing, autonomous units that ship code daily without compromising the integrity of financial transactions. * **Metric\-Driven Results:** Define and track KPIs that correlate engineering output with actual business revenue and user engagement. **3\. Organizational Mentorship** * **Leader of Leaders:** Provide direct mentorship and career development for Senior Leaders. * **Culture of Excellence:** Foster an environment of continuous learning, psychological safety, and technical curiosity. * **Bottom\-Up Leadership**: Empower Senior Leaders to take extreme ownership. Foster a culture where the best ideas win, regardless of hierarchy. ### **Candidate Requirements** **Education (Mandatory)** **Educational \& Foundation (Mandatory)** * **Academic Excellence:** **B.Tech** **/ B.E.** from a reputed, top\-tier institute or a **Master of Computer Applications (MCA)**. **Experience \& Skills** * **Years of Experience:** **12\+ years** in Software Development with a progressive track record of leadership. * **Domain Expertise:** Deep experience in **Fintech and Banking** (High\-volume transactions, security protocols, regulatory compliance). * **Full\-Stack Vision:** Proven experience leading both **Front\-end and Back\-end** initiatives simultaneously. * **Technical Stack:** Strong foundational knowledge in modern microservices, distributed systems, and **AWS Migration**. * **Communication:** Elite communication skills; able to influence senior business stakeholders and inspire junior engineers. ### **High\-Weightage Qualifications** * Demonstrated success in using **AI to enhance team efficiency** (e.g., LLM\-integrated workflows, automated code synthesis, or AI\-driven testing). * Experience transitioning legacy banking systems into modern, cloud\-native architectures. * A "Consultative Mindset": The ability to analyze problems from a first\-principles perspective and drive data\-backed decisions. ### **Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** * **Operational Efficiency:** 30% improvement in development velocity via AIDLC tools. * **System Reliability:** Maintaining 99\.99% uptime for critical banking portfolios. * **Talent Retention:** Reducing attrition among high\-potential Senior Managers and Directors. * **Stakeholder Satisfaction:** High NPS from business partners on the "transparency and predictability" of the delivery pipeline. ### **V. Why This Role?** This is a rare opportunity to build a engineering org within the high\-stakes world of Finance. You will have the budget of a Tier\-1 firm and the autonomy to rewrite the rules of how software is built using AI.

jobs.title: AI Engineer, Computer Vision
jobs.description: **About Niantic Spatial** At Niantic Spatial, we're building the future of physical AI. Powered by a proprietary database of over 30 billion posed images, our groundbreaking mapping technology unlocks a new dimension of interaction and spatial intelligence that helps both humans and machines better understand, represent, navigate, and engage with the real environment. Our reconstruction technology captures environments with geometric accuracy and extreme detail from any standard camera, and our Visual Positioning System delivers precise positioning almost anywhere in the world. We serve customers across robotics, the public sector, and energy and industrial markets — building for the 80% of economic activity that takes place beyond our screens. **About the Team** Localization is where the map meets the moment. Our localization team builds the living geospatial world model and the centimeter\-level Visual Positioning System (VPS) that lets people and robots know exactly where they are, from any camera, almost anywhere on Earth. That system is learned, not hand\-built. Our localization stack has moved from classical geometry to visual models trained on billions of posed images — models that have to be accurate to the centimeter, robust to lighting and seasons and clutter, and fast enough to run in production for every query. This team sits at the junction of research and production: we take what works in a paper, make it work on our data, and make it work for customers. **About the Role** We're hiring an AI Engineer, Computer Vision, to contribute to the deep learning models at the heart of our localization system. Working alongside experienced researchers and engineers, you'll help train and iterate on the visual models — feature extractors, matchers, pose regressors, and retrieval models — that turn a single image into a precise position in the world. This is a full\-loop environment. You'll get exposure to the entire pipeline: the data the model learns on, training, evaluation, and the service that runs it in production. You'll be surrounded by people who care deeply about correctness — where a loss curve going down is not the same as a system getting better — and you'll grow into that rigor quickly. **What You'll Do** * **Train and Evaluate Models —** Implement, train, and evaluate visual localization models in PyTorch: local feature extraction and matching, image retrieval, pose regression, and scene\-coordinate regression. Iterate on architectures, loss functions, and training loops to improve accuracy on real production captures. * **Build Data Pipelines —** Contribute to high\-throughput ingestion and preprocessing pipelines that turn raw imagery, poses, and 3D point clouds into training\-ready datasets, including curation, sampling, and augmentation. * **Run Experiments at Scale —** Run training jobs across GPU environments on our 30\-billion\-image corpus, working with senior engineers and ML Infrastructure to keep experiments reproducible and results interpretable. * **Extend the Benchmark —** Help build and maintain the evaluation suite for localization — pose accuracy, recall across lighting and season changes, and latency under production load — so results are comparable across model versions. * **Support Production Deployment —** Work with senior engineers to take models from checkpoint toward serving: export, inference optimization, and monitoring once live. Learn what it means to own a model end\-to\-end, not just hand off a checkpoint. * **Bridge Research and Product —** Work with the Research team and Real\-World Test Lab to understand how field failures translate into training data and benchmark improvements. **What You'll Bring** * Experience training deep learning models for computer vision tasks in PyTorch — through coursework, research, internships, or early industry work. * Foundational understanding of at least one of: visual localization, learned feature matching, image retrieval, pose estimation, SLAM, or structure\-from\-motion, and the 3D geometry underneath them (camera models, epipolar geometry, pose parameterizations). * Comfort working with large image or 3D datasets — preprocessing, curation, and understanding how data quality affects model behavior. * Familiarity with GPU\-based training and the ability to read and reason about training runs — identifying whether a bottleneck is in data loading, compute, or model architecture. * Strong Python skills and a habit of writing code that others can rerun and build on. * A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, computer vision, robotics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Nice to Have** * Published or contributed to work on learned localization, visual place recognition, scene\-coordinate regression, or vision foundation models (CVPR, ECCV, ICCV, NeurIPS, 3DV, or equivalent). * Experience with large\-scale self\-supervised or multi\-view pretraining, or fine\-tuning vision foundation models for geometric tasks. * jobs.title: Principal Engineer - Agentic AI Platform (Hybrid - Seattle,WA)
jobs.description: **Job Description** ------------------- **About the Role** Nordstrom is building the next generation of AI\-powered retail experiences, and the AI Agentic Platform is at the heart of that transformation. We are looking for a visionary Principal Engineer to lead the design, architecture, and development of a foundational platform that enables AI agents to autonomously reason, act, and collaborate across Nordstrom’s technology ecosystem. As a Principal Engineer (Level 19\), you are a functional expert and advisory individual contributor responsible for work across multiple teams. You will establish design principles, drive cross\-team technical strategy with a time horizon of up to one year, and serve as the primary escalation point for complex engineering challenges in the AI Agentic Platform domain. Your work will directly shape how Nordstrom leverages autonomous AI to enhance customer experiences, streamline operations, and accelerate engineering productivity. **A Day in the Life** * Architect and evolve the AI Agentic Platform — defining the foundational layers for agent orchestration, tool use, memory, and multi\-agent coordination at Nordstrom scale. * Partner with AI/ML and product teams to translate business goals into platform capabilities that enable autonomous agent workflows across commerce, inventory, and customer experience domains. * Lead cross\-team design reviews, establish platform engineering standards, and create reusable architecture artifacts that accelerate delivery across the organization. * Apply deep AI fluency to evaluate and integrate LLM APIs, vector stores, RAG patterns, and emerging agentic frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen, OpenAI Assistants API, Semantic Kernel). * Mentor and coach engineers across teams; serve as the technical escalation point for complex agentic system issues and significant operational incidents. * Drive decisions on platform observability, evaluation, and guardrails — ensuring agents behave reliably, safely, and within business policy constraints. * Hands\-on POC development for novel agentic patterns to prove viability and inform broader team adoption. * Collaborate with senior technology and business leaders to articulate trade\-offs, influence roadmaps, and align platform strategy with Nordstrom’s long\-term AI vision. * Contribute to Nordstrom\-wide engineering standards, open\-source initiatives, and the broader AI engineering community. **You Own This If You Have…** **Must Have** * 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of designing and delivering large\-scale distributed platforms. * AI Fluency — Required: Deep, hands\-on experience with LLMs, foundation model APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, etc.), prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and embedding\-based search in production environments. * Platform engineering in AI teams — You have built or significantly contributed to shared AI infrastructure or developer platforms within an AI\-focused product organization, enabling multiple teams to build on top of your foundation. * Strong proficiency in Python and/or Java; experienced with cloud\-native development on AWS and/or GCP. * Expertise architecting complex, scalable distributed systems — microservices, event\-driven architectures, API gateways, and data pipelines. * Highly skilled at applying architectural patterns to express complex, scalable systems that optimize for simplicity, operational support, and implementation velocity. * Demonstrated experience influencing senior technical and business leaders, with the ability to clearly articulate engineering trade\-offs and drive cross\-team decisions. * Strong DevOps foundation — CI/CD (GitLab or equivalent), containerization (Kubernetes/Docker), observability and telemetry, and SLA\-driven reliability engineering. * Experience with Agile methodologies, continuous improvement mindset, and security\-first development practices. * Track record of mentoring and growing engineering talent across multiple teams. * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field. **Nice to Have** * Hands\-on experience building AI Agentic systems — designing and deploying autonomous agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or OpenAI Assistants API. * Familiarity with multi\-agent orchestration patterns: task decomposition, tool\-use pipelines, agent memory (short\-term and long\-term), and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows. * Experience with agent evaluation frameworks, safety guardrails, and responsible AI deployment in production at scale. * Background in retail, e\-commerce, or supply chain — understanding of how AI agents can power inventory, fulfillment, personalization, or customer service workflows. * Contributions to open\-source AI or platform projects; active participant in the broader AI/ML engineering community. * Experience with data science\-enabled solutions, big data technologies (Spark, BigQuery, Redshift), and integrating ML models into production platforms. **Pay Range Details** The pay range(s) below has been provided in compliance with state specific laws. Our unique collaborative approach fosters a dynamic synergy between data science, product development, pharmaceutical industry experts, and engineering. jobs.title: Lead Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) delivers mission\-critical cloud services to enterprises worldwide. The Physical Networking Automation and Tooling team builds and operates the software platforms that enable Network Engineers to manage OCI’s global physical network through automation, observability, and actionable insights. We are building intelligent network automation platforms that combine network telemetry, topology, device state, operational workflows, and AI/ML to automate work across the network lifecycle. You will set the technical direction for AI agents that analyze network context, interact with approved tools, and execute controlled workflows with appropriate human oversight. You will define how these capabilities integrate into reliable, scalable software platforms that support production network operations. As a Lead Principal Software Engineer, you will own architecture and technical direction for these platforms, aligning engineering teams and driving complex initiatives from concept through production. You will remain hands\-on in critical design and implementation, establish engineering standards for reliability and safe automation, and mentor engineers and technical leaders. Working closely with engineering and network operations leaders, you will shape how OCI operates its physical network as it grows. **Key Responsibilities** * Define the long\-term architecture and technical roadmap for physical network automation, validation, observability, and AI\-driven operations across OCI. * Lead the design of distributed, event\-driven systems that ingest and correlate network failures, performance, power, capacity, topology, and change data at global scale. * Architect AI decision systems for anomaly detection, fault diagnosis, capacity forecasting, and remediation. Establish how models and agents use network context, express uncertainty, and escalate decisions to engineers when needed. * Direct the development of agent workflows that discover and invoke approved capabilities, coordinate tools and services, maintain execution state, and recover safely from partial failures. * Establish controls for actions affecting production networks, including identity and authorization, approval gates, validation, limits on the impact of failures, cancellation, rollback, and audit trails. * Define evaluation and observability standards for AI\-driven capabilities. Measure diagnostic accuracy, false positives, action quality, latency, cost, and operational outcomes before and after deployment. * Set architecture and engineering standards across APIs, backend services, data pipelines, workflow execution, testing, deployment, and production operations. * Advise senior leaders on technical investments and risk. Mentor principal and senior engineers and strengthen engineering practices across teams. **Minimum Qualifications** * At least 15 years of experience in software engineering, network automation, cloud infrastructure, or a related field, including technical leadership of initiatives spanning multiple teams. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * Strong programming skills in Java and Python, with experience building and operating production software. * Deep experience designing distributed systems, APIs, event\-driven data pipelines, workflow systems, or cloud\-native services. * Experience defining technical architecture and leading complex projects from concept through production operation. * Experience with network operations, data center infrastructure, or other large\-scale infrastructure systems. * Experience building AI/ML or LLM\-based capabilities to operational problems, including evaluating their output and defining when human review is required. * Strong knowledge of Linux, software development practices, CI/CD, observability, and production incident response. * Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, resolve architectural tradeoffs, and mentor experienced engineers. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience developing AI/ML automation workflows with network telemetry, device connectivity, configuration validation, or automated remediation in large\-scale networks. * Track record of architecting agentic systems, including planner and executor patterns, tool orchestration, agent handoffs, state management, checkpointing, retries, and durable workflows. * Hands\-on work integrating agents with enterprise tools through MCP, A2A, or similar protocols, including authentication, tool schemas, context handling, approval gates, and failure handling. * Knowledge of AI evaluation, quality, observability, and governance practices for production systems. * Proficiency with Kubernetes, containers, and operating cloud\-native platforms in production. * Practical use of AI\-assisted development tools for coding, testing, review, and debugging. Contributions to industry standards groups or open source projects related to network automation or data center infrastructure, such as the IETF, IEEE 802, or the Open Compute Project. * This is an individual contributor role with broad technical influence. Success means delivering cross org impact that increases OCI’s operational capabilities, and reduce the time required to resolve and deploy network infrastructure safely at global scale.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering & Maintenance
jobs.description: ***Do you get energized by turning engineering strategy into improvements you can actually see on the manufacturing floor?*** * Do you enjoy solving complex manufacturing challenges through engineering, automation, technology, and disciplined problem solving? * Do you take pride in building strong Engineering and Maintenance teams while creating the capability needed for future growth? ***If so, this role may be the perfect fit for you.*** **Who you’ll work for…** ------------------------ Palermo’s is a family\-owned company with a passion for great pizza and great people. or Master's degree with 6 years of relevant experience; or HS diploma with 12 years of relevant experience. * Mainframe development experience in production or maintenance environment. * Advanced proficiency with mainframe technologies such as COBOL, JCL, CICS, TSO and VSAM. * Knowledge of health care claims processing, particularly Medicare Fee For Service. * Ability to perform well in a highly rigorous, structured development environment. * Demonstrated experience as a senior or principal software developer in a mainframe environment. * Demonstrated ability to determine and decompose business and technical requirements. * Application lifecycle methodology experience, specifically Agile/SCRUM. * Strong communication skills and technical writing ability, including client\-facing communication. * Ability to develop application project solutions and provide accurate estimates. * Experience with Medicare Part A, Medicare Part B, DME or Medicare Common Working File (CWF) specific processing systems. * Experience working with or in support of CMS programs or contracts. * Experience with DevOps/DevSecOps tools and frameworks through plan, define, build, test, release and deploy processes. * SAFe experience and/or certification. * Must be able to achieve and maintain a Public Trust clearance. This represents the typical salary range for this position. jobs.title: Member of Data Staff (Analytics Engineer)
jobs.description: Perplexity is AI for people who expect more. On the data team, that means building the systems that make our data reliable, understandable, and usable by both humans and AI. We're looking for an analytics engineer or data engineer who wants to build the foundation for an AI\-native data organization. You'll design core data models, pipelines, semantic layers, data quality systems, governance practices, and warehouse workflows that power the entire company: helping teams make strategic decisions, operate the business, and move faster with trusted data. You'll also make sure those systems are secure, privacy\-aware, and legible to AI agents, data scientists, and the rest of the company. This role is for someone who can operate at the boundary of analytics engineering, data engineering, data governance, and internal product. You care about dimensional modeling, dbt standards, cost\-aware warehouse design, access controls, privacy, and the details that make data trustworthy. You also believe AI should make the data stack faster, easier to maintain, and more accessible across the company without weakening security or governance. **What You'll Do** ================== * **Build the core data foundation** \- design and maintain high\-quality data models, marts, and pipelines that make analysis fast, reliable, and reusable. * **Manage the data warehouse** \- help own warehouse architecture, environments, permissions, performance, cost, data lifecycle, and operational hygiene so the platform scales cleanly. * **Make the warehouse AI\-readable** \- own the documentation, semantic context, metadata, lineage, and retrieval patterns that AI systems depend on to understand and query Perplexity's data correctly. * **Own data modeling standards** \- define and champion dbt patterns, dimensional modeling practices, naming conventions, tests, and review processes. * **Lead data governance practices** \- define standards for access, ownership, lineage, documentation, retention, quality, and sensitive data handling across the analytical warehouse. * **Build with security and privacy in mind** \- partner with engineering, security, legal, and finance where needed to ensure data access, sharing, and AI\-enabled workflows are appropriate and controlled. * **Automate data quality and maintenance** \- build AI\-assisted workflows that detect issues, explain root causes, suggest fixes, generate tests, and reduce manual firefighting. * **Improve data team productivity** \- automate repetitive workflows, improve tooling, streamline development, and make it easier for data scientists and stakeholders to answer questions. * **Partner across the company** \- work closely with data scientists, engineering, product, finance, and GTM teams to translate analytical needs into durable data systems. * **Shape tooling decisions** \- evaluate build\-versus\-buy tradeoffs, manage vendor relationships when needed, and choose tools that scale with the team. **What We're Looking For** ========================== * **6\+ years** of experience as an analytics engineer, data engineer, data scientist, or closely related role. * **Deep SQL expertise** \- you can reason about correctness, performance, joins, grain, and edge cases in complex warehouse queries. * **Strong data modeling experience** \- you've worked hands\-on with dbt (or a similar transformation framework) in production, and you understand dimensional modeling, data contracts, testing, and how analytical schemas should evolve. * **Pipeline ownership** \- you've built, maintained, debugged, and improved production data pipelines. * **Warehouse management experience** \- you've worked with warehouse administration, access patterns, permissions, performance tuning, cost management, or operational ownership. * **Governance mindset** \- you think clearly about data ownership, access controls, privacy, retention, lineage, auditability, and the risks of making data too easy to access. * **AI\-native working style** \- you already use AI to speed up development, documentation, QA, exploration, and repetitive workflow automation. * **Stakeholder fluency** \- you know how to turn messy analytical requirements into trusted models, metrics, and reusable data assets. * **Autonomy and execution** \- you can take projects from ambiguous problem to production\-quality system with minimal oversight. * **Operational judgment** \- you care about reliability, governance, security, cost, and long\-term maintainability. **Bonus** ========= * Snowflake administration, optimization, cost management, or warehouse performance tuning. * Experience with RBAC, PII handling, data classification, retention policies, audit workflows, or privacy/security reviews. * Experience with Databricks or other modern data infrastructure. * Experience building semantic layers, metrics layers, metadata systems, or data catalogs. * Python experience for data tooling, automation, orchestration, or quality checks. * Previous experience as an early analytics engineer or data engineer at a high\-growth startup. **Why This Role** ================= * **Own the foundation** \- your work will determine how fast and confidently the company can use data. * **Build for humans and AI** \- the next generation of data infrastructure needs to be understandable by agents as well as analysts. * **High leverage** \- better models, pipelines, and tools multiply every data scientist and every stakeholder who depends on data. * **Small team, broad scope** \- you'll have room to define standards, choose tools, and ship systems that become company\-wide defaults.

This includes supporting safe rollouts, upgrades, and rollback strategies. * **Drive security, observability and cost\-aware infrastructure:** You will treat security, logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting as first\-class platform primitives, and build systems that surface reliability and performance issues early. jobs.title: Director, Operations Engineering
jobs.description: **About Prime Data Centers** Prime Data Centers develops, acquires, and operates data centers for some of the world's largest enterprises. A private firm owned by a group controlling $6 billion in assets, with a 15\-year tenure in technology and real estate development, Prime provides customers with ownership options and dynamic leasing models, defining a true corporate partnership. **About the Role** The Director of Operations Engineering is responsible for the technical strategy, continuous improvement, and engineering support of Prime's operating data centers. This team is separate from Design and Construction; its focus is the facilities already in service and the people who run them. Reporting to the SVP of Critical Operations, the Director is the engineering partner to Critical Facility Managers (CFMs) and Chief Engineers (CEs) across the portfolio. The Director provides senior technical support and troubleshooting, owns the root cause analysis program, and drives measurable improvement in equipment reliability. The Director also brings rigor and visibility to the engineering requirements that govern how Prime's sites are operated, maintained, and changed, including studies, single\-lines, settings, procedures, and change control. This is a platform role. It requires strong planning abilities, leadership through influence, and a proactive partnership approach, underpinned by a robust engineering background. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on engineering leader with real time on the operations side of mission\-critical facilities, with experience in electrical and mechanical systems and an understanding of large\-scale data centers or comparable environments. They should be equally comfortable working through a UPS failure on a bridge call at 2 a.m. and building the program that keeps it from happening again. They earn credibility with site teams by showing up and solving problems, and they turn what they learn into standards, data, and feedback for the teams designing and building Prime's next facilities. This role supports a 24x7x365 operating environment and includes participation in an escalation on\-call rotation for critical events. **What You'll Do** **Site Engineering Support \& Troubleshooting** ----------------------------------------------- * Build and lead a team of operations/reliability engineers (electrical, mechanical, and controls) dedicated to supporting operating sites. * Serve as the senior technical escalation path for CFMs and CEs on complex electrical, mechanical, controls, and fire/life safety issues. * Establish a clear intake, triage, and response model for site engineering requests, with defined response expectations and tracking. * Provide on\-site and remote troubleshooting support during critical events and recoveries, with the goal of achieving uptime and customer SLA commitments. **Root Cause Analysis Program** ------------------------------- * Own Prime's RCA program: methodology, severity thresholds that trigger an RCA, report standards, training, corrective action tracking, and closure verification. * Provide technical support to CFMs and CEs, who own and lead site RCAs. This support includes failure analysis, data review, and coordination with OEMs, service vendors, and forensic labs. * Review RCAs for technical quality and consistency, and make sure corrective actions address true root causes. * Share findings and lessons learned across all sites so a failure at one site becomes a fix everywhere. **Equipment Reliability** ------------------------- * Develop and run a portfolio\-wide reliability program covering asset criticality ranking, failure trending, FMEA, and PM optimization (RCM\-based where appropriate). * Use CMMS, BMS/EPMS, and incident data to find bad actors, recurring failures, and fleet\-wide equipment issues, and drive resolution with OEMs. * Define critical spares strategy and condition\-based maintenance practices such as IR thermography, oil and vibration analysis, and battery monitoring. * Drive innovation in facilities programs and systems to improve quality and reliability and to reduce operating costs, with an environmentally conscious approach. * Report reliability KPIs to Critical Operations leadership. **Engineering Requirements, Visibility \& Rigor** ------------------------------------------------- * Establish and maintain the engineering baseline for each operating site: current single\-lines, short\-circuit/coordination/arc flash studies, protective relay and breaker settings, sequences of jobs.description: Overview: The Accelerator seeks a **Data/ML Engineer** to strengthen our data team and advance the engineering, enrichment, and provisioning of the data we collect. The Data/ML Engineer will work within our team to help drive data engineering and machine learning initiatives and collaborations. They will play a crucial role in building and operating the pipelines that transform large\-scale social media and web behavior data into research\-ready data products, and in developing the machine learning and enrichment capabilities that extend their value. They will work on problems that have no precedent and little source material, requiring novel solutions. They will also be responsible for working with the other teams within the Accelerator and our external partners to help foster collaboration and create an impactful environment for our users. **This is a 6\-month term role with potential for extension. data engineering and machine learning methodologies and innovations. **Data Engineering:*** Design, build, and operate data pipelines across the Accelerator's medallion architecture, with end\-to\-end ownership of transformation layers that serve researchers. * Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and quality of data to be made available through the Accelerator, including data quality validation at pipeline boundaries and enforcement of versioned schema contracts. * Diagnose and optimize distributed data processing workloads at production scale. * Develop deployment automation, CI/CD, and release processes for data products, including versioned data releases and researcher\-facing change documentation. **Machine Learning and Data Science:*** Design, develop, and operate ML and NLP enrichment pipelines over large\-scale text and behavioral data, including language identification, translation, and topic and content classification. * Own the full lifecycle of enrichment models: selection, evaluation against labeled data, batch inference architecture, cost efficiency, and reprocessing and versioning strategy. * Develop ML\-ready feature layers and data products to support advanced research use cases. * Evaluate and apply large language model workflows and other emerging AI methods where they demonstrably improve outcomes, with attention to their validity for downstream scientific analysis. * Apply statistical analysis and modeling to characterize datasets, estimate coverage, and support research design. **Platform Operations and Cost Engineering:*** Contribute to cost attribution, visibility, and governance across institutional workspaces, including cluster policies, budget controls, and storage lifecycle management. * Design data and ML workloads to operate within the platform's cost governance framework. * Develop automation for workspace and project provisioning as institutions and research projects onboard. * Operate within Unity Catalog governance, multi\-tenant isolation, and research data security requirements. **Research and Collaboration:*** Work effectively in a modern, professional software and data engineering environment with a strong understanding of Agile concepts and practices. * Modern Software Engineering Foundations: agile (Scrum), DevOps, CI/CD, code review, and pair programming, with working knowledge of cloud compute platforms to support collaborative, scalable, and efficient development. * Author and maintain researcher\-facing documentation and provide direct technical support to research users of the platform. jobs.title: Senior Semantic Data Engineer
jobs.description: At Prologis, we don’t just lead the industry—we define it with a 1\.3 billion square foot portfolio and an annual throughput of approximately $3\.2 trillion. We create the intelligent infrastructure that powers global commerce, seamlessly connecting the digital and physical worlds. From agile supply chains to energy solutions, our ecosystems help your business move faster, operate smarter and grow sustainably. With unmatched scale, innovation and expertise, Prologis is a category of one—not just shaping the future of logistics but building what comes next.**Job Title:** Senior Semantic Data Engineer**Company:** Prologis **A day in the life** Prologis is transforming how work gets done by bringing trusted data, automation, and AI into the core of its operations. As a Senior Semantic Data Engineer on the Data Solutions team, you will help create a shared enterprise understanding of business concepts, relationships, rules, and measures so people, applications, processes, and AI can interpret and use data consistently. This multidisciplinary role combines senior data engineering, business analysis, semantic modeling, AI evaluation, and enablement, with close partnership across business leaders, domain experts, and technical teams. You will carry solutions from discovery through production, helping Prologis improve decision confidence, accelerate solution delivery, and scale automation and AI without recreating business logic for each use case. **Key responsibilities include:** * Design and deliver trusted, reusable Snowflake data products for business domains, translating source data into certified dimensional structures, reusable views, and data contracts while resolving identity and modeling historical change. * Build and maintain the semantic layer by defining shared business concepts, terminology, relationships, rules, and measures that support consistent use of enterprise data across analytics, applications, business processes, automation, and AI. * Implement semantic data products using Snowflake Cortex semantic views and analytical Cortex Agents, applying approved AI capabilities to improve delivery speed, quality, and consistency while remaining accountable for outputs. * Validate semantic data products for business accuracy, data quality, usability, performance, security, and production readiness. * Develop and maintain representative business questions, verified queries, expected results, and regression tests; investigate inaccurate or inconsistent AI\-generated answers and improve the underlying data, semantic model, instructions, or examples. * Capture definitions, mappings, ownership, lineage, and user guidance in version\-controlled, machine\-readable formats and publish this content to the enterprise data catalog through automated processes. * Lead complex semantic\-modeling initiatives from business and source discovery through technical design, implementation, production deployment, and continuous improvement, partnering with business owners and domain experts across business functions, processes, systems, and regional variations. **Building blocks for success** **Required:** * Five or more years of experience in data engineering, data modeling, analytics engineering, or a related discipline. * Experience designing conceptual, logical, physical, and dimensional data models and translating business concepts into production data products, including grain, relationships, metrics, identity, and historical change. * Advanced SQL skills. * Experience designing and delivering production data products in Snowflake. * Experience with semantic layers, reusable metric definitions, and business metadata that support natural\-language data access, enterprise search, copilots, or AI agents. * Experience managing technical assets through source control, code review, automated testing, deployment, and change\-management practices. * Practical experience using approved AI tools in analysis, engineering, documentation, testing, or problem\-solving, with disciplined validation of AI\-generated outputs. * Communication and facilitation skills demonstrated through work with business stakeholders, translation between business and technical teams, ambiguity resolution, influence without direct authority, and leadership across collaborating teams. **Preferred:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Management, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Experience with Snowflake Cortex semantic views, Cortex Analyst, Cortex Agents, or comparable AI\-enabled semantic\-layer technologies. * Experience creating evaluation datasets, verified query libraries, or validation frameworks for analytics, natural\-language\-to\-SQL, or AI solutions. * Experience with enterprise data catalogs, metadata management, lineage, and data\-quality platforms. * Experience using Python or a similar programming language and machine\-readable formats such as YAML to create and maintain data and metadata assets, including exposure to APIs or MCP\-based integrations; exposure to controlled vocabularies, taxonomies, knowledge graphs, or ontologies is also useful. * Demonstrates willingness and capability to leverage emerging technology, automation, and AI tools to improve efficiency, quality, and speed. Exercises sound judgment, creative thinking, and accountability for outcomes. **Hiring Salary Range of:** $104,000 \- $144,000\. Salary and whole compensation package (bonus target) to be determined by the candidate’s location, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. **People First** Each of us working at Prologis plays an essential role in the enduring success of our company. We value people who are decisive, courageous and adaptable. While we are one company, locations and departments operate with autonomy and accountability. **Individuals take the initiative here.** When you join Prologis, you work shoulder to shoulder with some of the top talent in the industry to do the best work of your career. Every employee belongs. Every employee contributes. **Employees advance their careers here.** As a successful global enterprise, Prologis has never lost sight of what matters most, our strong belief that our people are the most important part of our business. And because of that, we provide a generous total rewards package and take a lot of time to focus on quality management and leadership development. **People come first here.** All full\-time roles in the US come with a robust benefits package which includes healthcare, dental, and vision insurance for employees and eligible dependents. Prologis also offers several other wellness, financial, and work/lifestyle\-specific benefits. Our 401(k) retirement plan has a company match of 50% up to 12% of eligible compensation. We also offer generous PTO with a starting accrual of 22 days a year in addition to paid holidays and volunteer time. All job offers are contingent upon successful completion of background verification. jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **Automation Engineer** **Location**: Provo, UT · **Type**: Full\-time, on\-site · **Pay**: $95,000 \- $140,000/year · **Education**: No degree required **Build the machines that build our products** At Sprout, we often build our own tools and equipment instead of buying them off the shelf. We've already designed and built several custom CNC machines in\-house, and we're getting ready to design, build, and deploy at least six more. As our Automation Engineer, you'll work directly on the shop floor. You'll design, build, and deploy custom automated equipment and tooling, and set up production processes that are safe, efficient, and consistent. What matters most is turning what you know into working solutions that cut waste and create real value for our customers. **How We Work** Our culture is built on Gemba ("go where the work happens"), lean thinking, and self\- driven growth. We innovate because solving problems on the floor makes our customers' experience better, not just because it's fun (though it is). This is not a desk job. In many companies, engineers design from an office and production workers live with the results. We don't accept that divide. Our engineers work at the Gemba: they run the line, do the work themselves, and learn it as well as the operators do. The best equipment comes from engineers who know the job firsthand and who treat operators as partners, not end users. **Four values guide everything we do:** 1\. **Transparency \& Reflection**. We communicate openly, think out loud, and talk honestly about what's working and what isn't. We don't hide mistakes or hoard knowledge. We find root causes without ego and share what we learn with the whole team. 2\. **Discipline \& Standardization**. You can't improve a process that changes every day. Standardized baselines make consistency possible, and consistency is what lets us measure, improve, and innovate. We built our own real\-time standardization technology so the people running the tools own their procedures and can give feedback on them directly. 3\. **Growth \& Innovation**. We don't innovate from cubicles. Real improvement happens at Gemba, where the work and the customer value actually happen. As your skills grow, you'll spend more time on technical design and less on production, but you'll always stay connected to the floor. Even our best PLC programmers and equipment designers innovate with tools in their hands. 4\. **Community \& Mentorship**. We guide; you drive. We provide expert mentorship and professional\-grade tools, but we don't hand\-hold. We look for people who own their learning, teach themselves, and lift up the people around them. How fast you grow is up to your curiosity and initiative. **How Your Role Grows** We hire experienced engineers and expect you to own real equipment projects quickly. You'll start at the Gemba to learn our line, then move into leading improvements and machine builds within your first 3 weeks. 1\. Learn Our Line (first 3 weeks) * Work production shifts to learn our products, line flow, and team firsthand. * Map our existing equipment and processes, and pinpoint bottlenecks, wasted material, and wasted motion. * Take ownership of our "Living SOP" (Standard Operating Procedure) system and set standardized baselines with our real\-time technology stack. 2\. jobs.title: Senior Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description: ### **About Refractal** Refractal is an AI security company building the infrastructure organisations need to defend against autonomous AI threats. 2026 has shown that generally capable intelligence is here. The challenge now is modernising security to stop AI\-enabled threats, whether they come from internal agents going rogue or from attackers using AI to become more dangerous. Refractal was founded on cybersecurity and AI expertise from MIT, Microsoft, NASA and the U.S. Navy. Our product lets organisations detect AI\-enabled threats at low cost without sacrificing detection quality. We take a practical approach to AI risk, combining proven cybersecurity methods with frontier AI security research. Today, we work with governments and organisations that can't afford to get security wrong. We're backed by leading deep\-tech and cybersecurity investors and are growing the team to deliver on this mission. ### **The role** You'll build pipeline and close six\-figure enterprise deals for Refractal in the US, working with the founders to refine how we sell. You can be based in Boston, Austin or New York, working hybrid with travel to customers. ### **What you'll do** * Own the full sales cycle for US enterprise accounts, from first meeting to signature. * Sell to CISOs, security leaders, and risk and compliance executives. * Build and close partnerships with managed security service providers that resell or embed Refractal. * Run evaluations with our Forward Deployed Engineer and turn them into contracts. * Help refine our ideal customer profile, pricing, proposals and sales process, and lead outbound with our SDR. ### **Success in your first six months** * You've built a qualified pipeline with identified decision\-makers and clear next steps. * You've won new business against agreed targets and have at least one MSSP partnership in motion. * What works in your accounts is documented so the rest of the sales team can use it. ### **About you: essential** * 7\+ years in B2B sales, including 5\+ carrying a closing quota and 3\+ selling security. * A record of closing net\-new enterprise deals at $100k\+ annual contract value. * Comfort selling a new category, working closely with the founders and our technical team. * A network among security leaders in financial services or other regulated industries. * Disciplined qualification using MEDDPICC or similar, and willingness to travel. ### **Nice to have** * Experience selling for a growing security company. * Channel or MSSP sales experience. * A technical background, such as sales engineering. ### **Our values** **Radical transparency.** We believe the best work happens when everyone feels able to give and receive honest, constructive feedback. **Public service.** We see AI security as a form of public service. Getting the AI transition right means putting the right infrastructure in place to manage the threats that come with it, and our work helps protect the institutions and services society depends on. **Fail fast.** We test ideas early, seek feedback and learn quickly. We experiment rapidly and change course when something isn't working, without compromising on security. **Pragmatism, not dogmatism.** We choose approaches based on how well they solve the problem. That means combining established cybersecurity methods with frontier AI research, questioning our assumptions, and changing our minds when the evidence changes. ### **Compensation and benefits** * Salary: $140,000–$190,000 base * 20% commission on sales * Competitive equity to share in Refractal's growth * Pension contribution * Private medical and dental cover * Visa and relocation support Compensation Range: $140K \- $190K
