jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for a savvy Data Engineer to join our growing team of analytics experts. The hire will be responsible for expanding and optimizing our data and data pipeline architecture, as well as optimizing data flow and collection for cross functional teams. The ideal candidate is an experienced data pipeline builder and data wrangler who enjoys optimizing data systems and building them from the ground up. The Data Engineer will support our data analysts and data scientists on data initiatives and will ensure optimal data delivery architecture is consistent throughout ongoing projects. They must be self\-directed and comfortable supporting the data needs of multiple teams, systems and products. The right candidate will be excited by the prospect of optimizing or even re\-designing our company’s data architecture to support our next generation of products and data initiatives. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Create and maintain optimal data pipeline architecture, * Assemble large, complex data sets that meet functional / non\-functional business requirements. * Identify, design, and implement internal process improvements: automating manual processes, optimizing data delivery, re\-designing infrastructure for greater scalability, etc. * Build the infrastructure required for optimal extraction, transformation, and loading of data from a wide variety of data sources using SQL and ‘big data’ technologies. * Build analytics tools that utilize the data pipeline to provide actionable insights into customer acquisition, operational efficiency and other key business performance metrics. * Work with stakeholders including the Partner, Client and Data teams to assist with data\- related technical issues and support their data infrastructure needs. * Keep our data separated and secure across national boundaries through multiple data centers. * Create data tools for analytics and data scientist team members that assist them in building and optimizing our product into an innovative industry leader. * Work with data and analytics experts to strive for greater functionality in our data systems. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Advanced working SQL knowledge and experience working with relational databases, query authoring (SQL) as well as working familiarity with a variety of databases. * Experience building and optimizing ‘big data’ data pipelines, architectures and data sets. * Experience performing root cause analysis on internal and external data and processes to answer specific business questions and identify opportunities for improvement. * Strong analytic skills related to working with unstructured datasets. * Build processes supporting data transformation, data structures, metadata, dependency and workload management. * A successful history of manipulating, processing and extracting value from large disconnected datasets. * Working knowledge of message queuing, stream processing, and highly scalable ‘big data’ data stores. * Strong project management and organizational skills. * Experience supporting and working with cross\-functional teams in a dynamic environment. * We are looking for a candidate with 5\+ years of experience in a Data Engineer role, who has attained a Graduate degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Informatics, Information Systems or another quantitative field. * Experience with the following big data tools: Apache Hadoop, Apache Hive, Apache Spark, Apache Pig, etc. * Experience with at least three relational SQL and/or NoSQL databases: MongoDB, HBase, Oracle, SQL Server, Cassandra, Neo4j, Redis, and/or Riak. * Experience with any data pipeline and workflow management tools: Apache Kafka and/or Apache Spark, Azure DevOps, AWS Data Pipeline. * Experience with at least one cloud service: AWS and/or Microsoft Azure * Experience with at least one stream\-processing system: AWS Kinesis, Azure Stream Analytics, and/or Apache Flink, etc. * Experience with at least three of the following object\-oriented/object function/operating system scripting languages: Python, Java, Scala, C\+\+, Linux/Unix, etc. **About Scale** --------------- Scale Marketing is a collective of professionals who bring unique business and media experience together to drive client success. We dive into our client’s customer data and historic media buys to optimize strategy. We buy media strategically and efficiently, and we produce creative work designed to meet specific KPIs. With robust data and analytics expertise, Scale is constantly testing, analyzing, updating, and optimizing. We attribute our success to the way we treat our clients and each other, and we are always looking for subject matter experts to join our team. Proud to be awarded designation by Crain’s Chicago Business as one of the 2021 Best Places to Work in Chicago.

jobs.description: Job Description: **Engineering Manager \- Protection, Control \& Automation (PCA)** Hybrid work schedule based in one of Schneider Electric’s HUB or COE locations The PCA Engineering Manager is responsible for leading a team of engineers and system commissioning specialists to deliver projects involving protection, control, and automation solutions, while achieving organizational goals. Our team specializes in applications such as automatic transfer schemes, generator control, Load management, intelligent Load shedding \& restorage, networking, SCADA, protection schemes and etc, using Protection relays, PLC, RTUs, generator controllers, HMIs, network switches. We also use communication protocols such as Modbus, DNP3, IEC 61850 and others. Our team specializes in applications such as automatic transfer schemes, generator control, load management, intelligent load shedding and restoration, networking, SCADA systems, and protection schemes. These solutions are developed using protection relays, PLCs, RTUs, generator controllers, HMIs, and network switches. We also utilize communication protocols such as Modbus, DNP3, IEC 61850, and others. The key responsibilities of this role are outlined below: **Engineering resource plan:** * Understand backlog evolution and forecasts to proactively and efficiently plan resource needs. * Collaborate closely with Sales to understand forecasts, key opportunities, and strategic accounts. * Regularly review resource allocation to ensure an optimal balance between workload and utilization. **Project Execution:** * Ensure the team delivers high\-quality project outputs in a timely manner * Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle * Key activities include: + Assigning resources to new projects + Participating in project handoff meetings + Working with Project Managers (PMs) on scheduling + Attending project review meetings + Managing escalations * Ensure adherence to Schneider Electric (SE) safety policies and practices **Team Management**: * Partner with leadership to define and align on team goals * Establish clear objectives for both the team and individual members * Support employee development through: + Career discussions (especially for early\-career professionals) + Coaching and mentoring * Conduct annual performance evaluations and manage the Global Salary Review process * Lead team meetings and 1:1 sessions * Ensure adherence to processes and perform quality checks * Encourage continuous improvement initiatives from team members * Monitor performance and make adjustments as needed + Support team members with legal status processes as needed Create a positive work environment that fosters collaboration, cooperation, and strong communication. Act as the bridge between leadership and the team, ensuring transparent and effective communication. Drive innovation by proposing new ideas and improving processes, engineering practices, and templates. Continuously seek efficiency improvements. **Profit \& Loss (P\&L) management:** * Co\-own the P\&L with other team leaders * Ensure revenue and margin targets are met * Perform short\- and long\-term revenue forecasting * Support Project Managers in accelerating revenue when required * Manage Work In Progress (WIP) * Collaborate with Finance to review and resolve financial issues **Collaboration with other SE entities/teams:** * Collaborate with other Schneider Electric (SE) entities and teams within and beyond Digital Power to ensure cross\-functional alignment * Engage proactively in networking and cooperation initiatives, regardless of project requirements * Share ideas, resources (when applicable), and pursue collective success **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or equivalent * 5\+ years of engineering experience * 5\+ years of people management experience * Leadership \& Management skills + Coaching / Mentoring, Performance management + Strong Interpersonal \& communication skills + Ability to influence stakeholders, facilitate cross\-functional \& cross\-business unit collaboration + Experience in Sales is a plus + Conflict resolution \& decision making under pressure + Autonomous, motivator \& proactive * Project and Business management + Strong background and capability on project execution + Scheduling, budgeting, resource management / Risk \& Opportunity management + Experience in project management is a plus + Understanding of P\&L / Cost structure, ROI and other financial implications. Experience in managing P\&L is a plus * Technical competency in Protection, Control \& Automation + Technical experience \& expertise on Protection Relays, Programmable Logic Controller (PLC), Human Machine Interface (HMI) \& SCADA System + Experience on EPAS (Ecostruxure Power Automation System) is a plus * Operation \& Strategic Thinking + Safety oriented + Help to improve overall technical competency of the team + Short \& Long\-term operation planning + Strong pro  education or training. **Schneider Electric is there when it matters most to you** Our Total Rewards package outlines all the benefits and support you’ll enjoy as part of the Schneider Electric team: **Care for Yourself and Your Family.** We ensure you feel secure with benefits that help you and your family thrive: medical (with member reward points), dental, vision, and basic life insurance, Benefit Bucks, flexible work arrangements, paid family leaves, well\-being programs, 12 holidays per year, and 15 days of paid time off per year. **Invest and Plan Your Future.** We help you plan and invest for the future with competitive pay and programs including base salary, incentives, company share ownership, and 401(k) with match. **Grow Your Skills and Career.** We support development through performance discussions, global opportunities, the Schneider Career Hub, and learning platforms like Coursera. **Team Up in the Workplace.** We encourage collaboration, recognition, sharing your voice, and an inclusive workplace. **Support Your Community.** We make a difference through volunteer leave, programs with the Schneider Electric Foundation, youth education initiatives, and military leave benefits. *If you believe this job posting is not compliant with applicable state pay transparency laws in the U.S., jobs.description: Job Description: **Cybersecurity \& Data Protection Advisor** -------------------------------------------- ### **The Mission** At Schneider Electric, we empower all to make the most of our energy and resources, bridging progress and sustainability for all. We are seeking a **Cybersecurity \& Data Protection Advisor** to join our **IA Services \& Advisory** business and play a critical role in securing our digital ecosystem. This position offers an exciting opportunity to support Schneider Electric's digital transformation initiatives, including AI\-powered solutions, Industrial IoT, Edge Computing, cloud\-native technologies, and digital services. You will serve as a trusted cybersecurity advisor, partnering with product, engineering, and business teams to ensure security and privacy requirements are embedded throughout the lifecycle of our digital offerings. As a Cybersecurity \& Data Protection Advisor, you will help strengthen the cybersecurity and data protection posture of digital assets, provide guidance on secure development practices, and support certification and compliance activities across globally distributed teams.### **What Will You Do?** #### **Cybersecurity \& Data Protection Advisory** * Lead cybersecurity and data protection engagements for Schneider Electric digital assets, including software applications, technology platforms, APIs, and digital offers. * Partner with business, product, and engineering teams to identify cybersecurity and privacy requirements and implement appropriate controls. * Conduct risk assessments and provide recommendations to mitigate identified risks. * Review and evaluate security controls to ensure alignment with Schneider Electric cybersecurity and privacy standards. * Support security certification and governance activities, ensuring required evidence and documentation are completed accurately and on time. #### **Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL)** * Guide project and product teams through all phases of the Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL). * Support cybersecurity requirements definition, risk assessments, threat modeling, penetration test reviews, and final security reviews. * Conduct third\-party vendor cybersecurity assessments and identify appropriate risk mitigation measures. * Collaborate with development teams to integrate security\-by\-design and privacy\-by\-design principles into digital solutions. #### **Incident Response \& Security Assurance** * Coordinate with Incident Response teams to validate remediation plans and support security communications when required. * Work closely with R\&D, Verification \& Validation (V\&V), and Program Management teams to ensure products meet cybersecurity compliance requirements prior to release. * Participate in vulnerability management, remediation planning, and continuous improvement initiatives. #### **Stakeholder Engagement \& Awareness** * Deliver cybersecurity and privacy awareness sessions, workshops, and webinars. * Provide clear guidance and consultation to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Foster collaboration across global teams to maintain a strong cybersecurity culture and governance framework. (External) English Qualifications: ### **What Qualifications Will Make You Successful?** #### **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. * Minimum 3 years of experience in cybersecurity, preferably supporting software development or R\&D environments. * Hands\-on experience supporting Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) activities. * Strong knowledge of IEC 62443 cybersecurity standards. * Experience conducting cybersecurity risk assessments and implementing risk mitigation strategies. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage stakeholders across global teams. * Fluency in English. #### **Preferred Qualifications** * ISA/IEC 62443 Cybersecurity Expert certification. * CISSP, CSSLP, or other recognized cybersecurity certifications. * Experience supporting industrial automation, OT, or Industrial Control System (ICS) environments. * Multilingual capabilities, including Spanish or French. ### **Key Competencies** #### **Cybersecurity \& Technical Expertise** * Information Security Management principles and best practices. * Risk assessment, vulnerability management, and security governance. * Industrial Control Systems (ICS) and Operational Technology (OT) cybersecurity. * Secure cloud architecture and cloud security controls. * Data privacy and Privacy\-by\-Design methodologies. * Authentication, authorization, encryption, and cryptographic technologies. * Secure networking protocols including TCP/IP, HTTPS, TLS, SSH, MQTT/S, LDAP, Modbus, and OPC\-UA. * Threat modeling methodologies and security architecture review techniques. * DevSecOps and application security practices. * OWASP principles and secure co  education or training. **Schneider Electric is there when it matters most to you** Our Total Rewards package outlines all the benefits and support jobs.title: Washington Clean Buildings Specialist
jobs.description: **ABOUT THE ROLE** Sheehan Engineering is seeking a motivated Clean Buildings Specialist to support our growing portfolio of energy audits, energy management plans, operations and maintenance (O\&M) programs, and energy benchmarking services. This field role will support our mission to help building owners and operators achieve compliance with the Washington State Clean Buildings Performance Standard and other energy performance programs. Working with minimal supervision, you will travel to client facilities throughout your region to document existing building conditions in sufficient detail for our engineering staff to develop high\-quality energy management plans, O\&M programs, and benchmarking analyses. **COMPENSATION \& ENGAGEMENT** This is a flexible, as\-needed role. Work is project\-driven, assigned based on active survey and assessment needs. Compensation is hourly at a rate commensurate with experience and determined upon engagement, with hours allocated on a per\-project basis. Hours compensated are for onsite survey and documentation time, with mileage reimbursement per current IRS rates. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Conduct site visits to client facilities independently or with minimal supervision, documenting existing building conditions with thoroughness and accuracy. * Perform physical equipment inventory takeoffs for mechanical, electrical, and building envelope systems, including HVAC equipment, lighting, building controls, and other energy\-consuming components. * Photograph building equipment, mechanical rooms, utility infrastructure, and overall property conditions for engineering documentation purposes. * Locate and document utility meters — electricity, natural gas, and district energy systems — including tracing distribution systems to identify which equipment and zones each meter serves. * Conduct brief interviews with site staff and facility personnel to gather operational knowledge, system histories, and context that may not be apparent from physical observation alone. * Record nameplate data, model numbers, serial numbers, capacities, and operational status of building systems and components. * Perform physical takeoffs of building areas, envelope components, and equipment configurations to support energy calculations and benchmarking. * Gather operational information including schedules, setpoints, and control sequences as observable in the field. * Organize and submit field data, photographs, and documentation to engineering staff in a clear, structured format following company templates and standards. * Coordinate site access logistics with facility contacts and maintain professionalism as a representative of Sheehan Engineering. **QUALIFICATIONS** **Required** * Basic working knowledge of commercial building systems, including HVAC equipment types, distribution systems, and their roles in building operations. * Valid driver’s license and reliable personal vehicle; must be willing and able to travel to client sites throughout your region on a regular basis. * Self\-starter with strong initiative, the ability to work independently with minimal direction, and sound professional judgment in the field. * Organized, detail\-oriented, and able to produce accurate and complete field documentation. * Professional demeanor when interacting with facility staff and building operators. **Preferred** * Engineer in Training (EIT) accreditation. * Certified Energy Manager (CEM) credential or active enrollment in an AEE CEM training program. * ASHRAE certifications relevant to building energy work, such as the Building Energy Assessment Professional (BEAP) credential. * Journeyman HVAC/R license, EPA 608 certification, NATE certification, or equivalent trade credentials. * Prior experience in building energy auditing, commissioning, facility assessments, or related technical field work. * Familiarity with ASHRAE Standard 211, the Washington State Clean Buildings Performance Standard (CBPS), or ENERGY STAR Portfolio Manager. * Experience using field data collection tools, spreadsheets, or building assessment software. **WHY SHEEHAN ENGINEERING** Sheehan Engineering is a licensed professional engineering firm specializing in building energy performance services. We bring deep technical expertise to energy audits, assessments, commissioning, and compliance programs — with a commitment to independence and objectivity in every engagement. As the Pacific Northwest navigates the requirements of the Clean Buildings Performance Standard and broader decarbonization goals, the demand for qualified energy engineering professionals is growing rapidly. Joining Sheehan Engineering means gaining real\-world, resume\-building experience in a field at the forefront of the built environment’s energy transition. Learn more at sheehan\-eng.com. Pay: $28\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour Work Location: On the road

jobs.title: Manufacturing Master Data Engineer
jobs.description: **A Snapshot of Your Day** As a Manufacturing Master Data Engineer, you will play a critical role in establishing and maintaining the manufacturing data foundation for Siemens Energy's new Power Transformer factory in Charlotte, North Carolina. Working closely with engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, planning, and procurement teams, you will manage and govern manufacturing master data within SAP S/4HANA to support safe, efficient, and scalable operations. In this role, you will help build processes, standards, and documentation from the ground up as the factory ramps production. You will be responsible for executing and maintaining engineering changes, manufacturing bills of materials (MBoMs), routings, work centers, and other manufacturing master data objects while ensuring a high level of data integrity and process discipline. Your work will directly enable production readiness, operational excellence, and successful execution of customer projects. **How You’ll Make an Impact** * Partner with engineering, manufacturing, planning, procurement, and supply chain teams to create, maintain, and continuously improve manufacturing master data within SAP S/4HANA. * Develop and maintain manufacturing Bills of Material (MBoMs), ensuring alignment with engineering requirements, sourcing strategies, and manufacturing processes. * Execute Engineering Change Notices (ECNs) and manage the implementation of engineering changes across manufacturing data structures. * Create, maintain, and optimize manufacturing master data objects including routings, work centers, production versions, document information records, resources, storage locations, tools, and shift calendars. * Support the development of standardized master data governance processes, work instructions, and documentation within a greenfield manufacturing environment. * Attach manufacturing Bills of Material (MBoMs) to projects and maintain production versions to support production execution and material planning. * Analyze data accuracy, identify discrepancies, and collaborate with stakeholders to resolve issues that may impact manufacturing operations. * Ensure manufacturing master data remains accurate, consistent, and audit\-ready across all applicable SAP plant views. * Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to streamline data management processes and improve operational effectiveness. * Maintain a strong focus on quality, accuracy, and documentation to establish sustainable processes that support long\-term factory growth. **What You Bring** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related technical discipline. * 3\+ years of experience in manufacturing, operations, supply chain, or master data management within an Engineer\-to\-Order (ETO), Configure\-to\-Order (CTO), or complex industrial manufacturing environment. * Experience working with SAP ERP systems, preferably SAP S/4HANA, including manufacturing master data, bills of material (EBoM and MBoM), production planning, and change management processes. * Understanding of manufacturing processes, material flow, production planning, and engineering change control. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to interpret technical and manufacturing requirements and translate them into structured system data. * Experience developing and maintaining process documentation, work instructions, and operational standards. * Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data quality and accuracy. * Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced environment where new processes and systems are being established. * Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to work across engineering, manufacturing, and business functions. **About the Team** Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology. At Charlotte Power Transformers, you’ll be part of a team that is passionate about making a difference in the energy sector. We offer a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and opportunities for professional growth and development. Be a part of our mission to deliver superior transformer solutions to the world. **Who is Siemens Energy?** At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \+100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world’s electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo **Rewards** * Career growth and development opportunities * Supportive work culture * Company paid Health and wellness benefits * Paid Time Off and paid holidays * 401K savings plan with company match * Family building benefits * Parental leave Jobs \& Careers:https://jobs.siemens\-energy.com/jobs \#LI\-KM1

jobs.title: Equipment Software Engineer
jobs.description: Simpson Strong\-Tie is a leader in engineered structural connectors, software, and solutions for the building industry. We maintain a reputation as a trusted manufacturer, partner, and corporate citizen committed to our customers and employees. Our founder, Barc Simpson established 9 Principles of Business we live out as company values and have made Simpson Strong\-Tie an inspiring place to work since 1956\. Our team of talented people are dedicated to our shared mission: to provide solutions that help people design and build safer, stronger structures. Learn about our company culture directly from our team. **YOU** You want to build software that directly supports complex industrial equipment. You take pride in solving difficult, real\-world problems and delivering dependable systems that help customers design and build safer, stronger structures. As an Equipment Software Engineer, you will develop, maintain, and support multiple Windows applications used with a variety of manufacturing and equipment systems. You will initially be the primary software developer supporting this equipment area, with broad ownership of understanding the applications, their integrations, and how they interact with the equipment. This role combines strong C\#/.NET development skills with practical mechanical, electrical, and troubleshooting aptitude. You will use AI\-enabled development tools extensively to accelerate development, analysis, documentation, and test creation. You will be responsible for applying sound engineering judgment to guide those tools and rigorously reviewing, validating, and confirming that generated code, tests, and solutions are correct, safe, maintainable, and appropriate for equipment use. You will work closely with software, controls, electrical, mechanical, manufacturing, service, and other teams to diagnose issues, improve equipment capabilities, and deliver reliable solutions. You will not normally repair electrical, sensor, mechanical, or other physical equipment problems yourself. However, you must be able to understand how the complete system operates, narrow down the source of a problem, and accurately determine which team or person should address it. **WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING** (% of Time) Design, develop, maintain, and support Windows\-based equipment software applications using C\# and .NET. Applications may include operator interfaces, equipment\-control integrations, diagnostics, production\-support tools, configuration utilities, and printer integrations. (35%) Troubleshoot complex equipment\-related problems across software, electrical systems, sensors, PLCs, motors, drives, encoders, printers, networking, and mechanical components. Use a systematic approach to determine whether the source of an issue is within the software or should be escalated to another technical team. Clearly document findings, provide useful diagnostic information, and route issues to the appropriate subject\-matter expert when the problem is outside the software team’s responsibility. (20%) Integrate software applications with industrial equipment and control systems, including Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs), using protocols such as Modbus and OPC. This role will not program PLCs directly but will work closely with controls and electrical personnel to integrate applications with PLCs, troubleshoot communication and machine\-operation issues, and support new equipment features. (15%) Serve as a final software\-support escalation point for difficult issues. Work persistently and patiently through complex or intermittent problems until the software\-related cause is identified, the issue is properly scoped, or the appropriate team is engaged with enough information to continue the investigation. (10%) Develop and maintain automated tests, diagnostic tools, and validation processes to improve application and equipment reliability. Use AI tools to assist with test development while independently reviewing and confirming test coverage, correctness, and effectiveness. (10%) Integrate with a variety of industrial printing technologies, which may include inkjet printers, label printers, and high\-resolution printers that print directly on boards or other materials. Learn each printer’s interface, communication requirements, capabilities, and failure modes, and develop and support the software needed to send messages and production data to those devices. (5%) Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define requirements, support equipment installations and upgrades, document software and equipment behavior, and improve supportability across the equipment portfolio. Use practical planning and coordination practices to keep work visible and priorities aligned. (5%) **DESIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE** If you can do everything listed above, you’ve got what it takes. Perhaps some of the following would be helpful too: * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, information systems, engineering, or a rela ical, mechanical, manufacturing, service, and customer\-facing teams. * Building products, manufacturing, industrial automation, machinery, or equipment\-software experience is a plus. * Communication: Ability to write in a clear, concise, organized, and convincing manner for the intended audience. Ability to effectively present information to groups of managers, team members and customers. * Teamwork: Ability to build and sustain cooperative working relationships. * Organization: The ability to arrange resources to get things done; can orchestrate multiple activities at once to accomplish a goal; uses resources effectively and efficiently; arranges information and files in a useful manner. * Problem Solving: Ability to identify the information needed to solve complex problems effectively and work systematically to isolate the source across software, equipment, electrical, controls, and mechanical domains. * Composure: Ability to stay calm and in control in tense or frustrating situations. * Customer Focus: Ability to cultivate relationships that secure commitment and trust with external and internal customer needs. * Action Oriented: Ability to willingly take practical action to deal with a problem or situation in a timely manner. * Perseverance: Ability to do something despite difficulty or delay in achieving success. * Time Management: Ability to organize and prioritize assigned tasks. **TRAVEL REQUIRED** This position requires domestic and international travel up to 10% of the time. **WORK STATUS \& LOCATION** This full\-time, exempt position is located in Fulton, MO, with a hybrid schedule. **RELOCATION** Relocation is not available for this position. **PAY** $77,600 \- $124,200 / year **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT** The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS** While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit, talk, and hear, and sometimes walk and stand. While performing the duties of this job, the employee may occasionally push or lift up to 25 lbs. **WORK ENVIRONMENT** This job operates in a professional office environment where standard office equipment such as computers, phones, printers/scanners, etc. are frequently used. **REWARDS AT SIMPSON STRONG\-TIE** We recognize and reward employees with a carefully designed and comprehensive rewards package, including competitive compensation, quarterly bonuses or commission and first\-rate benefits. May exclude some positions, such as seasonal jobs. * **Quarterly Bonuses/Commission:** You will be eligible for either a bonus or commission, paid on a quarterly basis. We believe *all* employees affect customers, sales and revenue — directly or indirectly – and should be rewarded by sharing the company profits. * **Benefits:** We provide a wide range of benefits for eligible full\-time employees including: medical, dental, vision, retirement contributions, employee stock purchase and bonus plans, pay for holidays, vacation, sick days, funerals and jury duty, years of service awards, employee discounts, employee referral bonuses, charitable contribution matching, education reimbursement and more. View benefit plan details here: https://benefits.strongtie.com/. In keeping with our values and commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in our communities, we are an equal opportunity employer. This means that our employment decisions are based on your qualifications and merit, and our business needs. Please note all job offers are contingent upon a successful drug screen and criminal background check, in accordance with applicable local, state, and federal laws. \#NowHiring \#GetHired \#Hiring \#HiringNow Company: Simpson Strong\-Tie Company Inc.

jobs.title: Sr. Project Engineer - Embedded Software
jobs.description: Overview: **Snap\-on Business Solutions****(A group under RS\&I Division of Snap\-on Incorporated)****Location: Rochester Hill, MI****Work Schedule: Monday \- Friday in facility 5 days per week** Seeking an experienced Principal Embedded Systems Architect to lead the design and development of industry\-defining vehicle communication interfaces, diagnostic platforms, and connected solutions for the commercial vehicle industry. This hands\-on technical leadership role spans the full product lifecycle, from system architecture and hardware design through firmware, PC integration, production, and field support. The ideal candidate is a systems\-level engineer who can work across embedded hardware, ARM\-based firmware, PC device drivers, vehicle communications, and product cybersecurity. You will collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams, OEMs, fleets, and industry partners to advance NEXIQ diagnostic and connectivity products used worldwide. Responsibilities: * Lead the architecture, design, and development of embedded vehicle communication interfaces and diagnostic devices. * Develop and integrate firmware for ARM\-based microprocessors and microcontrollers using C/C\+\+. * Drive embedded hardware design, schematic and design reviews, board bring\-up, validation, troubleshooting, and production readiness. * Develop or support Windows device drivers, APIs, and low\-level communication software for USB and network connected devices. * Implement wired and wireless communications, including USB, Ethernet, TCP/IP, Wi\-Fi, and Bluetooth. * Design secure product architectures incorporating secure boot, hardware root of trust, secure firmware updates, device authentication, cryptographic services, and secure provisioning. * Support vehicle communication technologies and diagnostic standards, including CAN, CAN FD, SAE J1939, * J1708/J1587, ISO 15765, UDS, DoIP, RP1210, RP1227, and J2534\. * Provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and lead resolution of complex system and field issues. * Participate in industry standards organizations and vehicle communication working groups, helping influence future diagnostic, communication, and cybersecurity standards. Qualifications: * Bachelor's or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. * 10\+ years of experience developing embedded electronic products from concept through production. * Strong hardware design, integration, board bring\-up and debugging skills. * Deep experience with ARM\-based embedded systems and C/C\+\+ firmware development. * Experience developing or supporting PC device drivers and low\-level communications, particularly USB and networkbased protocols. * Strong knowledge of embedded Linux and/or RTOS\-based systems. * Experience with vehicle networks, protocol analysis, and commercial vehicle diagnostic systems. * Demonstrated ability to make system architecture decisions and lead across hardware, firmware, PC software, security, and test disciplines. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, location, and other factors.

jobs.title: Senior Solution Engineer
jobs.description: At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI\-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. Our customers are very happy with our technology and are quickly expanding their use cases, only limited by their own imaginations. The Customer Experience Engineering Team aims to enable customers to push these limits, and when customers run into roadblocks or issues, enable them and our internal technical resources to resolve those issues and get back to seeing success with Snowflake. Snowflake's Customer Experience Engineering Team is expanding! We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our team at the start of their career, someone who likes building intelligent data applications that give insight into diagnostic data and technical content that is relevant to issues customers may be facing. This is an entry\-level position: you will work closely with a mentor, tech lead, and your manager to get guidance and feedback as you grow into a well\-rounded engineer. Our Customer Experience Software Engineers enjoy developing features into the Snowflake product that aim to greatly reduce friction points that block customers and regularly require help from Snowflake technical experts. They are excited by the challenges presented by extracting intelligence from a wide variety of data sources, including structured and unstructured data. **You will:** * Implement well\-scoped tasks and projects across our stack, including Java and Python services hosted in Kubernetes and Snowpark Container Services, with input from other team members. * Learn to engage in all aspects of the software lifecycle, from design through supporting the deployment. * Show accountability for the quality, completeness, and customer experience of the work you own. * Seek feedback and incorporate input from peers, stakeholders, and design reviews. * Learn the design of the components you work in, including requirements, use cases, and architecture, and begin developing proficiency in a specific feature area. * Participate in all aspects of engineering: development, testing, bug fixing and triage, and support rotation. * Collaborate within a cross\-functional team, including product management and design. * Know when to ask for help in order to make progress and avoid unnecessary rework. **Our ideal Software Engineer will have:** * B.S. or M.S. degree in CS, MIS, or equivalent discipline * Internship or professional experience is a plus * Working knowledge of modern application design, good API design patterns, and the basics of performance and scale * Proficiency in at least one of the following (bonus for more than one): Python, Java, Scala, GoLang * Familiarity with software engineering best practices: unit testing, code reviews, and design documentation * Ability to debug your own code, and an interest in building strong troubleshooting skills in a cloud environment * Ability to write high\-quality, readable code that is readily maintainable by others, with consideration for performance, operability, and maintainability * Great communication skills, both verbal and written, and an interest in working with a diverse set of peers and external developers * A desire to contribute to the positive morale of the team, help new hires and interns onboard, and work on what the team needs * Genuine enjoyment of the art of building great software, and a love of learning new things Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. How do you want to make your impact? The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; flexible spending \& health savings account; at least 12 paid holidays; paid time off; parental leave; employee assistance program; and other company benefits. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game\-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.** **We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.** **The Impact You’ll Make in this Role** As an **ML Engineer** , you will be responsible for building and maintaining the pipelines that power AI in our Healthcare Information Systems (HIS). We are looking for a practical, detail\-oriented engineer who is passionate about **MLOps, data reliability, and production stability.** In this role, you won’t just be building models; you will be ensuring those models work reliably in the real world. You will help bridge the gap between data science and software engineering by implementing automated workflows, managing cloud infrastructure, and ensuring our AI services are secure and scalable. **Key Responsibilities** **1\. MLOps \& Deployment** * **Pipeline Development:** Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for machine learning, focusing on automated testing, model deployment, and version control (using tools like MLflow or Git). * **Model Serving:** Deploy ML models as scalable APIs and microservices, ensuring they meet performance and latency requirements for clinical use. * **Monitoring:** Implement basic monitoring tools to track model performance, data drift, and system health in production. **2\. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – Applied AI & Streaming
jobs.description: **Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?** Sony Interactive Entertainment isn't just the Best Place to Play — it's also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we're part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting\-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity. **Senior Software Engineer – Applied AI \& Streaming** **Aliso Viejo, CA** **The vision** We think AI will change what cloud gaming can be. It can make streamed play faster, more personal, and more accessible, and in some ways better than playing locally. As a Senior Software Engineer on our team, you'll build agents and inference\-backed systems into a real\-time streaming platform and ship them to players. You'll work where AI meets performance\-sensitive systems, and a lot of the problems here are still being defined. **What you'll do** * Design, prototype, and ship AI\-powered capabilities across our streaming platform and player experience. * Apply inference and agents to real\-time performance, player engagement, personalization, and accessibility. * Use AI to understand, optimize, and evolve large existing codebases, including our streaming stack. * Build and extend our platform in C\+\+, and help shape the technologies and architecture we use next. * Build what production AI needs: evaluation, telemetry, guardrails, fallbacks, and attention to latency and cost. * Turn ambiguous ideas into demos and experiments, measure what works, and harden it for production. * Work AI\-natively every day, using coding agents, automation, and rapid exploration, and help the team do the same. * Work with a small, focused engineering team and with partners across streaming, platform, and cloud. **You're a great fit if you have** * A BS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Senior\-level software engineering experience with a track record of owning complex systems end to end. * Strong C\+\+ skills from professional work in production codebases. * Hands\-on experience building and deploying agents or AI\-powered features in production. You've worked through evals, regressions, latency, cost, and the ways these systems fail. * A strong grasp of how to turn models into products, including context and prompt design, tool use and orchestration, memory and retrieval, model selection, and where inference should run. * Fluency with AI\-native engineering workflows. * Product judgment. You can tell when AI makes an experience better and when it's a gimmick. * The ability to work in ambiguity, move quickly, and keep momentum as priorities change. * Clear communication, strong ownership, and a habit of making the people around you better. **Bonus XP** * Python, Rust, or other languages used to build and serve AI systems. * Low\-latency or on\-device inference, model optimization, or GPU experience. * Real\-time media, game streaming, graphics, or video experience. * Cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, or production platform experience. * Experience building conversational or agentic experiences for games or interactive products. * Linux or Windows systems experience. * Japanese language or cross\-cultural collaboration experience. * You enjoy playing video games. **Why join us** * Work on AI problems most engineers never get to. In real\-time systems, every millisecond counts, and so does every inference call. * Help set the direction. Our AI strategy is still taking shape, and you'll help decide what we build, not just how. * Get real ownership. You'll join a small, senior team where ideas go from prototype to production quickly. Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks. Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights. **Equal Opportunity Statement:** *Sony is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category.* *We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity. jobs.title: VFX Director
jobs.description: Studio Wildcard, creators of the hit game ARK, was founded in 2014 by industry veterans Jeremy Stieglitz and Jesse Rapczak. ARK is the most successful Steam Early Access and Xbox Game Preview title ever and continues to break industry records on consoles and PC. We are seeking an experienced and highly creative VFX Director to lead the visual effects vision across our games and cinematic experiences. This role will define the artistic direction, technical standards, and production workflows for real\-time visual effects while collaborating closely with Art, Engineering, Design, Animation, Cinematics, and Production teams. The ideal candidate is both a strong visual leader and an experienced VFX artist who understands how to create spectacular and performant effects for large\-scale game worlds in Unreal. **Responsibilities** * Establish and maintain the overall VFX artistic vision and quality bar for Studio Wildcard projects. * Lead and mentor a team of VFX artists, providing creative direction, feedback, and professional development. * Develop VFX style guides, visual standards, workflows, and production best practices. * Collaborate with Art Director, Creative Director, Designers, Animators, Engineers, and Cinematics teams to develop cohesive visual experiences. * Oversee the creation of gameplay VFX including environmental effects, abilities, weapons, creatures, destruction, weather, magic, explosions, and other interactive effects. * Ensure VFX assets meet performance, scalability, readability, and platform requirements. * Work closely with Technical Artists and Engineers to improve VFX tools, shaders, materials, particle systems, and pipelines. * Establish efficient review and iteration processes for VFX production. * Balance visual quality with gameplay readability and technical performance. * Participate in creative reviews and provide clear, actionable feedback to artists. * Help define staffing, scheduling, task prioritization, and resource requirements for VFX production. * Identify emerging VFX technologies and techniques that could improve the quality and efficiency of Studio Wildcard's projects. * Maintain awareness of current real\-time rendering, simulation, procedural, and cinematic VFX techniques. **Qualifications** * 7\+ years of professional experience creating VFX for AAA games, film, animation, or comparable real\-time entertainment. * Previous experience leading or directing a VFX team. * Strong understanding of real\-time VFX production and Unreal 5\+. * Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain a cohesive visual style across a large project. * Strong artistic understanding of color, composition, timing, motion, lighting, scale, and visual storytelling. * Experience with particle systems, shaders/materials, textures, animation, simulations, and procedural effects. * Strong understanding of performance optimization and real\-time rendering constraints. * Excellent communication, leadership, and collaboration skills. * Ability to provide clear artistic feedback while maintaining a positive and creative team environment. * Experience working across multiple disciplines in a game\-development environment. * A strong portfolio demonstrating high\-quality VFX work. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Unreal Engine and/or other modern real\-time engines. * Experience creating VFX for large open\-world or multiplayer games. * Experience with creature, environmental, elemental, weather, destruction, and combat VFX. * Experience directing cinematic VFX and trailer work. * Familiarity with Niagara, Houdini, Substance tools, or comparable procedural/VFX technologies. * Experience building or improving VFX production pipelines and tools. * Experience working with technical artists and graphics programmers. * Passion for dinosaurs, creatures, survival games, science fiction, fantasy, or large\-scale worlds. **What You'll Bring** We are looking for a VFX leader who can think beyond individual effects and help define the visual language of an entire game. You should be comfortable moving between high\-level creative direction and detailed artistic feedback. You understand when an effect needs to be spectacular, when it needs to be subtle, and—most importantly—when it needs to communicate clearly to the player. You will have a major influence on how players experience the world, from the smallest environmental details to massive creature encounters and world\-changing events. **Leadership Expectations** As VFX Director, you will: * Set a clear creative vision for the VFX team. * Build and maintain a strong artistic culture. * Mentor artists and help develop the next generation of VFX talent. * Champion experimentation while maintaining production discipline. * Establish quality standards and hold the team accountable to them. * Work collaboratively across departments rather than operating in isolation. * Be proactive when gathering design requirements for VFX tasks * Advocate for VFX team during production planning and technical development. * Help create a team environment where artists can take creative risks, iterate, and produce their best work. **Portfolio Requirements** Applicants should provide a portfolio or reel demonstrating: * Real\-time gameplay VFX * Combat or ability effects * Environmental effects * Creature or character effects * Large\-scale effects and simulations * Shader/material work where applicable * Cinematic VFX where applicable **Why Studio Wildcard** At Studio Wildcard, VFX plays a critical role in bringing expansive worlds, creatures, environments, and gameplay systems to life. The VFX Director will have the opportunity to help establish the visual identity of our projects while working alongside a multidisciplinary team of worldclass artists, designers, engineers, and developers. If you're passionate about creating unforgettable real\-time visual experiences and want to help push the boundaries of game VFX, we'd love to see your work. **Required Application Materials:** * Resume * Portfolio * Cover Letter which should include + Why you are interested in working for Studio Wildcard + What games you are currently playing

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Pricing
jobs.description: **Tabs is the AI Operating System for Revenue, built for modern finance and accounting teams.** It combines deep revenue and accounting expertise with the agents and applications needed to run revenue work end to end. Tabs understands customer and contract context, applies accounting logic, and executes critical workflows with built in controls, auditability, and human oversight. With Tabs, finance teams can move from manually managing revenue workflows to directing outcomes while the system executes the work. **About the Role** We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own Pricing at Tabs — one of the most foundational and fastest\-evolving parts of the platform. Usage\- and token\-based pricing are becoming standard across B2B technology companies, fueled by the high cost of LLM inference and the opportunity to pass through these costs to customers. You’ll define the vision, data model, and roadmap for how Tabs handles usage, rating, and pricing — aggregating usage, calculating what’s owed against committed and overage pricing, and defining the price books/rate cards and commitments that drive it. Expect to shape technical architecture decisions directly, not just define requirements for them. **How We Work** * **We work hard.** Two\-week sprints, weekly ship goals, short feedback cycles. Built around intra\-month product releases. * **We work smart.** Get in front of the customer, use both data and customer feedback to drive decisions, while keeping the bigger picture in mind. * **We work together.** In\-office culture with people you want to work with. Lots of whiteboard space. Expense coffee, lunch, and dinner when in the office. **What You’ll Work On** **Establish pricing as a first\-class product domain** * Define and own the data model for pricing — price books/rate cards, and the quantity/pricing layer used to calculate what should be billed and recognized for revenue * Translate real\-world pricing complexity — tiering, effective\-dated changes, pass\-through costs, contract\-level exceptions — into a data model that's flexible without becoming unmanageable * Enable rate cards/price books to be defined once and referenced across downstream systems * Use AI/LLM extraction to parse pricing terms — rate structures, commitments, exceptions — directly from signed contract PDFs, so the price book reflects what was actually signed without manual re\-entry **Own usage aggregation and usage commitments** * Define how usage is aggregated and rated against contracted amount * Own the commitment model — how drawdowns, true\-ups, and overages work — in close partnership with engineering on the underlying architecture **Deepen support for usage and AI/token\-based pricing** * Build out the pricing infrastructure needed to support third\-party and usage\-based pass\-through costs * Give customers visibility into how their pricing has changed over time and what they were charged and why, so usage\-based invoices are self\-evidently correct **About You** * 5\+ years of product management experience, ideally in fintech, B2B SaaS, or platform/infrastructure products * Experience owning a data model or product layer that many downstream workflows depend on — you think in systems, not just features * Strong technical fluency — comfortable reasoning about data modeling and architecture tradeoffs directly with engineers, including on foundational/structural decisions * Experience owning a public or developer\-facing API as a product surface — versioning, rate limits, and documentation included * Comfortable operating in ambiguity — you can bring structure to an evolving problem space without needing it fully specified for you * Exceptional cross\-functional operator who can align technical and non\-technical stakeholders, including engineering leadership and executives * Thrives in fast\-moving, high\-growth environments where scope and priorities evolve **Strong plus** * Familiarity with billing, revenue recognition, or the contract\-to\-cash lifecycle * Experience with usage\-based billing/pricing infrastructure (e.g., at a billing platform like Stripe, Metronome, Orb, Zuora, or Chargebee, or owning pricing/monetization at a usage\-based product company) **Perks and Benefits (Full\-time Employees)** --------------------------------------------- * Competitive compensation and equity * Unlimited PTO * Up to 100% employer covered monthly healthcare premium (medical, dental, vision) * Lunch provided via Sharebite, plus dinner for any later in office days. * Parental leave up to 12 weeks * Tax free commuter and parking benefits * Voluntary insurances (Life, Hospital, Critical Illness, Accident) * Employee Assistance Program (Rightway) * Free One Medical Membership * 401k Tabs is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome teammates of all identities and do not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We’re committed to creating an environment where everyone can grow, contribute, and feel comfortable being themselves. Compensation Range: $180K \- $230K

jobs.title: Test Engineer 2
jobs.description: Position Description: **Test Engineer II** About the Role Join TRC Inc. as part of our dedicated engineering team embedded on\-site with a leading autonomous vehicle developer. As an AV Test Engineer, you will shape the future of mobility by evaluating prototype autonomous systems from end to end. Rather than passive mileage collection, our mission is focused on intentional edge\-case discovery, extreme limit testing, and fault injection validation across physical vehicles, closed\-course proving grounds, and Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL) test benches before software and hardware configurations reach public roads. The Top 3 Qualities We Look For ? Systematic Problem Solver: You approach anomalies methodically, isolating issues layer by layer across physical wiring, power, communication buses, firmware, and software stacks. You focus on preserving data, reading fault codes, and identifying the true root cause rather than just treating symptoms. ? Data\-Driven Automator: You believe test execution is only half the job; the other half is understanding system response. You leverage Python scripting and data parsing to turn raw vehicle telemetry into meaningful insights, automated test scripts, and repeatable validation pipelines. ? Safety\-Minded Team Player: You bring an uncompromising commitment to testing safety, thrive when solving ambiguous problems, and communicate technical findings clearly and objectively across diverse cross\-functional teams. What You Will Do ? Design and Author Tests: Translate high\-level system requirements into robust Design Verification Plans (DVPs) with clear parameters, boundary controls, and pass/fail criteria. ? Lead Multi\-Environment Testing: Execute testing across closed\-course tracks, physical prototype vehicles, and HIL test benches, collaborating closely with track dispatch, test conductors, and safety drivers. ? Manage Operational Test Modes: Guide vehicles safely through testing stages, from manual baseline runs (Mode 1\) to supervised autonomous runs (Mode 2\) and fully autonomous, high\-intensity limit / fault injection testing (Mode 3\). ? Integrate and Triage Vehicle Systems: Diagnose bus communication drops, firmware mismatches, and hardware anomalies using standard diagnostic protocols (UDS, DoIP) and lab equipment. ? Build Automation and Analytics: Write reusable Python scripts to parse time\-series logs, automate track scenarios, and build visual dashboards (such as Webviz or Jupyter notebooks) that streamline test reporting. ? Collaborate and Report: Track defects and systemic behavior in issue tracking systems (such as Jira), avoiding subjective terminology in favor of data\-backed, objective failure modes. Where You Can Make an Impact Test Engineers share a common core foundation and are matched with specialized workstreams based on interest and expertise: ? Vehicle Platform Integration: Testing physical and simulated interaction between the autonomous driving system and the base vehicle chassis. ? Sensing \& Perception: Validating LiDAR, Radar, and camera performance across extreme environments, adverse weather, and occluded target scenarios. ? Bring\-Up \& Flashing Operations: Standing up newly delivered prototype vehicles, managing flashing pipelines, and resolving base firmware mismatches at multiple testing sites. ? Motion Control \& Dynamics Simulation: Evaluating steering precision, lateral and longitudinal controls, and tire hydroplaning dynamics. ? Commercialization \& Offboard Operations: Validating driverless cabin comfort, thermal controls, low\-power sleep modes, and Over\-the\-Air (OTA) fleet updates. ? Structured Scenario Testing \& Benchmarking: Designing high\-fidelity track scenarios (soft targets, dummy pedestrian interactions, and multi\-vehicle choreography) while executing competitor benchmarking campaigns to evaluate autonomous decision\-making and safety margins against industry standards. ? Proving Ground V\&V: Running complex track campaigns, mileage accumulation, and real\-time field troubleshooting. ? Hardware Systems \& Architecture: Executing systemic defect triage, persistent diagnostic testing, and cybersecurity validation. What You Bring Core Qualifications: ? Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Systems, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, Robotics, or a related discipline. New college graduates and experienced engineers alike are encouraged to apply. ? Mindset: Strong understanding of systems engineering, requirements decomposition, and structured verification methods. ? Driving Credentials: Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record, plus the ability to pass internal closed\-course safety driver training (L1/L2 certifications). ? On\-Site Collaboration: Ability to be on\-site during core operational hours (9:30 AM to 2:30 PM) alongside vehicles, test benches, and track personnel. Technical Toolkit: ? Required Core Skills: ? Working knowledge or proficiency in Python (NumPy, Pandas, Pytest) for test automation, data analysis, and log parsing. ? Familiarity with in\-vehicle networking (CAN, CAN\-FD, Flexray, LIN, Automotive Ethernet) and diagnostics (UDS, DoIP). ? Hands\-on experience with lab instrumentation (multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, breakout harnesses) gained through industry work, coursework, or academic lab projects. ? Comfort working in Linux environments, using Git version control, and managing tasks in Jira or equivalent tracking tools. ? Preferred Domain Experience (Any of the following is a plus): ? Hands\-on involvement in collegiate engineering design teams (such as Formula SAE, Baja SAE, RoboMaster, or Autonomous Vehicle clubs) or engineering internships. ? Exposure to HIL and simulation platforms: dSPACE, Vector VT, MATLAB/Simulink, or CAPL. ? Familiarity with bus analysis tools: Vector CANoe, CANape, CANalyzer, or Dewesoft DAQ. ? High\-accuracy GPS/INS systems (e.g., OxTS, NovAtel) or track target systems (e.g., pedestrian target platforms, soft targets). ? Exposure to vehicle telematics, OTA update frameworks, or thermal/power management testing. ? Familiarity with ECU flashing pipelines, bootloaders, or flash toolchains. ? Exposure to robotics and perception frameworks: ROS / ROS 2, OpenCV, or sensor calibration toolsets. ? Interest or experience in vehicle dynamics testing automated steering robots, load cells, or outriggers. Working Environment \& Expectations ? Setting: A mix of offices, engineering garages, labs, and proving ground test tracks. ? Field Work: Occasional work outdoors in Arizona weather conditions, including summer heat and direct sun, with appropriate safety protocols in place. ? Mobility: Physical ability to position yourself comfortably in vehicle cabins and around sensor mounts when setting up instrumentation. ? Travel \& Schedule: Schedule flexibility to support critical milestone releases, with travel up to 20% to partner test sites as needed.

jobs.title: IT Operations Engineer
jobs.description: **About Teads** Teads is a leading omnichannel advertising platform building the future of digital advertising where quality content, trusted publishers, ambitious brands, and human creativity can thrive. Operating at true scale \- processing 18 billion ad opportunities every single day \- we connect global brands with a monthly reach of over 2\.2 billion unique users. At Teads, we believe **your impact travels further**. We are a borderless team of 1,700\+ innovators across 30\+ countries who favor outcome over tenure, value trusted autonomy, and use predictive AI to amplify human ingenuity rather than replace it. We move at pace, tackle genuinely complex problems, and foster a high\-accountability culture that stays genuinely human. If you are looking for room to build and meaningful scope, you belong here. Learn more at www.teads.com. **About the opportunity** Our global IT team supports Teadsters worldwide, from first\-level support to managing and standardizing major information systems. We are looking for an IT Operations Engineer to strengthen our New York presence, own day\-to\-day endpoint and end\-user operations for the US region, and work closely with the global IT team on identity, device management, and security hygiene. You are a resourceful, hands\-on problem solver who resolves issues autonomously, documents what you learn, and keeps users productive. You will balance daily support with improving the tools, processes, and automation behind it. **What will you do?** * Provide Tier 2 / Tier 3 technical support to Teadsters in US and across the globe: hardware, OS, applications, network, VPN, and authentication issues. * Manage the endpoint fleet (primarily macOS, with Windows) through MDM: enrollment, configuration, software deployment, patching, and compliance. * Administer identity and access: SSO and MFA, user and group provisioning, access requests and permissions, and secure access removal (Okta and directory services). * Run the onboarding and offboarding process end to end: laptop and account setup, welcome sessions for new hires, device recovery, and access revocation. * Track hardware, software, and license assets across their lifecycle; order IT equipment and manage vendors. * Monitor vulnerability and endpoint security tooling and act on findings with the Security team. * Keep core services stable and available: Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Zoom, Slack, and related SaaS. * Support the New York office: network, printers, meeting rooms, AV, and live\-streaming for global town halls and events. * Create and maintain documentation and runbooks; contribute to global standardization of IT processes. * Identify recurring issues and fix root causes through automation, scripting, or process changes **What will you bring to the team?** * Your skills and experiences: + 3\+ years of experience in IT support or IT operations in a fast\-paced, global environment. + Hands\-on experience supporting macOS and Windows in a hybrid environment. + Experience with MDM and endpoint management tools (Jamf, Kandji, Intune, NinjaOne, or similar). + Experience administering an identity provider (Okta, Entra ID, or similar), including SSO, MFA, and the user lifecycle. + Experience with ticketing and request\-management systems (Jira, ServiceNow, or similar) and tracking assets and operations. + Solid knowledge of networking fundamentals (DNS/DHCP, VLANs, VPN, Wi\-Fi) and endpoint security basics. + Experience with productivity suites (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365\) and video conferencing systems. + Strong communication skills, a service mindset, and a real sense of ownership and accountability. + Fluency in English. * Bonus points: + Experience with secure web gateway or zero\-trust tools (for example Zscaler) and endpoint security platforms (for example Microsoft Defender). + Scripting or automation skills (Bash, Python, or PowerShell). + Experience supporting remote teams and managing devices remotely. + Experience with AV and live\-streaming for company events. + Relevant certifications (for example Jamf, Okta, Microsoft, or CompTIA). * You connect with our values: + *Relentless Customer Focus:* You put customers at the heart of everything, building strong relationships, understanding customers needs, and making decisions that keep their perspective front and center. + *Act Today, Not Tomorrow:* You make smart decisions quickly, prioritize action over perfection, and keep things moving forward, even when things aren't 100% clear. + *Obsess About Outcomes:* You're outcome\-driven, take ownership of your results, and work through challenges to deliver what really matters. + *Evolve Through Change:* You're adaptable, curious, and see change as a chance to learn and improve. You evolve your skills to keep up and push ahead. + *Human\-driven, Powered by AI:* While we use AI to drive performance, it's our people who make the real difference. You bring empathy, collaboration, and a love of learning to everything you do. *The pay range for this position is USD $70,000 to $100,000 annually. The actual amount offered may be higher or lower, based on non\-discriminatory factors such as experience, job\-related knowledge, skills, and abilities. In addition to salary, you may be eligible for our competitive benefits and perks to support you and your family as part of Teads' total rewards package.* \#LI\-HYBRID \#LI\-BAILEY **Life at Teads** At Teads, we don't just offer jobs. We blend creativity, technology, and cutting\-edge data to shape the future of media. As a Teadster, you'll work alongside smart humans, collaborate with meaningful brands, and leverage advanced AI and automation to redefine how advertising works in a transparent, privacy\-first world. We are builders, innovators, and future\-thinkers. If you are excited by the evolution of technology and ready to embrace the future of AI\-driven media, you belong here. **Why Join Us?** * **A New Era of Media:** We've merged two open internet category leaders, Outbrain and Teads to create a unified omnichannel platform. Together, we drive results from branding to performance across CTV, mobile, and web. * **AI\-Powered Innovation:** We actively embrace AI and next\-gen technology to solve complex industry challenges. We look for curious minds who aren't afraid to experiment, adapt, and lead the charge into the future of digital advertising. * **Growth \& High Performance:** Our culture is dynamic, global, and built on excellence. We are committed to your success, offering the modern tools, mentorship, and development opportunities you need to thrive. * **Belonging \& Impact:** We foster a welcoming, diverse environment where approachable, resourceful, and passionate people excel. Through our employee\-ledEmployee Resource Groups (ERGs), you can actively drive change in areas like sustainability, women's empowerment, charitable initiatives, and DE\&I. **Equal Opportunity Employer** Teads is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion at all stages of recruitment and employment. We celebrate unique perspectives and are dedicated to building a team that reflects the global communities we serve.
